title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理
summary: 鐵路路基過渡段處理以「剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm；y=khard/ksoft=4 1。只把 khard 增加百分之十，y=4.4 1。模型邊界：相同載重區間的等效剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1. Increasing only khard with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 1. Boundary: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 相鄰支承位移差與剛度比值辨認
stages.titleEn: Adjacent-support displacement difference & Stiffness-ratio identification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相鄰支承位移差」與「剛度比值辨認」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adjacent-support displacement difference" and "Stiffness-ratio identification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相鄰支承位移差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-support displacement difference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相鄰支承位移差」如何影響鐵路路基過渡段處理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adjacent-support displacement difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway subgrade transition treatment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個獨立線性支承。使用兩側同步載重位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部懸空使差異增加，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相鄰支承位移差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.1 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two independent linear supports. Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adjacent-support displacement difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部懸空使差異增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相鄰支承位移差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adjacent-support displacement difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 相鄰支承位移差
knowledge.text: 同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部懸空使差異增加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相鄰支承位移差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Adjacent-support displacement difference" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部懸空使差異增加
同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同比值不同長度可有不同動態效應
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch.
Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal ratios over different lengths have different dynamics.
quiz.explanation: 同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相鄰支承位移差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-support displacement difference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相鄰支承位移差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adjacent-support displacement difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以兩側同步載重位移區分模型與觀察，先用荷重元及雙位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 相鄰支承位移差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-support displacement difference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相鄰支承位移差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adjacent-support displacement difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以兩側同步載重位移區分模型與觀察，先用荷重元及雙位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「相鄰支承位移差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using load cells and paired displacement gauges, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adjacent-support displacement difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「相鄰支承位移差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個獨立線性支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部懸空使差異增加造成偏離的合成觀察，以兩側同步載重位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Adjacent-support displacement difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two independent linear supports. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. Explain which evidence in simultaneous load-displacement on both sides distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部懸空使差異增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 相鄰支承位移差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-support displacement difference: failure diagnosis

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1. Increasing only khard with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 1. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

stages.title: 填土壓縮量級與排水流量估算

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「填土壓縮量級」與「排水流量估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fill compression scale" and "Drainage discharge estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fill compression scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「填土壓縮量級」如何影響鐵路路基過渡段處理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fill compression scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway subgrade transition treatment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓縮模數把應力增量連到層厚變化。本模型把 stress 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。一維均勻壓縮。使用應力與分層位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「填土壓縮量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Constrained modulus links stress increase to thickness change. In this model, stress is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13.2 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform one-dimensional compression. Use stress and layer movements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fill compression scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa；y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa; y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「填土壓縮量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fill compression scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「填土壓縮量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fill compression scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa；y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm。只把 stress 增加百分之十，y=13.2 mm。模型邊界：一維均勻壓縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa; y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm. Increasing only stress with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform one-dimensional compression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以應力與分層位移區分模型與觀察，先用層間沉陷計與載荷帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use stress and layer movements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Uniform one-dimensional compression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填土壓縮量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fill compression scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以應力與分層位移區分模型與觀察，先用層間沉陷計與載荷帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「填土壓縮量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use stress and layer movements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using layer settlement gauges and load ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fill compression scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「填土壓縮量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出一維均勻壓縮如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數造成偏離的合成觀察，以應力與分層位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fill compression scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform one-dimensional compression. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. Explain which evidence in stress and layer movements distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「填土壓縮量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fill compression scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數。這個失效與「填土壓縮量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查應力與分層位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. This failure and a measurement bias in Fill compression scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check stress and layer movements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.title: 過渡段通過時間：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transition passage time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：L=30 m, v=60 m/s；y=L/v=0.5 s。只把 L 增加百分之十，y=0.55 s。模型邊界：等速通過；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: L=30 m, v=60 m/s; y=L/v=0.5 s. Increasing only L with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 s. Boundary: Constant-speed passage; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以車速與過渡邊界區分模型與觀察，先用里程與同步時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed and transition boundaries to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transition passage time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以車速與過渡邊界區分模型與觀察，先用里程與同步時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「過渡段通過時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed and transition boundaries to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using chainage and synchronized clock, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Transition passage time. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「過渡段通過時間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等速通過如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由過短事件可能超出低頻量測頻寬造成偏離的合成觀察，以車速與過渡邊界說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Transition passage time, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Constant-speed passage. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Short events can exceed low-bandwidth measurements. Explain which evidence in speed and transition boundaries distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過短事件可能超出低頻量測頻寬。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Short events can exceed low-bandwidth measurements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 過渡段通過時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transition passage time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「過渡段通過時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transition passage time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過短事件可能超出低頻量測頻寬。這個失效與「過渡段通過時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查車速與過渡邊界，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short events can exceed low-bandwidth measurements. This failure and a measurement bias in Transition passage time can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed and transition boundaries rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用車速與過渡邊界作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過短事件可能超出低頻量測頻寬，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short events can exceed low-bandwidth measurements; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過短事件可能超出低頻量測頻寬」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Short events can exceed low-bandwidth measurements." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 按通過總重正規化可比較觀察期。本模型把 ds 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.44 mm/MGT。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。指定觀察窗平均。使用沉陷和噸位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；首次壓密與後期成長不可同一線性外推，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環沉陷增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Normalization by gross tonnage compares observation periods. In this model, ds is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.44 mm/MGT. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mean over a specified window. Use settlement and gross tonnage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Initial compaction and later growth need different extrapolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settlement increment per traffic” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: ds=2 mm, M=5 MGT; y=ds/M=0.4 mm/MGT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：首次壓密與後期成長不可同一線性外推」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：total=35 mm, used=18 mm, future=8 mm；y=total-used-future=9 mm。只把 total 增加百分之十，y=12.5 mm。模型邊界：同方向代數餘量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: total=35 mm, used=18 mm, future=8 mm; y=total-used-future=9 mm. Increasing only total with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.5 mm. Boundary: Algebraic reserve in one direction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 調整剩餘空間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Remaining adjustment range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「調整剩餘空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining adjustment range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以已用與預留調整量區分模型與觀察，先用竣工調整紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「調整剩餘空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use used and reserved adjustment to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using as-built adjustment records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Remaining adjustment range. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「調整剩餘空間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同方向代數餘量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍造成偏離的合成觀察，以已用與預留調整量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Remaining adjustment range, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Algebraic reserve in one direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. Explain which evidence in used and reserved adjustment distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以已用與預留調整量區分模型與觀察，先用竣工調整紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「調整剩餘空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use used and reserved adjustment to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using as-built adjustment records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Remaining adjustment range. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「調整剩餘空間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同方向代數餘量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍造成偏離的合成觀察，以已用與預留調整量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Remaining adjustment range, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Algebraic reserve in one direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. Explain which evidence in used and reserved adjustment distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調整剩餘空間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Remaining adjustment range"?
options: 本單元以已用與預留調整量區分模型與觀察，先用竣工調整紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：塑性耗能不能當成可回復儲能
optionsEn: Use used and reserved adjustment to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Plastic dissipation is not recoverable energy.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以已用與預留調整量區分模型與觀察，先用竣工調整紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use used and reserved adjustment to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 調整剩餘空間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Remaining adjustment range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調整剩餘空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining adjustment range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。這個失效與「調整剩餘空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已用與預留調整量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. This failure and a measurement bias in Remaining adjustment range can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check used and reserved adjustment rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用已用與預留調整量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。這個失效與「調整剩餘空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已用與預留調整量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. This failure and a measurement bias in Remaining adjustment range can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check used and reserved adjustment rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調整剩餘空間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Remaining adjustment range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部懸空使差異增加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch.
quiz.explanation: 重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 多年凍土地區鐵路路基
summary: 多年凍土地區鐵路路基以「凍土熱平衡活動層與路基變形」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。多年凍土路基的機械反應受溫度與含冰量控制，保冷、排水及熱擾動必須一起評估，短期穩定不代表長期熱狀態不變。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops permafrost heat balance active layer and embankment movement through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Permafrost embankment response depends on temperature and ice content; cooling, drainage and thermal disturbance must be assessed together, and short-term stability does not prove a stable long-term thermal state. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1.8 W/mK, dT=4 K, L=2 m；y=k*dT/L=3.6 W/m2。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=3.96 W/m2。模型邊界：一維穩態常數導熱率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mice=500 kg, latent=334 kJ/kg；y=mice*latent/1000=167 MJ。只把 mice 增加百分之十，y=183.7 MJ。模型邊界：純冰相變能量帳；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1.8 W/mK, dT=4 K, L=2 m; y=k*dT/L=3.6 W/m2. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.96 W/m2. Boundary: One-dimensional steady conduction with constant conductivity; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: mice=500 kg, latent=334 kJ/kg; y=mice*latent/1000=167 MJ. Increasing only mice with a ten-percent increase gives y=183.7 MJ. Boundary: Pure-ice phase-change energy account; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地基導熱通量與融冰潛熱需求
stages.titleEn: Ground conductive heat flux & Ground-ice latent heat
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地基導熱通量」與「融冰潛熱需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground conductive heat flux" and "Ground-ice latent heat": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地基導熱通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground conductive heat flux: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地基導熱通量」如何影響多年凍土地區鐵路路基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground conductive heat flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway embankments on permafrost”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溫度梯度決定熱流方向而非溫度正負本身。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.96 W/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。一維穩態常數導熱率。使用深度溫度梯度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；地表溫度單點無法決定深層熱流，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地基導熱通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature gradient determines heat-flow direction, not temperature sign alone. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.96 W/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One-dimensional steady conduction with constant conductivity. Use temperature gradient with depth as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One surface temperature cannot determine deeper heat flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ground conductive heat flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1.8 W/mK, dT=4 K, L=2 m；y=k*dT/L=3.6 W/m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1.8 W/mK, dT=4 K, L=2 m; y=k*dT/L=3.6 W/m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：地表溫度單點無法決定深層熱流」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One surface temperature cannot determine deeper heat flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地基導熱通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 本單元以分層沉陷及融深區分模型與觀察，先用分層沉陷計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「融沉應變估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Thaw-settlement strain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 融沉應變估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thaw-settlement strain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融沉應變估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thaw-settlement strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 冰透鏡分布不均會使沉陷高度局部化。這個失效與「融沉應變估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查分層沉陷及融深，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven ice lenses localize settlement. This failure and a measurement bias in Thaw-settlement strain can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check layer settlement and thaw depth rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用分層沉陷及融深作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；冰透鏡分布不均會使沉陷高度局部化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uneven ice lenses localize settlement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：冰透鏡分布不均會使沉陷高度局部化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven ice lenses localize settlement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 年度淨熱收支與雪層熱阻量級
stages.titleEn: Annual net heat balance & Snow-layer thermal resistance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「年度淨熱收支」與「雪層熱阻量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Annual net heat balance" and "Snow-layer thermal resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 年度淨熱收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Annual net heat balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「年度淨熱收支」如何影響多年凍土地區鐵路路基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Annual net heat balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway embankments on permafrost”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 年度淨熱輸入累積可改變長期熱狀態。本模型把 summer 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32 MJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同一邊界的全年能量帳。使用全年熱通量積分作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只量冬季散熱會漏掉夏季增熱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「年度淨熱收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulated annual net heat changes the long-term thermal state. In this model, summer is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 32 MJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Annual energy account on one boundary. Use year-round heat-flux integration as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Winter-only measurements miss summer warming; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Annual net heat balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：summer=120 MJ, winter=100 MJ；y=summer-winter=20 MJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: summer=120 MJ, winter=100 MJ; y=summer-winter=20 MJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只量冬季散熱會漏掉夏季增熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Winter-only measurements miss summer warming." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「年度淨熱收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Annual net heat balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 年度淨熱收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Annual net heat balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「年度淨熱收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Annual net heat balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：summer=120 MJ, winter=100 MJ；y=summer-winter=20 MJ。只把 summer 增加百分之十，y=32 MJ。模型邊界：同一邊界的全年能量帳；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: summer=120 MJ, winter=100 MJ; y=summer-winter=20 MJ. Increasing only summer with a ten-percent increase gives y=32 MJ. Boundary: Annual energy account on one boundary; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以全年熱通量積分區分模型與觀察，先用熱通量板與時間積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use year-round heat-flux integration to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 雪覆蓋可降低冬季散熱，並非越冷空氣就越能冷卻地基。本模型把 H 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.65 m2*K/W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻有效導熱率。使用雪深密度與地表溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；漂雪增加會改變原先冷卻邊界，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雪層熱阻量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Snow cover can reduce winter heat loss despite cold air. In this model, H is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.65 m2*K/W. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform effective conductivity. Use snow depth, density and ground temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Snow drifting changes the cooling boundary; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Snow-layer thermal resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 雪層熱阻量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Snow-layer thermal resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雪層熱阻量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snow-layer thermal resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漂雪增加會改變原先冷卻邊界。這個失效與「雪層熱阻量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查雪深密度與地表溫度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Snow drifting changes the cooling boundary. This failure and a measurement bias in Snow-layer thermal resistance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check snow depth, density and ground temperature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用雪深密度與地表溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；漂雪增加會改變原先冷卻邊界，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Snow drifting changes the cooling boundary; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：漂雪增加會改變原先冷卻邊界」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Snow drifting changes the cooling boundary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation heat removal" and "Thermistor-depth temperature error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風帶走熱量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation heat removal: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風帶走熱量」如何影響多年凍土地區鐵路路基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation heat removal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway embankments on permafrost”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 空氣顯熱輸送取決於質量流率與溫差。本模型把 mdot 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1658.25 W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。穩態乾空氣顯熱。使用進出溫差與風量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；通道阻塞會減少冷卻能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風帶走熱量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air sensible-heat transport depends on mass flow and temperature difference. In this model, mdot is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1658.25 W. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Steady dry-air sensible heat. Use inlet-outlet temperature difference and airflow as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Blocked ducts reduce cooling capacity; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation heat removal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mdot=0.5 kg/s, cp=1005 J/kgK, dT=3 K；y=mdot*cp*dT=1507.5 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mdot=0.5 kg/s, cp=1005 J/kgK, dT=3 K; y=mdot*cp*dT=1507.5 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：通道阻塞會減少冷卻能力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Blocked ducts reduce cooling capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風帶走熱量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation heat removal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 通風帶走熱量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風帶走熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation heat removal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mdot=0.5 kg/s, cp=1005 J/kgK, dT=3 K；y=mdot*cp*dT=1507.5 W。只把 mdot 增加百分之十，y=1658.25 W。模型邊界：穩態乾空氣顯熱；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mdot=0.5 kg/s, cp=1005 J/kgK, dT=3 K; y=mdot*cp*dT=1507.5 W. Increasing only mdot with a ten-percent increase gives y=1658.25 W. Boundary: Steady dry-air sensible heat; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以進出溫差與風量區分模型與觀察，先用風量計與雙溫度探頭建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「熱敏電阻深度誤差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出局部線性溫度梯度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度造成偏離的合成觀察，以感測器安裝深度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Establish a baseline using installation survey and repeat levelling, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermistor-depth temperature error"?

steps.title: 熱敏電阻深度誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermistor-depth temperature error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱敏電阻深度誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermistor-depth temperature error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度。這個失效與「熱敏電阻深度誤差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查感測器安裝深度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Embankment settlement can change relative sensor depth. This failure and a measurement bias in Thermistor-depth temperature error can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check installed sensor depths rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用感測器安裝深度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Embankment settlement can change relative sensor depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Embankment settlement can change relative sensor depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度。這個失效與「熱敏電阻深度誤差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查感測器安裝深度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Embankment settlement can change relative sensor depth. This failure and a measurement bias in Thermistor-depth temperature error can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check installed sensor depths rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱敏電阻深度誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermistor-depth temperature error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：地表溫度單點無法決定深層熱流
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Embankment settlement can change relative sensor depth.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One surface temperature cannot determine deeper heat flow.
quiz.explanation: 路基沉陷可能改變感測器相對深度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Embankment settlement can change relative sensor depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 重載鐵路軌道模數管理
summary: 重載鐵路軌道模數管理以「重載下支承模數辨識與載重分布」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌道模數把每單位長度反力連到鋼軌位移，與單一扣件剛度不同；量測辨識需分離鋼軌彎曲、道碴支承及軌枕接觸。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops support modulus identification and load distribution under heavy haul through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Track modulus relates reaction per unit length to rail displacement and differs from a single fastening stiffness; identification separates rail bending, ballast support and sleeper contact. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m；y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2。只把 q 增加百分之十，y=55 MN/m2。模型邊界：反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=60000000 N/m, s=0.6 m；y=k/s/1e6=100 MN/m2。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=110 MN/m2。模型邊界：離散彈簧剛度相同且等距；連續化只適用較長空間尺度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m; y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2. Increasing only q with a ten-percent increase gives y=55 MN/m2. Boundary: Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=60000000 N/m, s=0.6 m; y=k/s/1e6=100 MN/m2. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=110 MN/m2. Boundary: Discrete springs are equally stiff and spaced; homogenization applies only at longer spatial scales; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 軌道模數定義與扣件間距換算
stages.titleEn: Track modulus definition & Fastening-spacing conversion
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軌道模數定義」與「扣件間距換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Track modulus definition" and "Fastening-spacing conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軌道模數定義：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Track modulus definition: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軌道模數定義」如何影響重載鐵路軌道模數管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Track modulus definition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單位長度反力除位移才是軌道模數。本模型把 q 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 55 MN/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承。使用反力分布與撓度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軌道模數定義」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction per unit length divided by displacement defines track modulus. In this model, q is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 55 MN/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform. Use reaction distribution and deflection as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Track modulus definition” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m；y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m; y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軌道模數定義」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Track modulus definition”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軌道模數定義
knowledge.text: 單位長度反力除位移才是軌道模數。本模型把 q 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 55 MN/m2。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction per unit length divided by displacement defines track modulus. In this model, q is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軌道模數定義」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Track modulus definition" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數
單位長度反力除位移才是軌道模數。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：跨越懸空軌枕時均勻近似失效
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing.
Reaction per unit length divided by displacement defines track modulus.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uniform approximation fails across unsupported sleepers.
quiz.explanation: 單位長度反力除位移才是軌道模數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction per unit length divided by displacement defines track modulus. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軌道模數定義：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Track modulus definition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌道模數定義」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Track modulus definition” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m；y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2。只把 q 增加百分之十，y=55 MN/m2。模型邊界：反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m; y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2. Increasing only q with a ten-percent increase gives y=55 MN/m2. Boundary: Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以反力分布與撓度區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼軌分布反力、載點及鄰點撓度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use reaction distribution and deflection to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.instruction: 本單元以間距與單點剛度區分模型與觀察，先用每個模型支承力位移、間距及鋼軌連續撓度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「扣件間距換算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use spacing and point stiffness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 扣件間距換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fastening-spacing conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「扣件間距換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fastening-spacing conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 跨越懸空軌枕時均勻近似失效。這個失效與「扣件間距換算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查間距與單點剛度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform approximation fails across unsupported sleepers. This failure and a measurement bias in Fastening-spacing conversion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check spacing and point stiffness rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用間距與單點剛度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；跨越懸空軌枕時均勻近似失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uniform approximation fails across unsupported sleepers; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：跨越懸空軌枕時均勻近似失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uniform approximation fails across unsupported sleepers." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 梁支承特徵參數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Beam-foundation characteristic parameter: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「梁支承特徵參數」如何影響重載鐵路軌道模數管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-foundation characteristic parameter” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 四次根參數連結梁彎曲剛度與分布支承。本模型把 u 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.21546 1/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻無限歐拉梁置於線性溫克勒基礎；不含剪切變形。使用沿程撓度衰減作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；以集中彈簧公式替代會錯估影響長度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「梁支承特徵參數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fourth-root parameter links rail bending rigidity with distributed support. In this model, u is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.21546 1/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform infinite Euler beam on a linear Winkler foundation; shear deformation is excluded. Use longitudinal deflection decay as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A lumped-spring substitution misestimates influence length; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Beam-foundation characteristic parameter” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: u=50000000 N/m2, E=210000000000 Pa, I=0.00003 m4; y=(u/(4*E*I))**0.25=1.18684 1/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：以集中彈簧公式替代會錯估影響長度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A lumped-spring substitution misestimates influence length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「梁支承特徵參數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 梁支承特徵參數：定量估算
