steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：u=50000000 N/m2, E=210000000000 Pa, I=0.00003 m4；y=(u/(4*E*I))**0.25=1.18684 1/m。只把 u 增加百分之十，y=1.21546 1/m。模型邊界：均勻無限歐拉梁置於線性溫克勒基礎；不含剪切變形；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以沿程撓度衰減區分模型與觀察，先用模型梁彎曲剛度、支承模數及荷載兩側撓度衰減建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use longitudinal deflection decay to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 影響長度量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Influence-length scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「影響長度量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Influence-length scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以荷載兩側位移區分模型與觀察，先用跨越數個特徵長度的模型位移與反力剖面建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「影響長度量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use displacements on both sides of a load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model displacement and reaction profiles extending over several characteristic lengths, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Influence-length scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「影響長度量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出參數為均勻梁基礎模型的正特徵值；倒數不是反力的硬截止距離如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散造成偏離的合成觀察，以荷載兩側位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Influence-length scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Parameter is a positive characteristic value of a uniform beam-foundation model; its inverse is not a hard reaction cutoff. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A short sensing range misses load distribution. Explain which evidence in displacements on both sides of a load distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short sensing range misses load distribution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 影響長度量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Influence-length scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「影響長度量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Influence-length scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散。這個失效與「影響長度量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷載兩側位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short sensing range misses load distribution. This failure and a measurement bias in Influence-length scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check displacements on both sides of a load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用荷載兩側位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A short sensing range misses load distribution; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short sensing range misses load distribution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散。這個失效與「影響長度量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷載兩側位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: A short sensing range misses load distribution. This failure and a measurement bias in Influence-length scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check displacements on both sides of a load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「影響長度量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Influence-length scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A short sensing range misses load distribution.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation.
quiz.explanation: 感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short sensing range misses load distribution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 無限梁載點撓度與載點彎矩估算
stages.titleEn: Infinite-beam load-point deflection & Load-point bending moment
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無限梁載點撓度」與「載點彎矩估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Infinite-beam load-point deflection" and "Load-point bending moment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無限梁載點撓度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Infinite-beam load-point deflection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無限梁載點撓度」如何影響重載鐵路軌道模數管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Infinite-beam load-point deflection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無限梁解把荷載分散到連續支承。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.32 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一靜態集中力作用於均勻無限線性梁基礎；遠離端部。使用載點與鄰點撓度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無限梁載點撓度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The infinite-beam solution distributes load into continuous support. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.32 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One static point load on a uniform infinite linear beam-foundation system, far from ends. Use load-point and neighboring deflection as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Infinite-beam load-point deflection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=150000 N, beta=0.8 1/m, u=50000000 N/m2；y=P*beta/(2*u)*1000=1.2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=150000 N, beta=0.8 1/m, u=50000000 N/m2; y=P*beta/(2*u)*1000=1.2 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無限梁載點撓度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Infinite-beam load-point deflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無限梁載點撓度
knowledge.text: 無限梁解把荷載分散到連續支承。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.32 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The infinite-beam solution distributes load into continuous support. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無限梁載點撓度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Infinite-beam load-point deflection" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化
無限梁解把荷載分散到連續支承。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Displacement alone misses moment changes.
The infinite-beam solution distributes load into continuous support.
quiz.explanation: 無限梁解把荷載分散到連續支承。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The infinite-beam solution distributes load into continuous support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無限梁載點撓度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infinite-beam load-point deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無限梁載點撓度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Infinite-beam load-point deflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=150000 N, beta=0.8 1/m, u=50000000 N/m2；y=P*beta/(2*u)*1000=1.2 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.32 mm。模型邊界：單一靜態集中力作用於均勻無限線性梁基礎；遠離端部；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=150000 N, beta=0.8 1/m, u=50000000 N/m2; y=P*beta/(2*u)*1000=1.2 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.32 mm. Boundary: One static point load on a uniform infinite linear beam-foundation system, far from ends; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以載點與鄰點撓度區分模型與觀察，先用模型荷重元、載點位移及對稱鄰點撓度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use load-point and neighboring deflection to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=150000 N, beta=0.8 1/m, u=50000000 N/m2；y=P*beta/(2*u)*1000=1.2 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.32 mm。模型邊界：單一靜態集中力作用於均勻無限線性梁基礎；遠離端部；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=150000 N, beta=0.8 1/m, u=50000000 N/m2; y=P*beta/(2*u)*1000=1.2 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.32 mm. Boundary: One static point load on a uniform infinite linear beam-foundation system, far from ends; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Infinite-beam load-point deflection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似。這個失效與「無限梁載點撓度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載點與鄰點撓度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation. This failure and a measurement bias in Infinite-beam load-point deflection can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load-point and neighboring deflection rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用載點與鄰點撓度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：端部邊界會破壞無限梁近似」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: End boundaries violate the infinite-beam approximation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 較長荷載分散尺度改變鋼軌彎矩。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 51.5625 kN*m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一集中力與均勻無限梁基礎；未加入鄰近輪載疊加。使用鋼軌應變剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「載點彎矩估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A longer load-spreading scale changes rail moment. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 51.5625 kN*m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One point load and uniform infinite beam foundation; neighboring wheel-load superposition is excluded. Use rail strain profile as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Displacement alone misses moment changes; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load-point bending moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load-point bending moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以鋼軌應變剖面區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼軌多位置應變、截面模數及載點座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「載點彎矩估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use rail strain profile to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model rail strains at multiple positions, section modulus and load coordinate, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Load-point bending moment. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「載點彎矩估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一集中力與均勻無限梁基礎；未加入鄰近輪載疊加如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化造成偏離的合成觀察，以鋼軌應變剖面說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Load-point bending moment, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One point load and uniform infinite beam foundation; neighboring wheel-load superposition is excluded. steps.failure: 注意干擾：只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Displacement alone misses moment changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 載點彎矩估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load-point bending moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「載點彎矩估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load-point bending moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化。這個失效與「載點彎矩估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查鋼軌應變剖面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Displacement alone misses moment changes. This failure and a measurement bias in Load-point bending moment can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail strain profile rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用鋼軌應變剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Displacement alone misses moment changes; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只比較垂向位移會漏掉彎矩變化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Displacement alone misses moment changes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 軸重輪重分配與動載放大量級
stages.titleEn: Axle-to-wheel load & Dynamic load scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軸重輪重分配」與「動載放大量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axle-to-wheel load" and "Dynamic load scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軸重輪重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Axle-to-wheel load: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸重輪重分配」如何影響重載鐵路軌道模數管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axle-to-wheel load” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 對稱靜態軸重可均分兩輪，動態不均另計。本模型把 axle 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 161.865 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。輸入公噸為質量且左右輪靜態均分；不含曲線或動載轉移。使用左右輪重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；曲線與不平順會破壞均分，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸重輪重分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A symmetric static axle load splits across two wheels; dynamic imbalance is separate. In this model, axle is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 161.865 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Input tonnes represent mass and wheels share static load equally; curve and dynamic load transfer are excluded. Use left and right wheel loads as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Curves and irregularity break equal sharing; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Axle-to-wheel load” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：axle=30 t, g=9.81 m/s2；y=axle*1000*g/2/1000=147.15 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: axle=30 t, g=9.81 m/s2; y=axle*1000*g/2/1000=147.15 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：曲線與不平順會破壞均分」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Curves and irregularity break equal sharing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸重輪重分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Axle-to-wheel load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軸重輪重分配

knowledge.textEn: A symmetric static axle load splits across two wheels; dynamic imbalance is separate. In this model, axle is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：曲線與不平順會破壞均分 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「軸重輪重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

A symmetric static axle load splits across two wheels; dynamic imbalance is separate.

steps.title: 軸重輪重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axle-to-wheel load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸重輪重分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Axle-to-wheel load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：axle=30 t, g=9.81 m/s2；y=axle*1000*g/2/1000=147.15 kN。只把 axle 增加百分之十，y=161.865 kN。模型邊界：輸入公噸為質量且左右輪靜態均分；不含曲線或動載轉移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: axle=30 t, g=9.81 m/s2; y=axle*1000*g/2/1000=147.15 kN. Increasing only axle with a ten-percent increase gives y=161.865 kN. Boundary: Input tonnes represent mass and wheels share static load equally; curve and dynamic load transfer are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以左右輪重區分模型與觀察，先用合成車軸質量、左右輪荷重元及水平幾何建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use left and right wheel loads to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：axle=30 t, g=9.81 m/s2；y=axle*1000*g/2/1000=147.15 kN。只把 axle 增加百分之十，y=161.865 kN。模型邊界：輸入公噸為質量且左右輪靜態均分；不含曲線或動載轉移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: axle=30 t, g=9.81 m/s2; y=axle*1000*g/2/1000=147.15 kN. Increasing only axle with a ten-percent increase gives y=161.865 kN. Boundary: Input tonnes represent mass and wheels share static load equally; curve and dynamic load transfer are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軸重輪重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 曲線與不平順會破壞均分。這個失效與「軸重輪重分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查左右輪重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Curves and irregularity break equal sharing. This failure and a measurement bias in Axle-to-wheel load can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check left and right wheel loads rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Curves and irregularity break equal sharing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 動載放大量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dynamic load scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動載放大量級」如何影響重載鐵路軌道模數管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic load scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動載係數是已假定的放大，不是任意通用常數。本模型把 static 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 210.425 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。放大係數是獨立給定的假設且僅對此靜載；不是通用設計係數。使用同速度動靜輪重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；沿用其他路段係數會漏掉本地共振，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動載放大量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dynamic factor is an assumed amplification, not a universal constant. In this model, static is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 210.425 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Amplification is an independently assumed factor for this static load, not a universal design factor. Use dynamic and static wheel loads at matched speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A factor from another section can miss local resonance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dynamic load scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：static=147.15 kN, factor=1.3 1；y=static*factor=191.295 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: static=147.15 kN, factor=1.3 1; y=static*factor=191.295 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：沿用其他路段係數會漏掉本地共振」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A factor from another section can miss local resonance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「動載放大量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：static=147.15 kN, factor=1.3 1；y=static*factor=191.295 kN。只把 static 增加百分之十，y=210.425 kN。模型邊界：放大係數是獨立給定的假設且僅對此靜載；不是通用設計係數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: static=147.15 kN, factor=1.3 1; y=static*factor=191.295 kN. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 本單元以同速度動靜輪重區分模型與觀察，先用同工況靜動輪重時間序列、速度及輪軌不平順建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「動載放大量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use dynamic and static wheel loads at matched speed to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 動載放大量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dynamic load scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動載放大量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic load scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沿用其他路段係數會漏掉本地共振。這個失效與「動載放大量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同速度動靜輪重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A factor from another section can miss local resonance. This failure and a measurement bias in Dynamic load scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check dynamic and static wheel loads at matched speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用同速度動靜輪重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；沿用其他路段係數會漏掉本地共振，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A factor from another section can miss local resonance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：沿用其他路段係數會漏掉本地共振」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A factor from another section can miss local resonance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 支承區間增量剛度與模數空間變異
stages.titleEn: Support interval incremental stiffness & Modulus spatial variation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支承區間增量剛度」與「模數空間變異」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support interval incremental stiffness" and "Modulus spatial variation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支承區間增量剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support interval incremental stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支承區間增量剛度」如何影響重載鐵路軌道模數管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support interval incremental stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩點間增量剛度不同於原點割線，只有區間足夠小才近似切線。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 36 kN/mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩點有限差分給出區間增量剛度；只有極小區間才近似切線。使用多級載入曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；將切線與割線混用會誤判劣化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承區間增量剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two-point incremental stiffness differs from an origin secant and approximates a tangent only over a sufficiently small interval. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 36 kN/mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A finite difference between two points gives interval incremental stiffness; it approximates a tangent only over a very small interval. Use multilevel loading curve as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing tangent and secant stiffness misidentifies degradation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support interval incremental stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=40 kN, F2=80 kN, d1=1.5 mm, d2=2.5 mm；y=(F2-F1)/(d2-d1)=40 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=40 kN, F2=80 kN, d1=1.5 mm, d2=2.5 mm; y=(F2-F1)/(d2-d1)=40 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：將切線與割線混用會誤判劣化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing tangent and secant stiffness misidentifies degradation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支承區間增量剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support interval incremental stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支承區間增量剛度
knowledge.text: 兩點間增量剛度不同於原點割線，只有區間足夠小才近似切線。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 36 kN/mm。
knowledge.textEn: Two-point incremental stiffness differs from an origin secant and approximates a tangent only over a sufficiently small interval. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.title: 支承區間增量剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support interval incremental stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支承區間增量剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support interval incremental stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=40 kN, F2=80 kN, d1=1.5 mm, d2=2.5 mm；y=(F2-F1)/(d2-d1)=40 kN/mm。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=36 kN/mm。模型邊界：兩點有限差分給出區間增量剛度；只有極小區間才近似切線；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=40 kN, F2=80 kN, d1=1.5 mm, d2=2.5 mm; y=(F2-F1)/(d2-d1)=40 kN/mm. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=36 kN/mm. Boundary: A finite difference between two points gives interval incremental stiffness; it approximates a tangent only over a very small interval; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以多級載入曲線區分模型與觀察，先用多級模型力位移曲線、端點區間及加密取樣建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use multilevel loading curve to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=40 kN, F2=80 kN, d1=1.5 mm, d2=2.5 mm；y=(F2-F1)/(d2-d1)=40 kN/mm。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=36 kN/mm。模型邊界：兩點有限差分給出區間增量剛度；只有極小區間才近似切線；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.title: 支承區間增量剛度：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support interval incremental stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將切線與割線混用會誤判劣化。這個失效與「支承區間增量剛度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多級載入曲線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing tangent and secant stiffness misidentifies degradation. This failure and a measurement bias in Support interval incremental stiffness can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check multilevel loading curve rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用多級載入曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；將切線與割線混用會誤判劣化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mixing tangent and secant stiffness misidentifies degradation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：將切線與割線混用會誤判劣化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing tangent and secant stiffness misidentifies degradation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Modulus spatial variation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 變異指標須附測點間距及載重條件。本模型把 umax 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.94 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。最大、最小及平均模數使用同一載重與測點集合；不是標準差。使用空間模數圖作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模數空間變異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Variation indices require spacing and loading conditions. In this model, umax is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.94 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Maximum, minimum and mean moduli use one load and point set; this is not a standard deviation. Use spatial modulus map as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Modulus spatial variation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 模數空間變異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Modulus spatial variation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模數空間變異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Modulus spatial variation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以空間模數圖區分模型與觀察，先用等間距模數剖面、原始力位移及分段統計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「模數空間變異」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use spatial modulus map to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using equally spaced modulus profile, raw force-displacement and segment statistics, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Modulus spatial variation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「模數空間變異」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出最大、最小及平均模數使用同一載重與測點集合；不是標準差如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部造成偏離的合成觀察，以空間模數圖說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Modulus spatial variation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Maximum, minimum and mean moduli use one load and point set; this is not a standard deviation. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support. Explain which evidence in spatial modulus map distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模數空間變異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 模數空間變異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Modulus spatial variation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模數空間變異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Modulus spatial variation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部。這個失效與「模數空間變異」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查空間模數圖，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support. This failure and a measurement bias in Modulus spatial variation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check spatial modulus map rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用空間模數圖作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部。這個失效與「模數空間變異」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查空間模數圖，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模數空間變異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Modulus spatial variation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing.

title: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析
summary: 列車—軌道耦合振動分析以「車軌接觸模態耦合取樣與穩定性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。車輛與軌道透過輪軌接觸互相交換作用力，車體舒適與輪軌力峰值不是同一輸出，模型必須分清質量層次與接觸條件。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops vehicle-track contact modal coupling sampling and stability through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Vehicle and track exchange forces through wheel contact; carbody comfort and peak contact force are different outputs, and the model must distinguish mass levels and contact conditions. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=4.7213 Hz。模型邊界：單質量線性彈簧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg；y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg。只把 m1 增加百分之十，y=1064.52 kg。模型邊界：兩個自由質量間相對運動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.7213 Hz. Boundary: Single mass and linear spring; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m1=1500 kg, m2=3000 kg; y=m1*m2/(m1+m2)=1000 kg. Increasing only m1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=1064.52 kg. Boundary: Relative motion between two free masses; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 單質量固有頻率與輪軌約化質量
stages.titleEn: Single-mass natural frequency & Wheel-track reduced mass
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單質量固有頻率」與「輪軌約化質量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Single-mass natural frequency" and "Wheel-track reduced mass": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單質量固有頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Single-mass natural frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單質量固有頻率」如何影響列車—軌道耦合振動分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-mass natural frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 質量層次選擇決定模態的物理意義。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.7213 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單質量線性彈簧。使用自由衰減頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單質量固有頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Chosen mass level determines the physical meaning of the mode. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.7213 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Single mass and linear spring. Use free-decay frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Single-mass natural frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=1200000 N/m, m=1500 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=4.50158 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單質量固有頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Single-mass natural frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單質量固有頻率
knowledge.text: 質量層次選擇決定模態的物理意義。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.7213 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Chosen mass level determines the physical meaning of the mode. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單質量固有頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-mass natural frequency" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度
質量層次選擇決定模態的物理意義。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接使用總質量會低估相對模態頻率
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale.
Chosen mass level determines the physical meaning of the mode.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using total mass understates the relative-mode frequency.
quiz.explanation: 質量層次選擇決定模態的物理意義。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Chosen mass level determines the physical meaning of the mode. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單質量固有頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-mass natural frequency: quantitative estimate

steps.title: 速度波長激振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-wavelength excitation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度波長激振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-wavelength excitation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以速度掃描與頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成幾何輸入與加速度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「速度波長激振」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed sweep and spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic geometry input and acceleration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Speed-wavelength excitation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「速度波長激振」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等速通過正弦不平順如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由單一速度測試會漏掉共振區造成偏離的合成觀察，以速度掃描與頻譜說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Speed-wavelength excitation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Constant-speed sinusoidal irregularity passage. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One test speed can miss resonance. Explain which evidence in speed sweep and spectrum distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一速度測試會漏掉共振區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One test speed can miss resonance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 速度波長激振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed-wavelength excitation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「速度波長激振」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed-wavelength excitation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一速度測試會漏掉共振區。這個失效與「速度波長激振」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查速度掃描與頻譜，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One test speed can miss resonance. This failure and a measurement bias in Speed-wavelength excitation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed sweep and spectrum rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用速度掃描與頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一速度測試會漏掉共振區，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One test speed can miss resonance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一速度測試會漏掉共振區」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One test speed can miss resonance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 阻尼對衰減影響與積分時間步長
stages.titleEn: Damping decay scale & Integration time-step scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「阻尼對衰減影響」與「積分時間步長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Damping decay scale" and "Integration time-step scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 阻尼對衰減影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Damping decay scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「阻尼對衰減影響」如何影響列車—軌道耦合振動分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damping decay scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 欠阻尼包絡隨阻尼比與固有頻率衰減。本模型把 zeta 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.177661 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線性欠阻尼自由振動。使用多週期峰值包絡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；受迫振動不可直接當自由衰減，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「阻尼對衰減影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underdamped envelope decays with damping ratio and natural frequency. In this model, zeta is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 0.177661 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Linear underdamped free vibration. Use multi-cycle peak envelope as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Forced response cannot be treated as free decay; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Damping decay scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：zeta=0.05 1, fn=5 Hz, t=1 s；y=exp(-zeta*2*pi*fn*t)=0.20788 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: zeta=0.05 1, fn=5 Hz, t=1 s; y=exp(-zeta*2*pi*fn*t)=0.20788 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：受迫振動不可直接當自由衰減」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Forced response cannot be treated as free decay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「阻尼對衰減影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Damping decay scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 阻尼對衰減影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damping decay scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻尼對衰減影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damping decay scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：zeta=0.05 1, fn=5 Hz, t=1 s；y=exp(-zeta*2*pi*fn*t)=0.20788 1。只把 zeta 增加百分之十，y=0.177661 1。模型邊界：線性欠阻尼自由振動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: zeta=0.05 1, fn=5 Hz, t=1 s; y=exp(-zeta*2*pi*fn*t)=0.20788 1. Increasing only zeta with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.177661 1. Boundary: Linear underdamped free vibration; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以多週期峰值包絡區分模型與觀察，先用停止激振後峰值紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use multi-cycle peak envelope to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「積分時間步長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Integration time-step scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以時間步收斂結果區分模型與觀察，先用半步長重算及能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「積分時間步長」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use time-step convergence results to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using half-step rerun and energy balance, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Integration time-step scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「積分時間步長」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出指定最高解析頻率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定造成偏離的合成觀察，以時間步收斂結果說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Integration time-step scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Specified highest resolved frequency. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Sampling adequacy does not prove numerical integration stability. Explain which evidence in time-step convergence results distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling adequacy does not prove numerical integration stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 積分時間步長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integration time-step scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「積分時間步長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Integration time-step scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定。這個失效與「積分時間步長」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查時間步收斂結果，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling adequacy does not prove numerical integration stability. This failure and a measurement bias in Integration time-step scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check time-step convergence results rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用時間步收斂結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sampling adequacy does not prove numerical integration stability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Sampling adequacy does not prove numerical integration stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「積分時間步長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Integration time-step scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸
optionsEn: Sampling adequacy does not prove numerical integration stability.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can hide momentary contact loss.
quiz.explanation: 只滿足取樣條件不保證數值積分穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 接觸卸載比例與隔振位移傳遞率
stages.titleEn: Contact unloading fraction & Displacement transmissibility
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接觸卸載比例」與「隔振位移傳遞率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact unloading fraction" and "Displacement transmissibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接觸卸載比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact unloading fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸卸載比例」如何影響列車—軌道耦合振動分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact unloading fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 卸載比例需保留最小輪重而非只看平均。本模型把 Q0 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.772727 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。正接觸力區間的比值。使用最小與平均接觸力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸卸載比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unloading requires minimum wheel load, not only its mean. In this model, Q0 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.772727 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ratio within positive contact-force range. Use minimum and mean contact force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A normal mean can hide momentary contact loss; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact unloading fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Q0=80 kN, Qmin=20 kN；y=(Q0-Qmin)/Q0=0.75 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: Q0=80 kN, Qmin=20 kN; y=(Q0-Qmin)/Q0=0.75 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can hide momentary contact loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接觸卸載比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contact unloading fraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接觸卸載比例
knowledge.text: 卸載比例需保留最小輪重而非只看平均。本模型把 Q0 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.772727 1。
knowledge.textEn: Unloading requires minimum wheel load, not only its mean. In this model, Q0 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can hide momentary contact loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接觸卸載比例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Contact unloading fraction" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸
卸載比例需保留最小輪重而非只看平均。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：位移隔振不等於所有接觸力都降低
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can hide momentary contact loss.
Unloading requires minimum wheel load, not only its mean.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Displacement isolation does not reduce every contact force.
quiz.explanation: 卸載比例需保留最小輪重而非只看平均。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Unloading requires minimum wheel load, not only its mean. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接觸卸載比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contact unloading fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸卸載比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact unloading fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Q0=80 kN, Qmin=20 kN；y=(Q0-Qmin)/Q0=0.75 1。只把 Q0 增加百分之十，y=0.772727 1。模型邊界：正接觸力區間的比值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: Q0=80 kN, Qmin=20 kN; y=(Q0-Qmin)/Q0=0.75 1. Increasing only Q0 with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.772727 1. Boundary: Ratio within positive contact-force range; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以最小與平均接觸力區分模型與觀察，先用合成接觸力時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use minimum and mean contact force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Q0=80 kN, Qmin=20 kN；y=(Q0-Qmin)/Q0=0.75 1。只把 Q0 增加百分之十，y=0.772727 1。模型邊界：正接觸力區間的比值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Ratio within positive contact-force range; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
