steps.instruction: 基礎激振位移傳遞與頻率比及阻尼有關。本模型把 r 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.307513 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單自由度穩態基礎激振。使用基礎與質量位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；位移隔振不等於所有接觸力都降低，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隔振位移傳遞率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Displacement transmissibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位移隔振不等於所有接觸力都降低。這個失效與「隔振位移傳遞率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查基礎與質量位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Displacement isolation does not reduce every contact force. This failure and a measurement bias in Displacement transmissibility can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check base and mass displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用基礎與質量位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；位移隔振不等於所有接觸力都降低，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Displacement isolation does not reduce every contact force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：位移隔振不等於所有接觸力都降低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Displacement isolation does not reduce every contact force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 模型能量殘差與輸出頻譜解析度
stages.titleEn: Model energy residual & Output spectral resolution
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模型能量殘差」與「輸出頻譜解析度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Model energy residual" and "Output spectral resolution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模型能量殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Model energy residual: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模型能量殘差」如何影響列車—軌道耦合振動分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Model energy residual” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Coupled vehicle–track vibration analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量殘差可暴露數值或漏項問題。本模型把 input 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 17 J。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。相同時窗與系統邊界。使用全時段輸入儲存耗散帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；邊界作功漏列會產生假能量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模型能量殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy residual can expose numerical errors or omitted terms. In this model, input is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 17 J. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Same time window and system boundary. Use full-window input, storage and dissipation accounts as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitted boundary work creates apparent energy imbalance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Model energy residual” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：input=120 J, stored=40 J, lost=75 J；y=input-stored-lost=5 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: input=120 J, stored=40 J, lost=75 J; y=input-stored-lost=5 J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：邊界作功漏列會產生假能量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitted boundary work creates apparent energy imbalance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模型能量殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：input=120 J, stored=40 J, lost=75 J；y=input-stored-lost=5 J。只把 input 增加百分之十，y=17 J。模型邊界：相同時窗與系統邊界；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: input=120 J, stored=40 J, lost=75 J; y=input-stored-lost=5 J. Increasing only input with a ten-percent increase gives y=17 J. Boundary: Same time window and system boundary; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以原始時窗與頻譜格點區分模型與觀察，先用保留原始時間紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「輸出頻譜解析度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use original window and spectral bins to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using retained original time record, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Output spectral resolution. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「輸出頻譜解析度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出矩形觀察窗基本格距如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰造成偏離的合成觀察，以原始時窗與頻譜格點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Output spectral resolution, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Basic spacing for a finite observation window. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Short records can merge neighboring modes. Explain which evidence in original window and spectral bins distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸出頻譜解析度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Output spectral resolution"?
options: 本單元以原始時窗與頻譜格點區分模型與觀察，先用保留原始時間紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均正常可能掩蓋短時失去接觸
optionsEn: Use original window and spectral bins to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can hide momentary contact loss.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以原始時窗與頻譜格點區分模型與觀察，先用保留原始時間紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use original window and spectral bins to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸出頻譜解析度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Output spectral resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸出頻譜解析度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Output spectral resolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰。這個失效與「輸出頻譜解析度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始時窗與頻譜格點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short records can merge neighboring modes. This failure and a measurement bias in Output spectral resolution can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check original window and spectral bins rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用原始時窗與頻譜格點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short records can merge neighboring modes; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Short records can merge neighboring modes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰。這個失效與「輸出頻譜解析度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始時窗與頻譜格點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Short records can merge neighboring modes. This failure and a measurement bias in Output spectral resolution can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check original window and spectral bins rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸出頻譜解析度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Output spectral resolution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把車體質量代入輪對模態會錯配尺度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Short records can merge neighboring modes.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using carbody mass for a wheelset mode mismatches scale.
quiz.explanation: 短紀錄可能把鄰近模態混成一峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Short records can merge neighboring modes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鐵路橋軌相互作用分析
summary: 鐵路橋軌相互作用分析以「橋梁溫伸制動位移與鋼軌約束」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。橋梁與連續鋼軌透過扣件和支承交換縱向作用，橋梁溫度、制動以及支承布置會改變鋼軌附加力，不能把橋與軌各自分析後忽略相容。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops bridge thermal movement braking displacement and rail restraint through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Bridges and continuous rails exchange longitudinal action through fastenings and supports; temperature, braking and bearing layout alter rail force, so separate analyses cannot omit compatibility. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=26.4 mm。模型邊界：均溫自由伸縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：bridge=20 mm, rail=5 mm；y=bridge-rail=15 mm。只把 bridge 增加百分之十，y=17 mm。模型邊界：同方向共同基準；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 mm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature free expansion; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: bridge=20 mm, rail=5 mm; y=bridge-rail=15 mm. Increasing only bridge with a ten-percent increase gives y=17 mm. Boundary: Shared datum and direction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 橋梁自由熱伸長與橋軌相對位移
stages.titleEn: Bridge free thermal movement & Relative rail-bridge movement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋梁自由熱伸長」與「橋軌相對位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge free thermal movement" and "Relative rail-bridge movement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋梁自由熱伸長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge free thermal movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋梁自由熱伸長」如何影響鐵路橋軌相互作用分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge free thermal movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail–bridge interaction analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由端位移受有效伸縮長度而非總橋長控制。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均溫自由伸縮。使用固定支承位置與端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；固定點判錯會錯估位移方向，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋梁自由熱伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Free-end movement depends on effective expansion length rather than total bridge length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform-temperature free expansion. Use fixed-bearing location and endpoint movement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge free thermal movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：固定點判錯會錯估位移方向」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋梁自由熱伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge free thermal movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋梁自由熱伸長
knowledge.text: 自由端位移受有效伸縮長度而非總橋長控制。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Free-end movement depends on effective expansion length rather than total bridge length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：固定點判錯會錯估位移方向 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋梁自由熱伸長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bridge free thermal movement" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：固定點判錯會錯估位移方向
自由端位移受有效伸縮長度而非總橋長控制。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測基準不同會產生假相對位移
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction.
Free-end movement depends on effective expansion length rather than total bridge length.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different datums create false relative movement.
quiz.explanation: 自由端位移受有效伸縮長度而非總橋長控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Free-end movement depends on effective expansion length rather than total bridge length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋梁自由熱伸長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge free thermal movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁自由熱伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge free thermal movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=26.4 mm。模型邊界：均溫自由伸縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 mm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature free expansion; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以固定支承位置與端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用梁溫計與端部位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use fixed-bearing location and endpoint movement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=26.4 mm。模型邊界：均溫自由伸縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 mm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature free expansion; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「橋梁自由熱伸長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bridge free thermal movement", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：均布假設可能漏掉局部峰值
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接相加互斥工況會產生不實組合
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。

steps.instruction: 扣件受的是橋軌相對位移而非橋梁絕對位移。本模型把 bridge 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 17 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同方向共同基準。使用同位置橋軌雙位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測基準不同會產生假相對位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋軌相對位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 橋軌相對位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative rail-bridge movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋軌相對位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative rail-bridge movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測基準不同會產生假相對位移。這個失效與「橋軌相對位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同位置橋軌雙位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different datums create false relative movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Relative rail-bridge movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check paired bridge and rail movement at one location rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用同位置橋軌雙位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測基準不同會產生假相對位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Different datums create false relative movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測基準不同會產生假相對位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different datums create false relative movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 縱向彈性分力與制動平均分布
stages.titleEn: Longitudinal elastic force & Mean braking distribution
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱向彈性分力」與「制動平均分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Longitudinal elastic force" and "Mean braking distribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱向彈性分力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal elastic force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「縱向彈性分力」如何影響鐵路橋軌相互作用分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longitudinal elastic force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail–bridge interaction analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 線性區相對位移經扣件剛度轉成縱向力。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 49.5 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單扣件預滑移區。使用相對位移與扣件力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；滑移後不能延用線性剛度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「縱向彈性分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Within the linear range, relative movement becomes force through fastening stiffness. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 49.5 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One fastening before slip. Use relative movement and fastening force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Linear stiffness cannot be extended beyond slip; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Longitudinal elastic force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=15 kN/mm, d=3 mm；y=k*d=45 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=15 kN/mm, d=3 mm; y=k*d=45 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：滑移後不能延用線性剛度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear stiffness cannot be extended beyond slip." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「縱向彈性分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Longitudinal elastic force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縱向彈性分力
knowledge.text: 線性區相對位移經扣件剛度轉成縱向力。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 49.5 kN。
knowledge.textEn: Within the linear range, relative movement becomes force through fastening stiffness. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：滑移後不能延用線性剛度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 縱向彈性分力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縱向彈性分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Longitudinal elastic force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=15 kN/mm, d=3 mm；y=k*d=45 kN。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=49.5 kN。模型邊界：單扣件預滑移區；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=15 kN/mm, d=3 mm; y=k*d=45 kN. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=49.5 kN. Boundary: One fastening before slip; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 支承縱向位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bearing displacement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支承縱向位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Longitudinal bearing displacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承卡死會重新分配橋軌作用。這個失效與「支承縱向位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查支承力位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized bearing redistributes bridge-rail action. This failure and a measurement bias in Longitudinal bearing displacement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check bearing force-displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用支承力位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承卡死會重新分配橋軌作用，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A seized bearing redistributes bridge-rail action; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承卡死會重新分配橋軌作用」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A seized bearing redistributes bridge-rail action." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鋼軌附加應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Additional rail stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼軌附加應力」如何影響鐵路橋軌相互作用分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Additional rail stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail–bridge interaction analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 附加軸力需與既有熱應力依相容模型組合。本模型把 N 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 28.9474 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻軸應力。使用鋼軌應變與溫度補償作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直接相加互斥工況會產生不實組合，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼軌附加應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Additional axial force must be combined with existing thermal stress consistently. In this model, N is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 28.9474 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform axial stress. Use rail strain with temperature compensation as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Adding mutually exclusive cases creates an unreal combination; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Additional rail stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：N=200 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=N*1000/A=26.3158 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: N=200 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=N*1000/A=26.3158 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接相加互斥工況會產生不實組合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Adding mutually exclusive cases creates an unreal combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼軌附加應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 鋼軌附加應力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼軌附加應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Additional rail stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：N=200 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=N*1000/A=26.3158 MPa。只把 N 增加百分之十，y=28.9474 MPa。模型邊界：均勻軸應力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: N=200 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=N*1000/A=26.3158 MPa. Increasing only N with a ten-percent increase gives y=28.9474 MPa. Boundary: Uniform axial stress; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以鋼軌應變與溫度補償區分模型與觀察，先用溫補應變計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use rail strain with temperature compensation to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 直接相加互斥工況會產生不實組合。這個失效與「鋼軌附加應力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查鋼軌應變與溫度補償，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding mutually exclusive cases creates an unreal combination. This failure and a measurement bias in Additional rail stress can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail strain with temperature compensation rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用鋼軌應變與溫度補償作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直接相加互斥工況會產生不實組合，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding mutually exclusive cases creates an unreal combination; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：直接相加互斥工況會產生不實組合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Adding mutually exclusive cases creates an unreal combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 橋端轉角位移與伸縮裝置餘量
stages.titleEn: Bridge-end rotation movement & Expansion-device reserve
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋端轉角位移」與「伸縮裝置餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bridge-end rotation movement" and "Expansion-device reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋端轉角位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge-end rotation movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「橋端轉角位移」如何影響鐵路橋軌相互作用分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge-end rotation movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail–bridge interaction analysis”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 梁端轉角透過高度差產生附加縱向位移。本模型把 theta 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.65 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小轉角剛體投影。使用梁端轉角與軌面高度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略梁高會漏掉轉角誘發位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「橋端轉角位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: End rotation creates longitudinal movement through vertical offset. In this model, theta is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.65 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Small-angle rigid-body projection. Use end rotation and rail-level offset as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring girder depth misses rotation-induced movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bridge-end rotation movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：theta=0.001 rad, h=1.5 m；y=theta*h*1000=1.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: theta=0.001 rad, h=1.5 m; y=theta*h*1000=1.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略梁高會漏掉轉角誘發位移」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring girder depth misses rotation-induced movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「橋端轉角位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bridge-end rotation movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: End rotation creates longitudinal movement through vertical offset. In this model, theta is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

End rotation creates longitudinal movement through vertical offset.

steps.title: 橋端轉角位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge-end rotation movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋端轉角位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge-end rotation movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：theta=0.001 rad, h=1.5 m；y=theta*h*1000=1.5 mm。只把 theta 增加百分之十，y=1.65 mm。模型邊界：小轉角剛體投影；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: theta=0.001 rad, h=1.5 m; y=theta*h*1000=1.5 mm. Increasing only theta with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.65 mm. Boundary: Small-angle rigid-body projection; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以梁端轉角與軌面高度區分模型與觀察，先用傾角計與位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use end rotation and rail-level offset to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bridge-end rotation movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以梁端轉角與軌面高度區分模型與觀察，先用傾角計與位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「橋端轉角位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use end rotation and rail-level offset to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using inclinometer and displacement gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Bridge-end rotation movement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring girder depth misses rotation-induced movement. Explain which evidence in end rotation and rail-level offset distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略梁高會漏掉轉角誘發位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction.
quiz.explanation: 單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。 需以量測區分可能原因。

title: 軌旁落石與異物偵測
summary: 軌旁落石與異物偵測以「異物偵測覆蓋延遲與誤報漏報」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌旁異物偵測要把感測範圍、事件判定與列車防護動作連接，警報延遲和漏檢比漂亮影像更重要，正常訊號不能直接視為安全許可。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops obstruction coverage latency false alarms and missed events through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Trackside obstruction detection connects sensing coverage, event decisions and train protection; latency and missed events matter more than attractive images, and a normal signal is not automatically movement permission. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.11783 s。模型邊界：無初速無阻力垂落；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s；y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s。只把 sense 增加百分之十，y=0.36 s。模型邊界：順序處理無重疊；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.11783 s. Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s; y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s. Increasing only sense with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.36 s. Boundary: Sequential processing without overlap; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 落體到達時間與警報總延遲
stages.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time & Total alarm latency
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「落體到達時間」與「警報總延遲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Falling-object arrival time" and "Total alarm latency": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 落體到達時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落體到達時間」如何影響軌旁落石與異物偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Falling-object arrival time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想自由落體時間只是事件時間尺度。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.11783 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。無初速無阻力垂落。使用合成物體軌跡作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落體到達時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal free-fall time is only an event timescale. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.11783 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Vertical fall without initial speed or drag. Use synthetic object trajectory as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Falling-object arrival time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「落體到達時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Falling-object arrival time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Ideal free-fall time is only an event timescale. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Ideal free-fall time is only an event timescale.

steps.title: 落體到達時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落體到達時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Falling-object arrival time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2；y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.11783 s。模型邊界：無初速無阻力垂落；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=20 m, g=9.81 m/s2; y=sqrt(2*h/g)=2.01928 s. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.11783 s. Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以合成物體軌跡區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速影格與時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synthetic object trajectory to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.title: 落體到達時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Falling-object arrival time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「落體到達時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Falling-object arrival time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以合成物體軌跡區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速影格與時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「落體到達時間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synthetic object trajectory to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic high-speed frames and clock, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Falling-object arrival time. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「落體到達時間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出無初速無阻力垂落如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以合成物體軌跡說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Falling-object arrival time, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Vertical fall without initial speed or drag. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. Explain which evidence in synthetic object trajectory distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 碰撞反彈與坡面滑動改變到達時間。這個失效與「落體到達時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查合成物體軌跡，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time. This failure and a measurement bias in Falling-object arrival time can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synthetic object trajectory rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bounces and slope sliding alter arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: sense=0.1 s, comm=0.2 s, logic=0.05 s; y=sense+comm+logic=0.35 s. knowledge.textEn: Ignoring delay overstates protection distance. This failure and a measurement bias in Train travel during latency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check train speed and alarm time rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 辨識召回率：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=45 count, FN=5 count；y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent。只把 TP 增加一個整數單位，y=90.1961 percent。模型邊界：具代表性的替代計數資料集，擾動時總樣本數可變；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=45 count, FN=5 count; y=TP/(TP+FN)*100=90 percent. Increasing only TP with an increase of one whole unit gives y=90.1961 percent. Boundary: Representative alternative count datasets whose total may change under perturbation; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以盲測真值集區分模型與觀察，先用人工標註與事件配對建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use blinded ground-truth set to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Detection recall estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以盲測真值集區分模型與觀察，先用人工標註與事件配對建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「辨識召回率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use blinded ground-truth set to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Detection recall estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：只收集警報影片無法估漏檢。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.title: 警報精確率與稀有事件基率
stages.titleEn: Alarm precision estimate & Rare-event predictive value
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警報精確率」與「稀有事件基率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alarm precision estimate" and "Rare-event predictive value": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警報精確率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alarm precision estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警報精確率」如何影響軌旁落石與異物偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alarm precision estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 精確率描述警報中真事件比例。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 75.4098 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變。使用全部警報與複核結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高召回可伴隨過多誤報，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警報精確率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Precision describes the true-event fraction among alarms. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 75.4098 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Alternative count datasets with a fixed event definition and variable alarm totals. Use all alarms and review outcomes as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alarm precision estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=45 count, FP=15 count；y=TP/(TP+FP)*100=75 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=45 count, FP=15 count; y=TP/(TP+FP)*100=75 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高召回可伴隨過多誤報」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警報精確率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alarm precision estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 警報精確率
knowledge.text: 精確率描述警報中真事件比例。本模型把 TP 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 75.4098 percent。
knowledge.textEn: Precision describes the true-event fraction among alarms. In this model, TP is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高召回可伴隨過多誤報 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「警報精確率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alarm precision estimate" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高召回可伴隨過多誤報
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只報正確率會掩蓋低警報可信度
精確率描述警報中真事件比例。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Accuracy alone hides low alarm credibility.
Precision describes the true-event fraction among alarms.
quiz.explanation: 精確率描述警報中真事件比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Precision describes the true-event fraction among alarms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 警報精確率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alarm precision estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「警報精確率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alarm precision estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=45 count, FP=15 count；y=TP/(TP+FP)*100=75 percent。只把 TP 增加一個整數單位，y=75.4098 percent。模型邊界：固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: TP=45 count, FP=15 count; y=TP/(TP+FP)*100=75 percent. Increasing only TP with an increase of one whole unit gives y=75.4098 percent. Boundary: Alternative count datasets with a fixed event definition and variable alarm totals; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以全部警報與複核結果區分模型與觀察，先用盲測複核表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use all alarms and review outcomes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：TP=45 count, FP=15 count；y=TP/(TP+FP)*100=75 percent。只把 TP 增加一個整數單位，y=75.4098 percent。模型邊界：固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Increasing only TP with an increase of one whole unit gives y=75.4098 percent. Boundary: Alternative count datasets with a fixed event definition and variable alarm totals; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alarm precision estimate", which statement holds?

steps.title: 警報精確率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alarm precision estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「警報精確率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alarm precision estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以全部警報與複核結果區分模型與觀察，先用盲測複核表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「警報精確率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use all alarms and review outcomes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using blinded adjudication table, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Alarm precision estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「警報精確率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定事件定義的替代計數資料集，擾動時警報總數可變如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由高召回可伴隨過多誤報造成偏離的合成觀察，以全部警報與複核結果說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Alarm precision estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Alternative count datasets with a fixed event definition and variable alarm totals. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. Explain which evidence in all alarms and review outcomes distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高召回可伴隨過多誤報。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以全部警報與複核結果區分模型與觀察，先用盲測複核表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「警報精確率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Establish a baseline using blinded adjudication table, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Alarm precision estimate. quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alarm precision estimate"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

quiz.explanationEn: Use all alarms and review outcomes to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 警報精確率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alarm precision estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「警報精確率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alarm precision estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高召回可伴隨過多誤報。這個失效與「警報精確率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查全部警報與複核結果，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. This failure and a measurement bias in Alarm precision estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check all alarms and review outcomes rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用全部警報與複核結果作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高召回可伴隨過多誤報，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高召回可伴隨過多誤報」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高召回可伴隨過多誤報。這個失效與「警報精確率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查全部警報與複核結果，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. This failure and a measurement bias in Alarm precision estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check all alarms and review outcomes rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「警報精確率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alarm precision estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

高召回可伴隨過多誤報。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Accuracy alone hides low alarm credibility.
High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms.
quiz.explanation: 高召回可伴隨過多誤報。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High recall can coexist with excessive false alarms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 定期心跳超時：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heartbeat timeout scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定期心跳超時」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heartbeat timeout scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：period=2 s, missed=3 count；y=period*missed=6 s。只把 period 增加百分之十，y=6.6 s。模型邊界：固定週期且無額外抖動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: period=2 s, missed=3 count; y=period*missed=6 s. Increasing only period with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.6 s. Boundary: Fixed period without additional jitter; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以心跳序號與接收時刻區分模型與觀察，先用通訊故障注入建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use heartbeat sequence and arrival time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 定期心跳超時：試驗與驗證
