steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heartbeat timeout scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以心跳序號與接收時刻區分模型與觀察，先用通訊故障注入建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「定期心跳超時」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use heartbeat sequence and arrival time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using communication fault injection, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heartbeat timeout scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「定期心跳超時」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定週期且無額外抖動如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由斷線被當正常會形成靜默失效造成偏離的合成觀察，以心跳序號與接收時刻說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Heartbeat timeout scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed period without additional jitter. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating disconnection as normal creates silent failure. Explain which evidence in heartbeat sequence and arrival time distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斷線被當正常會形成靜默失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating disconnection as normal creates silent failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 定期心跳超時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Heartbeat timeout scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定期心跳超時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Heartbeat timeout scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斷線被當正常會形成靜默失效。這個失效與「定期心跳超時」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查心跳序號與接收時刻，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating disconnection as normal creates silent failure. This failure and a measurement bias in Heartbeat timeout scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check heartbeat sequence and arrival time rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用心跳序號與接收時刻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；斷線被當正常會形成靜默失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating disconnection as normal creates silent failure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：斷線被當正常會形成靜默失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating disconnection as normal creates silent failure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 測試誤報頻率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「測試誤報頻率」如何影響軌旁落石與異物偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test false-alarm rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Trackside rockfall and obstruction detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每小時誤報率需附環境條件與測試時間。本模型把 false 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 0.025 alarms/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。指定測試環境平均。使用天候分層運行紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測試誤報頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: False alarms per hour require conditions and exposure duration. In this model, false is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 0.025 alarms/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mean in the specified test environment. Use weather-stratified operating records as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Test false-alarm rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：false=4 count, hours=200 h；y=false/hours=0.02 alarms/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: false=4 count, hours=200 h; y=false/hours=0.02 alarms/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測試誤報頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：false=4 count, hours=200 h；y=false/hours=0.02 alarms/h。只把 false 增加一個整數單位，y=0.025 alarms/h。模型邊界：指定測試環境平均；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: false=4 count, hours=200 h; y=false/hours=0.02 alarms/h. Increasing only false with an increase of one whole unit gives y=0.025 alarms/h. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test false-alarm rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以天候分層運行紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用事件與天候時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「測試誤報頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use weather-stratified operating records to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using event and weather time series, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Test false-alarm rate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「測試誤報頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出指定測試環境平均如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件造成偏離的合成觀察，以天候分層運行紀錄說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Test false-alarm rate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mean in the specified test environment. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog. Explain which evidence in weather-stratified operating records distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 測試誤報頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test false-alarm rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測試誤報頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test false-alarm rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件。這個失效與「測試誤報頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查天候分層運行紀錄，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog. This failure and a measurement bias in Test false-alarm rate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check weather-stratified operating records rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用天候分層運行紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：晴天測試不能代表雨霧條件」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Clear-weather tests do not represent rain and fog." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 架空電車線懸掛系統
summary: 架空電車線懸掛系統以「接觸線懸掛張力垂度與溫度補償」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。架空電車線同時是導電路徑與受拉結構，跨距、張力和支承彈性共同決定受流幾何，靜態高度並不能代表列車通過的動態接觸。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops contact-wire suspension tension sag and thermal compensation through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. An overhead contact line is both a conductor and a tension structure; span, tension and support flexibility determine current-collection geometry, while static height does not establish dynamic contact. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m。只把 w 增加百分之十，y=0.229167 m。模型邊界：均勻載重小垂度弦；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：T=15000 N, mu=1.35 kg/m；y=sqrt(T/mu)=105.409 m/s。只把 T 增加百分之十，y=110.554 m/s。模型邊界：均勻柔弦無彎曲剛度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: w=10 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N; y=w*L**2/(8*T)=0.208333 m. Increasing only w with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.229167 m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded small-sag string; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: T=15000 N, mu=1.35 kg/m; y=sqrt(T/mu)=105.409 m/s. Increasing only T with a ten-percent increase gives y=110.554 m/s. Boundary: Uniform flexible string without bending rigidity; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 跨中垂度近似與弦波傳播速度
stages.titleEn: Midspan sag approximation & String wave speed
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨中垂度近似」與「弦波傳播速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Midspan sag approximation" and "String wave speed": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨中垂度近似：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Midspan sag approximation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨中垂度近似」如何影響架空電車線懸掛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Midspan sag approximation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overhead contact-line suspension systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小垂度近似中跨距平方放大垂度。本模型把 w 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.229167 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻載重小垂度弦。使用張力與跨中高度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨中垂度近似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 本單元以電流均方與電阻區分模型與觀察，先用合成有效值電流記錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「導線焦耳損耗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conductor Joule loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 脈動電流用平均值會低估損耗。這個失效與「導線焦耳損耗」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查電流均方與電阻，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Average current understates loss under ripple. This failure and a measurement bias in Conductor Joule loss can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check mean-square current and resistance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用電流均方與電阻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；脈動電流用平均值會低估損耗，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Average current understates loss under ripple; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：脈動電流用平均值會低估損耗」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Average current understates loss under ripple." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「風載橫向位移」如何影響架空電車線懸掛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wind-load lateral displacement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overhead contact-line suspension systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小位移下橫風分布力使導線偏移。本模型把 q 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.183333 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。靜態均布橫載小位移。使用風速與橫向位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；陣風動態不可只用靜態偏移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風載橫向位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distributed crosswind force displaces the wire at small deflection. In this model, q is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.183333 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Static uniform lateral load at small displacement. Use wind speed and lateral position as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Gust dynamics cannot be reduced to static displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wind-load lateral displacement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：q=8 N/m, L=50 m, T=15000 N；y=q*L**2/(8*T)=0.166667 m。只把 q 增加百分之十，y=0.183333 m。模型邊界：靜態均布橫載小位移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「懸掛點彈性位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性單點支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移造成偏離的合成觀察，以支點力位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以支點力位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型彈簧與位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「懸掛點彈性位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use support force-displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model spring and displacement gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Suspension-point elastic movement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

steps.title: 懸掛點彈性位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Suspension-point elastic movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸掛點彈性位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Suspension-point elastic movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。這個失效與「懸掛點彈性位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查支點力位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Suspension-point elastic movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support force-displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用支點力位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。這個失效與「懸掛點彈性位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查支點力位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Suspension-point elastic movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support force-displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸掛點彈性位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Suspension-point elastic movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把支點視為完全固定會低估動態位移。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：張力下降會改變靜態接觸高度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Loss of tension changes static contact height.

quiz.explanationEn: Perfectly fixed supports can understate dynamic movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證
summary: 高速鐵路受流性能驗證以「接觸力離線受流率與測試不確定度」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。受電弓與電車線耦合時，平均接觸力、力的散布、離線與電弧必須分開量測，單一平均值無法描述短暫中斷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops contact force contact loss and test uncertainty through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Coupled pantograph and contact-line behavior requires separate measures of mean force, dispersion, loss of contact and arcing; a mean cannot describe brief interruptions. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=103.512 N。模型邊界：等權有限樣本均方根；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt((F1**2+F2**2+F3**2)/3)=101.325 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=103.512 N. Boundary: Equal-weight finite-sample RMS; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 平均接觸力與接觸力均方根
stages.titleEn: Mean contact force & Contact-force RMS
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平均接觸力」與「接觸力均方根」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean contact force" and "Contact-force RMS": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 平均接觸力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean contact force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平均接觸力」如何影響高速鐵路受流性能驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean contact force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 113 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。等時距三筆合成取樣。使用最小力與接觸影像作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；正常平均可同時含零接觸片段，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平均接觸力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 113 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Three equally spaced synthetic samples. Use minimum force and contact images as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean contact force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平均接觸力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean contact force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平均接觸力
knowledge.text: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 113 N。
knowledge.textEn: Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平均接觸力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean contact force" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段
平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals.
Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them.
quiz.explanation: 平均力描述時窗中央趨勢而不保證持續接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean force describes the central tendency of a window without guaranteeing continuous contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平均接觸力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean contact force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平均接觸力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean contact force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N；y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=113 N。模型邊界：等時距三筆合成取樣；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=90 N, F2=110 N, F3=130 N; y=(F1+F2+F3)/3=110 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=113 N. Boundary: Three equally spaced synthetic samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以最小力與接觸影像區分模型與觀察，先用低載力計與同步攝影建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use minimum force and contact images to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 接觸力均方根：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contact-force RMS” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以完整力時序與均值區分模型與觀察，先用離線力資料與校正表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接觸力均方根」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use complete force time history and mean to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using offline force data and calibration sheet, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Contact-force RMS. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「接觸力均方根」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出等權有限樣本均方根如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋造成偏離的合成觀察，以完整力時序與均值說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them. Explain which evidence in complete force time history and mean distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 接觸力均方根：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contact-force RMS: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸力均方根」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contact-force RMS” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋。這個失效與「接觸力均方根」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查完整力時序與均值，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them. This failure and a measurement bias in Contact-force RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check complete force time history and mean rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用完整力時序與均值作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：少數尖峰可提高均方根卻被平均掩蓋」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A few peaks raise RMS while a mean hides them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 力散布標準差與離線時間比例
stages.titleEn: Contact-force population deviation & Loss-of-contact duration fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「力散布標準差」與「離線時間比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact-force population deviation" and "Loss-of-contact duration fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 力散布標準差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact-force population deviation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「力散布標準差」如何影響高速鐵路受流性能驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact-force population deviation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 全體樣本標準差量化此時窗相對均值的散布。本模型把 F1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 13.1993 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三個等權樣本的全體標準差，式內平均隨擾動重算。使用時窗分段後散布作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混合不同速度時窗會把工況差當隨機散布，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「力散布標準差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Population deviation quantifies spread about the mean in this window. In this model, F1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 13.1993 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Population deviation of three equally weighted samples, with the mean recalculated inside the expression. Use spread in segmented windows as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing speed regimes confuses operating changes with random spread; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact-force population deviation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混合不同速度時窗會把工況差當隨機散布」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing speed regimes confuses operating changes with random spread." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「力散布標準差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contact-force population deviation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 力散布標準差

steps.title: 力散布標準差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contact-force population deviation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「力散布標準差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact-force population deviation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=13.1993 N。模型邊界：三個等權樣本的全體標準差，式內平均隨擾動重算；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.1993 N. Boundary: Population deviation of three equally weighted samples, with the mean recalculated inside the expression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以時窗分段後散布區分模型與觀察，先用合成時序分段統計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use spread in segmented windows to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N；y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N。只把 F1 增加百分之十，y=13.1993 N。模型邊界：三個等權樣本的全體標準差，式內平均隨擾動重算；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F1=80 N, F2=100 N, F3=120 N; y=sqrt(((F1-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F2-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2+(F3-(F1+F2+F3)/3)**2)/3)=16.3299 N. Increasing only F1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.1993 N. Boundary: Population deviation of three equally weighted samples, with the mean recalculated inside the expression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「力散布標準差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Loss-of-contact duration fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以離線起迄時間與事件數區分模型與觀察，先用接觸狀態重播與共同時鐘建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「離線時間比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use contact-loss start/end times and event count to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using contact-state replay and common clock, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Loss-of-contact duration fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「離線時間比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定辨識門檻的合成時窗如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由相同事件數可能有完全不同中斷時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以離線起迄時間與事件數說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Loss-of-contact duration fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Synthetic window with a fixed detection definition. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations. Explain which evidence in contact-loss start/end times and event count distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同事件數可能有完全不同中斷時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Loss-of-contact duration fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同事件數可能有完全不同中斷時間。這個失效與「離線時間比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查離線起迄時間與事件數，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations. This failure and a measurement bias in Loss-of-contact duration fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check contact-loss start/end times and event count rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同事件數可能有完全不同中斷時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal event counts can conceal very different interruption durations." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 電弧事件時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arc-event exposure fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電弧事件時間」如何影響高速鐵路受流性能驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arc-event exposure fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電弧時間需定義偵測頻寬與事件合併規則。本模型把 arc 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.044 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。僅用既有合成事件，不產生真實電弧。使用光學事件與電流同步作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；外界閃光可能造成假電弧事件，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電弧事件時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arc duration requires defined sensing bandwidth and event-merging rules. In this model, arc is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.044 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Use synthetic recorded events only, without creating real arcs. Use optical events synchronized with current as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. External flashes may create false arc detections; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arc-event exposure fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：arc=12 ms, test=30 s；y=arc/(test*1000)*100=0.04 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: arc=12 ms, test=30 s; y=arc/(test*1000)*100=0.04 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外界閃光可能造成假電弧事件」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: External flashes may create false arc detections." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：arc=12 ms, test=30 s；y=arc/(test*1000)*100=0.04 percent。只把 arc 增加百分之十，y=0.044 percent。模型邊界：僅用既有合成事件，不產生真實電弧；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: arc=12 ms, test=30 s; y=arc/(test*1000)*100=0.04 percent. Increasing only arc with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.044 percent. Boundary: Use synthetic recorded events only, without creating real arcs; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以光學事件與電流同步區分模型與觀察，先用合成光電訊號與時間戳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 弓頭慣性修正：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pantograph-head inertia correction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Current-collection verification for high-speed rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 加速度造成慣性項，感測器內力不一定直接等於接觸力。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 17.6 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。剛性弓頭的一維平動。使用加速度與力的共同相位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；質量或加速度正負號錯誤會加倍偏差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弓頭慣性修正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acceleration produces an inertia term, so measured internal force may differ from contact force. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 17.6 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One-dimensional rigid-head translation. Use common phase of acceleration and force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Wrong mass or acceleration sign can increase bias; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pantograph-head inertia correction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Combined force uncertainty. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「合成量測不確定度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出零共變異的一階近似如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度造成偏離的合成觀察，以各項校正與相關性說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Combined force uncertainty, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: First-order approximation with zero covariance. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty. Explain which evidence in calibration and correlation of each contribution distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合成量測不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Combined force uncertainty"?
options: 本單元以各項校正與相關性區分模型與觀察，先用校正證據與重複測試建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：質量或加速度正負號錯誤會加倍偏差
optionsEn: Use calibration and correlation of each contribution to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Wrong mass or acceleration sign can increase bias.

quiz.explanationEn: Use calibration and correlation of each contribution to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合成量測不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Combined force uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合成量測不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Combined force uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度。這個失效與「合成量測不確定度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各項校正與相關性，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty. This failure and a measurement bias in Combined force uncertainty can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check calibration and correlation of each contribution rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用各項校正與相關性作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度。這個失效與「合成量測不確定度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各項校正與相關性，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty. This failure and a measurement bias in Combined force uncertainty can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check calibration and correlation of each contribution rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合成量測不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Combined force uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：正常平均可同時含零接觸片段
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A normal mean can include zero-contact intervals.
quiz.explanation: 把共同偏差當獨立會低估力不確定度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating shared bias as independent understates uncertainty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 牽引變電所整合
summary: 牽引變電所整合以「牽引變壓整流負載與保護邊界」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。變電所整合需要分辨電壓層級、交流相量、直流回路與能量帳，額定設備容量不能直接代表供電區間可同時支援的列車數。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops traction transformation rectification load and protection boundaries through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Substation integration distinguishes voltage levels, AC phasors, DC circuits and energy balances; equipment ratings do not directly establish how many trains a feeding section supports. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1；y=primary/ratio=1000 V。只把 primary 增加百分之十，y=1100 V。模型邊界：理想單相變壓器幅值比；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A；y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA。只把 Vline 增加百分之十，y=10.4789 MVA。模型邊界：平衡三相正弦系統；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1; y=primary/ratio=1000 V. Increasing only primary with a ten-percent increase gives y=1100 V. Boundary: Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A; y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA. Increasing only Vline with a ten-percent increase gives y=10.4789 MVA. Boundary: Balanced sinusoidal three-phase system; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 變壓器電壓比與三相視在功率
stages.titleEn: Transformer voltage ratio & Three-phase apparent power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「變壓器電壓比」與「三相視在功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transformer voltage ratio" and "Three-phase apparent power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 變壓器電壓比：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transformer voltage ratio: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「變壓器電壓比」如何影響牽引變電所整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transformer voltage ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Traction-substation integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想匝數比改變電壓而近似保存功率。本模型把 primary 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1100 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想單相變壓器幅值比。使用次側空載電壓與匝比作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「變壓器電壓比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ideal turns ratio changes voltage while approximately conserving power. In this model, primary is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1100 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio. Use secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transformer voltage ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1；y=primary/ratio=1000 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1; y=primary/ratio=1000 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「變壓器電壓比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transformer voltage ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 變壓器電壓比
knowledge.text: 理想匝數比改變電壓而近似保存功率。本模型把 primary 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1100 V。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal turns ratio changes voltage while approximately conserving power. In this model, primary is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「變壓器電壓比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transformer voltage ratio" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比
理想匝數比改變電壓而近似保存功率。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio.
An ideal turns ratio changes voltage while approximately conserving power.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error.
quiz.explanation: 理想匝數比改變電壓而近似保存功率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ideal turns ratio changes voltage while approximately conserving power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 變壓器電壓比：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transformer voltage ratio: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「變壓器電壓比」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transformer voltage ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1；y=primary/ratio=1000 V。只把 primary 增加百分之十，y=1100 V。模型邊界：理想單相變壓器幅值比；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1; y=primary/ratio=1000 V. Increasing only primary with a ten-percent increase gives y=1100 V. Boundary: Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以次側空載電壓與匝比區分模型與觀察，先用隔離低壓縮比變壓器建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1；y=primary/ratio=1000 V。只把 primary 增加百分之十，y=1100 V。模型邊界：理想單相變壓器幅值比；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: primary=25000 V, ratio=25 1; y=primary/ratio=1000 V. Increasing only primary with a ten-percent increase gives y=1100 V. Boundary: Ideal single-phase transformer magnitude ratio; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「變壓器電壓比」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transformer voltage ratio", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：換相壓降與元件壓降使真值較低
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：輔助負載遺漏會高估整站效率

optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Commutation and device drops reduce the actual value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitted auxiliary loads overstate station efficiency.

steps.title: 變壓器電壓比：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transformer voltage ratio: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transformer voltage ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比。這個失效與「變壓器電壓比」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查次側空載電壓與匝比，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio. This failure and a measurement bias in Transformer voltage ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check secondary no-load voltage and turns ratio rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用次側空載電壓與匝比作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-phase apparent power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Traction-substation integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 線電壓與線電流的三相關係包含根號三。本模型把 Vline 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 10.4789 MVA。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。平衡三相正弦系統。使用三相電壓電流與平衡度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三相視在功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The three-phase relation between line voltage and line current includes square root of three. In this model, Vline is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 10.4789 MVA. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Balanced sinusoidal three-phase system. Use three-phase voltage, current and balance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Three-phase apparent power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vline=11000 V, Iline=500 A；y=sqrt(3)*Vline*Iline/1e6=9.52628 MVA。只把 Vline 增加百分之十，y=10.4789 MVA。模型邊界：平衡三相正弦系統；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instructionEn: Use three-phase voltage, current and balance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 三相視在功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three-phase apparent power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三相視在功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three-phase apparent power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差。這個失效與「三相視在功率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查三相電壓電流與平衡度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error. This failure and a measurement bias in Three-phase apparent power can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check three-phase voltage, current and balance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用三相電壓電流與平衡度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mixing phase and line voltage creates a scale error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
