stages.title: 實功率與功因與整流理想平均電壓
stages.titleEn: Real power and power factor & Ideal rectifier mean voltage
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「實功率與功因」與「整流理想平均電壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Real power and power factor" and "Ideal rectifier mean voltage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 實功率與功因：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Real power and power factor: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「實功率與功因」如何影響牽引變電所整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Real power and power factor” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Traction-substation integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 功率因數把視在功率分成可用實功部分。本模型把 S 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9.9 MW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已知總功率因數。使用有功無功與波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；畸變功因不能只用相位角描述，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「實功率與功因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power factor relates apparent power to real power. In this model, S is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 9.9 MW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Known total power factor. Use real/reactive power and waveforms as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Distortion power factor is not described by phase angle alone; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Real power and power factor” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1；y=S*pf=9 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1; y=S*pf=9 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：畸變功因不能只用相位角描述」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distortion power factor is not described by phase angle alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「實功率與功因」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Real power and power factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實功率與功因
knowledge.text: 功率因數把視在功率分成可用實功部分。本模型把 S 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 9.9 MW。
knowledge.textEn: Power factor relates apparent power to real power. In this model, S is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：畸變功因不能只用相位角描述 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distortion power factor is not described by phase angle alone. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Power factor relates apparent power to real power.

steps.title: 實功率與功因：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Real power and power factor: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實功率與功因」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Real power and power factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1；y=S*pf=9 MW。只把 S 增加百分之十，y=9.9 MW。模型邊界：已知總功率因數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1; y=S*pf=9 MW. Increasing only S with a ten-percent increase gives y=9.9 MW. Boundary: Known total power factor; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以有功無功與波形區分模型與觀察，先用合成功率分析儀輸出建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use real/reactive power and waveforms to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1；y=S*pf=9 MW。只把 S 增加百分之十，y=9.9 MW。模型邊界：已知總功率因數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: S=10 MVA, pf=0.9 1; y=S*pf=9 MW. Increasing only S with a ten-percent increase gives y=9.9 MW. Boundary: Known total power factor; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實功率與功因」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instructionEn: Distortion power factor is not described by phase angle alone. This failure and a measurement bias in Real power and power factor can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check real/reactive power and waveforms rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal rectifier mean voltage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Traction-substation integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 六脈波理想整流平均值取決於交流線電壓。本模型把 Vll 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 891.313 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。連續電流理想三相二極體橋。使用直流均值與交流線電壓作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；換相壓降與元件壓降使真值較低，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「整流理想平均電壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal six-pulse mean DC voltage depends on AC line voltage. In this model, Vll is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 891.313 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal three-phase diode bridge with continuous current. Use DC mean and AC line voltage as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Commutation and device drops reduce the actual value; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal rectifier mean voltage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「短路等效電流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equivalent short-circuit current” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流。這個失效與「短路等效電流」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查等效源阻抗與波形，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current. This failure and a measurement bias in Equivalent short-circuit current can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check equivalent source impedance and waveform rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用等效源阻抗與波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流。這個失效與「短路等效電流」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查等效源阻抗與波形，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current. This failure and a measurement bias in Equivalent short-circuit current can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check equivalent source impedance and waveform rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「短路等效電流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equivalent short-circuit current" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：鬆動接點會提高局部發熱
忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A loose joint raises local heating.
Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current.
quiz.explanation: 忽略源阻抗會得到不合理無限電流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting source impedance implies unphysical infinite current. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 母線熱損耗與備援容量算例
stages.titleEn: Busbar thermal loss & Redundant-capacity example
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「母線熱損耗」與「備援容量算例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Busbar thermal loss" and "Redundant-capacity example": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 母線熱損耗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Busbar thermal loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「母線熱損耗」如何影響牽引變電所整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Busbar thermal loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Traction-substation integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接點小電阻在大電流下仍產生明顯熱量。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 968 W。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定電阻的穩態電損。使用接點電阻與溫升作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；鬆動接點會提高局部發熱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「母線熱損耗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small joint resistance can generate substantial heat at high current. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 968 W. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Steady electrical loss at fixed resistance. Use joint resistance and temperature rise as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A loose joint raises local heating; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Busbar thermal loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=2000 A, R=0.0002 ohm；y=I**2*R=800 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=2000 A, R=0.0002 ohm; y=I**2*R=800 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：鬆動接點會提高局部發熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A loose joint raises local heating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「母線熱損耗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Busbar thermal loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 母線熱損耗
knowledge.text: 接點小電阻在大電流下仍產生明顯熱量。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 968 W。
knowledge.textEn: Small joint resistance can generate substantial heat at high current. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：鬆動接點會提高局部發熱 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A loose joint raises local heating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「母線熱損耗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Busbar thermal loss" is correct?

本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：鬆動接點會提高局部發熱
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電
optionsEn: Small joint resistance can generate substantial heat at high current.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A loose joint raises local heating.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load.
quiz.explanation: 接點小電阻在大電流下仍產生明顯熱量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 母線熱損耗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Busbar thermal loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「母線熱損耗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Busbar thermal loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=2000 A, R=0.0002 ohm；y=I**2*R=800 W。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=968 W。模型邊界：固定電阻的穩態電損；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=2000 A, R=0.0002 ohm; y=I**2*R=800 W. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=968 W. Boundary: Steady electrical loss at fixed resistance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以接點電阻與溫升區分模型與觀察，先用低壓四線模型與熱感測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use joint resistance and temperature rise to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=2000 A, R=0.0002 ohm；y=I**2*R=800 W。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=968 W。模型邊界：固定電阻的穩態電損；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=2000 A, R=0.0002 ohm; y=I**2*R=800 W. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=968 W. Boundary: Steady electrical loss at fixed resistance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「母線熱損耗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Busbar thermal loss", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：混用相電壓與線電壓造成比例誤差

steps.title: 母線熱損耗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Busbar thermal loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「母線熱損耗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Busbar thermal loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以接點電阻與溫升區分模型與觀察，先用低壓四線模型與熱感測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「母線熱損耗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use joint resistance and temperature rise to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage four-wire model and thermal sensing, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Busbar thermal loss. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「母線熱損耗」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定電阻的穩態電損如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由鬆動接點會提高局部發熱造成偏離的合成觀察，以接點電阻與溫升說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Busbar thermal loss, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Steady electrical loss at fixed resistance. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A loose joint raises local heating. Explain which evidence in joint resistance and temperature rise distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鬆動接點會提高局部發熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A loose joint raises local heating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以接點電阻與溫升區分模型與觀察，先用低壓四線模型與熱感測建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「母線熱損耗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use joint resistance and temperature rise to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage four-wire model and thermal sensing, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Busbar thermal loss. Cross-check joint resistance and temperature rise rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用接點電阻與溫升作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；鬆動接點會提高局部發熱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A loose joint raises local heating; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：鬆動接點會提高局部發熱」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A loose joint raises local heating." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 備援容量算例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Redundant-capacity example: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「備援容量算例」如何影響牽引變電所整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Redundant-capacity example” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Traction-substation integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一台不可用時的名義餘量仍須檢查網路供電路徑。本模型把 units 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 14 MVA。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。相同額定單元且可完全分攤。使用供電拓樸與剩餘容量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援容量算例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal reserve after one unavailable unit still requires a viable network path. In this model, units is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 14 MVA. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Equal-rated units with fully shareable loading. Use feeding topology and remaining capacity as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Redundant-capacity example” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: units=3 count, each=10 MVA, load=16 MVA; y=(units-1)*each-load=4 MVA.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 備援容量算例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Redundant-capacity example: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「備援容量算例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Redundant-capacity example” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：units=3 count, each=10 MVA, load=16 MVA；y=(units-1)*each-load=4 MVA。只把 units 增加一個整數單位，y=14 MVA。模型邊界：相同額定單元且可完全分攤；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: units=3 count, each=10 MVA, load=16 MVA; y=(units-1)*each-load=4 MVA. Increasing only units with an increase of one whole unit gives y=14 MVA. Boundary: Equal-rated units with fully shareable loading; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以供電拓樸與剩餘容量區分模型與觀察，先用離線單線圖與情境表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use feeding topology and remaining capacity to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電。這個失效與「備援容量算例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查供電拓樸與剩餘容量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load. This failure and a measurement bias in Redundant-capacity example can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check feeding topology and remaining capacity rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「備援容量算例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Redundant-capacity example" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：負載壓降使實測值偏離理想比
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Load voltage drop separates measured voltage from the ideal ratio.
quiz.explanation: 有容量但無連通路徑仍無法供電。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Capacity without connectivity cannot supply the load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 直流第三軌供電設計
summary: 直流第三軌供電設計以「第三軌壓降集電靴連續性與熱容量」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。第三軌供電將接觸幾何與低電壓大電流回路連在一起，供電中斷區、集電靴配置和回流路徑共同影響列車供能。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops third-rail voltage drop shoe continuity and thermal capacity through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Third-rail supply links contact geometry with a low-voltage high-current circuit; gaps, shoe arrangement and return paths jointly affect train power. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=1500 kW, V=750 V；y=P*1000/V=2000 A。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2200 A。模型邊界：理想定功率負載；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=0.00000003 ohm*m, L=1000 m, A=0.003 m2；y=rho*L/A=0.01 ohm。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=0.011 ohm。模型邊界：均溫等截面導軌；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=1500 kW, V=750 V; y=P*1000/V=2000 A. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2200 A. Boundary: Ideal constant-power load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=0.00000003 ohm*m, L=1000 m, A=0.003 m2; y=rho*L/A=0.01 ohm. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.011 ohm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature constant-area rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 牽引直流需求與第三軌電阻
stages.titleEn: Traction DC current demand & Third-rail resistance
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「牽引直流需求」與「第三軌電阻」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Traction DC current demand" and "Third-rail resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牽引直流需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction DC current demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引直流需求」如何影響直流第三軌供電設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction DC current demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “DC third-rail power-supply design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定功率負載在電壓下降時需要更大電流。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2200 A。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想定功率負載。使用端電壓與電流作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引直流需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A constant-power load requires more current as voltage falls. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2200 A. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal constant-power load. Use terminal voltage and current as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Traction DC current demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=1500 kW, V=750 V；y=P*1000/V=2000 A。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=1500 kW, V=750 V; y=P*1000/V=2000 A.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「牽引直流需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Traction DC current demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 牽引直流需求
knowledge.text: 定功率負載在電壓下降時需要更大電流。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2200 A。
knowledge.textEn: A constant-power load requires more current as voltage falls. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「牽引直流需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Traction DC current demand" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔
定功率負載在電壓下降時需要更大電流。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading.
A constant-power load requires more current as voltage falls.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Joint impedance can dominate a short section.
quiz.explanation: 定功率負載在電壓下降時需要更大電流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A constant-power load requires more current as voltage falls. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 牽引直流需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traction DC current demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引直流需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction DC current demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=1500 kW, V=750 V；y=P*1000/V=2000 A。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2200 A。模型邊界：理想定功率負載；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=1500 kW, V=750 V; y=P*1000/V=2000 A. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2200 A. Boundary: Ideal constant-power load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以端電壓與電流區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電子負載的合成資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use terminal voltage and current to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=1500 kW, V=750 V；y=P*1000/V=2000 A。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2200 A。模型邊界：理想定功率負載；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=1500 kW, V=750 V; y=P*1000/V=2000 A. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2200 A. Boundary: Ideal constant-power load; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「牽引直流需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Traction DC current demand", which statement holds?

steps.title: 牽引直流需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traction DC current demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牽引直流需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Traction DC current demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以端電壓與電流區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電子負載的合成資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「牽引直流需求」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use terminal voltage and current to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic data for a low-voltage electronic load, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Traction DC current demand. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「牽引直流需求」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出理想定功率負載如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔造成偏離的合成觀察，以端電壓與電流說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Traction DC current demand, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Ideal constant-power load. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading. Explain which evidence in terminal voltage and current distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把電流視為固定會低估低壓負擔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixed-current assumptions understate low-voltage loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「第三軌電阻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Third-rail resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降。這個失效與「第三軌電阻」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查四線電阻與溫度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joint impedance can dominate a short section. This failure and a measurement bias in Third-rail resistance can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check four-terminal resistance and temperature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用四線電阻與溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Joint impedance can dominate a short section; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接頭阻抗可能主導短段壓降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Joint impedance can dominate a short section." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check four-terminal resistance and temperature rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 供電區段電壓與雙端供電分流
stages.titleEn: Feeding-section voltage & Two-end feeding current split
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「供電區段電壓」與「雙端供電分流」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Feeding-section voltage" and "Two-end feeding current split": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 供電區段電壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Feeding-section voltage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「供電區段電壓」如何影響直流第三軌供電設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Feeding-section voltage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “DC third-rail power-supply design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 負載端電壓是源電壓扣除完整回路壓降。本模型把 Vs 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 785 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單負載直流穩態。使用源負載兩端及回流電位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略並聯列車會低估壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「供電區段電壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Load voltage equals source voltage minus complete-loop drop. In this model, Vs is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 785 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Single-load steady DC circuit. Use source/load voltages and return potential as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring parallel trains understates drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Feeding-section voltage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vs=750 V, I=2000 A, R=0.02 ohm；y=Vs-I*R=710 V。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: Vs=750 V, I=2000 A, R=0.02 ohm; y=Vs-I*R=710 V.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略並聯列車會低估壓降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring parallel trains understates drop." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「供電區段電壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Feeding-section voltage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 供電區段電壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Feeding-section voltage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「供電區段電壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Feeding-section voltage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Vs=750 V, I=2000 A, R=0.02 ohm；y=Vs-I*R=710 V。只把 Vs 增加百分之十，y=785 V。模型邊界：單負載直流穩態；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: Vs=750 V, I=2000 A, R=0.02 ohm; y=Vs-I*R=710 V. Increasing only Vs with a ten-percent increase gives y=785 V. Boundary: Single-load steady DC circuit; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以源負載兩端及回流電位區分模型與觀察，先用合成雙端電表資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use source/load voltages and return potential to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 供電區段電壓：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「供電區段電壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Feeding-section voltage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以源負載兩端及回流電位區分模型與觀察，先用合成雙端電表資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「供電區段電壓」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use source/load voltages and return potential to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic terminal meter data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Feeding-section voltage. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「供電區段電壓」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單負載直流穩態如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略並聯列車會低估壓降造成偏離的合成觀察，以源負載兩端及回流電位說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring parallel trains understates drop. Explain which evidence in source/load voltages and return potential distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略並聯列車會低估壓降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

title: 鐵路回流與雜散電流控制
summary: 鐵路回流與雜散電流控制以「回路電位分流與雜散電荷控制」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。牽引回流、軌地電位與雜散電流是不同量；減少一處電位可能把電流轉向其他路徑，需用完整網路及時間電荷帳判斷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops return potential current division and stray-charge control through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Traction return current, rail-earth potential and stray current are distinct; reducing voltage at one point can divert current elsewhere, requiring a complete network and time-integrated charge. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm；y=I*R=15 V。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=16.5 V。模型邊界：穩態單一路徑；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：It=1000 A, Rrail=0.02 ohm, Rcable=0.01 ohm；y=It*Rcable/(Rrail+Rcable)=333.333 A。只把 It 增加百分之十，y=366.667 A。模型邊界：兩個純電阻並聯；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm; y=I*R=15 V. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=16.5 V. Boundary: Steady single return path; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Increasing only It with a ten-percent increase gives y=366.667 A. Boundary: Two purely resistive parallel paths; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.

stages.title: 鋼軌回流壓降與平行回流分配
stages.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop & Parallel return sharing
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼軌回流壓降」與「平行回流分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail-return voltage drop" and "Parallel return sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼軌回流壓降」如何影響鐵路回流與雜散電流控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rail-return voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail-return and stray-current control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回流鋼軌有限電阻產生沿程電位差。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 16.5 V。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。穩態單一路徑。使用回流電流與兩點軌電位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接續線劣化會增加局部壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼軌回流壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Finite return-rail resistance produces longitudinal potential difference. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 16.5 V. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Steady single return path. Use return current and rail potentials at two points as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A degraded bond increases local voltage drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rail-return voltage drop” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼軌回流壓降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail-return voltage drop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm；y=I*R=15 V。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=16.5 V。模型邊界：穩態單一路徑；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=1000 A, R=0.015 ohm; y=I*R=15 V. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=16.5 V. Boundary: Steady single return path; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use return current and rail potentials at two points to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼軌回流壓降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail-return voltage drop” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以回流電流與兩點軌電位區分模型與觀察，先用低壓電阻鏈與差動電表建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「鋼軌回流壓降」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use return current and rail potentials at two points to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-voltage resistor chain and differential voltmeter, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Rail-return voltage drop. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「鋼軌回流壓降」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出穩態單一路徑如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由接續線劣化會增加局部壓降造成偏離的合成觀察，以回流電流與兩點軌電位說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. Explain which evidence in return current and rail potentials at two points distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋼軌回流壓降：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail-return voltage drop: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼軌回流壓降」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail-return voltage drop” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接續線劣化會增加局部壓降。這個失效與「鋼軌回流壓降」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查回流電流與兩點軌電位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop. This failure and a measurement bias in Rail-return voltage drop can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check return current and rail potentials at two points rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用回流電流與兩點軌電位作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；接續線劣化會增加局部壓降，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：接續線劣化會增加局部壓降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A degraded bond increases local voltage drop." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 時間取樣電荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampled charge estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時間取樣電荷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampled charge estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I1=0.1 A, I2=0.3 A, dt=60 s；y=(I1+I2)/2*dt=12 C。只把 I1 增加百分之十，y=12.3 C。模型邊界：兩樣本線性插值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I1=0.1 A, I2=0.3 A, dt=60 s; y=(I1+I2)/2*dt=12 C. Increasing only I1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.3 C. Boundary: Linear interpolation between two samples; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以更密集取樣電流區分模型與觀察，先用合成電流與降採樣比較建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use more densely sampled current to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 時間取樣電荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampled charge estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時間取樣電荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampled charge estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以更密集取樣電流區分模型與觀察，先用合成電流與降採樣比較建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「時間取樣電荷」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use more densely sampled current to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic current and downsampling comparison, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sampled charge estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「時間取樣電荷」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩樣本線性插值如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由稀疏取樣會漏掉短時高電流造成偏離的合成觀察，以更密集取樣電流說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Sampled charge estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear interpolation between two samples. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Sparse sampling misses brief high-current intervals. Explain which evidence in more densely sampled current distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：稀疏取樣會漏掉短時高電流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sparse sampling misses brief high-current intervals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 本單元以更密集取樣電流區分模型與觀察，先用合成電流與降採樣比較建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「時間取樣電荷」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sampled charge estimate. steps.title: 時間取樣電荷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampled charge estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時間取樣電荷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampled charge estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 稀疏取樣會漏掉短時高電流。這個失效與「時間取樣電荷」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查更密集取樣電流，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sparse sampling misses brief high-current intervals. This failure and a measurement bias in Sampled charge estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check more densely sampled current rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用更密集取樣電流作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；稀疏取樣會漏掉短時高電流，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sparse sampling misses brief high-current intervals; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：稀疏取樣會漏掉短時高電流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Sparse sampling misses brief high-current intervals." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 稀疏取樣會漏掉短時高電流。這個失效與「時間取樣電荷」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查更密集取樣電流，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時間取樣電荷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
