title: 軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統
titleEn: Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication
summary: 軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統以「輪緣與軌頂摩擦位置管理及黏著取捨」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。輪緣潤滑與軌頂摩擦調節作用位置及目標不同，減少磨耗不能以犧牲牽引制動黏著為代價，需同時追蹤摩擦、磨耗與材料散布。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops location-specific flange and railhead friction management through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Flange lubrication and top-of-rail friction management act at different locations with different aims; wear reduction must be evaluated alongside traction/braking adhesion and material carryover. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN；y=mu*N=25 kN。只把 mu 增加百分之十，y=27.5 kN。模型邊界：簡化庫侖上限；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=20 m/s, mu=0.15 1, g=9.81 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*mu*g)=135.916 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=164.458 m。模型邊界：水平常摩擦且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN. Increasing only mu with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.5 kN. Boundary: Simplified Coulomb ceiling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=20 m/s, mu=0.15 1, g=9.81 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*mu*g)=135.916 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=164.458 m. Boundary: Level track with constant friction and no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 黏著牽引上限與制動黏著距離
stages.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling & Adhesion-limited braking scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「黏著牽引上限」與「制動黏著距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adhesion traction ceiling" and "Adhesion-limited braking scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏著牽引上限」如何影響軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion traction ceiling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摩擦係數與法向力限制可傳遞切向力。本模型把 mu 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。簡化庫侖上限。使用切向力及法向力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏著牽引上限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Friction coefficient and normal force limit transferable tangential force. In this model, mu is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.5 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Simplified Coulomb ceiling. Use tangential and normal force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Excess lubrication may reduce available traction; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adhesion traction ceiling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN；y=mu*N=25 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏著牽引上限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adhesion traction ceiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 黏著牽引上限
knowledge.text: 摩擦係數與法向力限制可傳遞切向力。本模型把 mu 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 kN。
knowledge.textEn: Friction coefficient and normal force limit transferable tangential force. In this model, mu is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「黏著牽引上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Adhesion traction ceiling" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力
摩擦係數與法向力限制可傳遞切向力。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：乾燥摩擦外推濕污會低估停距
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction.
Friction coefficient and normal force limit transferable tangential force.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Dry-friction extrapolation understates wet/contaminated stopping distance.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦係數與法向力限制可傳遞切向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Friction coefficient and normal force limit transferable tangential force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏著牽引上限」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adhesion traction ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN；y=mu*N=25 kN。只把 mu 增加百分之十，y=27.5 kN。模型邊界：簡化庫侖上限；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN. Increasing only mu with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.5 kN. Boundary: Simplified Coulomb ceiling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以切向力及法向力區分模型與觀察，先用低載摩擦滑台與荷重元建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN；y=mu*N=25 kN。只把 mu 增加百分之十，y=27.5 kN。模型邊界：簡化庫侖上限；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Simplified Coulomb ceiling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mu=0.25 1, N=100 kN; y=mu*N=25 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏著牽引上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adhesion traction ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以切向力及法向力區分模型與觀察，先用低載摩擦滑台與荷重元建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「黏著牽引上限」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load friction sled and load cells, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adhesion traction ceiling. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「黏著牽引上限」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出簡化庫侖上限如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力造成偏離的合成觀察，以切向力及法向力說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Adhesion traction ceiling, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Simplified Coulomb ceiling. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. Explain which evidence in tangential and normal force distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 本單元以切向力及法向力區分模型與觀察，先用低載摩擦滑台與荷重元建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「黏著牽引上限」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load friction sled and load cells, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adhesion traction ceiling. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「黏著牽引上限」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出簡化庫侖上限如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力造成偏離的合成觀察，以切向力及法向力說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

quiz.question: 要驗證「黏著牽引上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Adhesion traction ceiling"?
options: 本單元以切向力及法向力區分模型與觀察，先用低載摩擦滑台與荷重元建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.

quiz.explanationEn: Use tangential and normal force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 黏著牽引上限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adhesion traction ceiling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏著牽引上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adhesion traction ceiling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力。這個失效與「黏著牽引上限」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查切向力及法向力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction. This failure and a measurement bias in Adhesion traction ceiling can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check tangential and normal force rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用切向力及法向力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力。這個失效與「黏著牽引上限」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查切向力及法向力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Cross-check tangential and normal force rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「黏著牽引上限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Adhesion traction ceiling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Excess lubrication may reduce available traction.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Dry-friction extrapolation understates wet/contaminated stopping distance.

steps.title: 制動黏著距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adhesion-limited braking scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「制動黏著距離」如何影響軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adhesion-limited braking scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 黏著限制減速度時停距隨摩擦降低而增長。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 164.458 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水平常摩擦且無建立延遲。使用減速度與摩擦條件作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；乾燥摩擦外推濕污會低估停距，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「制動黏著距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When adhesion limits deceleration, stopping distance grows as friction falls. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 164.458 m. steps.instructionEn: Dry-friction extrapolation understates wet/contaminated stopping distance. This failure and a measurement bias in Adhesion-limited braking scale can produce similar symptoms. steps.title: 簡化阿查德磨耗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Simplified Archard wear: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「簡化阿查德磨耗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Simplified Archard wear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：K=0.00001 1, N=1000 N, s=100 m, H=1000000000 Pa；y=K*N*s/H*1e9=1 mm3。只把 K 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm3。模型邊界：固定係數輕微磨耗區間；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: K=0.00001 1, N=1000 N, s=100 m, H=1000000000 Pa; y=K*N*s/H*1e9=1 mm3. Increasing only K with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm3. Boundary: Mild-wear interval with fixed coefficient; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以體積損失與載入距離區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片輪廓與質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use volume loss and loaded sliding distance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 簡化阿查德磨耗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Simplified Archard wear: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「簡化阿查德磨耗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Simplified Archard wear” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以體積損失與載入距離區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片輪廓與質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡化阿查德磨耗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use volume loss and loaded sliding distance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load specimen profiles and mass, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Simplified Archard wear. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「簡化阿查德磨耗」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出固定係數輕微磨耗區間如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由不同磨耗機制轉換會使線性外推失效造成偏離的合成觀察，以體積損失與載入距離說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Simplified Archard wear, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mild-wear interval with fixed coefficient. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A change of wear mechanism invalidates linear extrapolation. Explain which evidence in volume loss and loaded sliding distance distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同磨耗機制轉換會使線性外推失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A change of wear mechanism invalidates linear extrapolation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以體積損失與載入距離區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片輪廓與質量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「簡化阿查德磨耗」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

steps.title: 簡化阿查德磨耗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Simplified Archard wear: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「簡化阿查德磨耗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Simplified Archard wear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同磨耗機制轉換會使線性外推失效。這個失效與「簡化阿查德磨耗」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查體積損失與載入距離，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A change of wear mechanism invalidates linear extrapolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Simplified Archard wear can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check volume loss and loaded sliding distance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用體積損失與載入距離作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同磨耗機制轉換會使線性外推失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A change of wear mechanism invalidates linear extrapolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同磨耗機制轉換會使線性外推失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A change of wear mechanism invalidates linear extrapolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同磨耗機制轉換會使線性外推失效。這個失效與「簡化阿查德磨耗」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查體積損失與載入距離，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: A change of wear mechanism invalidates linear extrapolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Simplified Archard wear can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check volume loss and loaded sliding distance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「簡化阿查德磨耗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 材料面密度與分布衰減量級
stages.titleEn: Applied-material areal density & Carryover decay scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「材料面密度」與「分布衰減量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Applied-material areal density" and "Carryover decay scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 材料面密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Applied-material areal density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料面密度」如何影響軌道輪軌摩擦調節與潤滑系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Applied-material areal density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rail Wheel Contact Friction Management and Lubrication”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均面密度不表示每一處都有相同膜厚。本模型把 mass 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.275 g/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。僅惰性模型材料的面積平均。使用面積分布與質量帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料面密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean areal density does not imply uniform film thickness. In this model, mass is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.275 g/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Area average for inert model material only. Use spatial distribution and mass balance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Applied-material areal density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=0.5 g, area=2 m2；y=mass/area=0.25 g/m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=0.5 g, area=2 m2; y=mass/area=0.25 g/m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料面密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Applied-material areal density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 平均面密度不表示每一處都有相同膜厚。本模型把 mass 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.275 g/m2。

steps.title: 材料面密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Applied-material areal density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「材料面密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Applied-material areal density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=0.5 g, area=2 m2；y=mass/area=0.25 g/m2。只把 mass 增加百分之十，y=0.275 g/m2。模型邊界：僅惰性模型材料的面積平均；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=0.5 g, area=2 m2; y=mass/area=0.25 g/m2. Increasing only mass with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.275 g/m2. Boundary: Area average for inert model material only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以面積分布與質量帳區分模型與觀察，先用染色紙面模型與天平建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use spatial distribution and mass balance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 材料面密度：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料面密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Applied-material areal density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以面積分布與質量帳區分模型與觀察，先用染色紙面模型與天平建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「材料面密度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use spatial distribution and mass balance to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using dyed paper model and balance, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Applied-material areal density. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「材料面密度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出僅惰性模型材料的面積平均如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均造成偏離的合成觀察，以面積分布與質量帳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Applied-material areal density, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Area average for inert model material only. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean. Explain which evidence in spatial distribution and mass balance distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 材料面密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Applied-material areal density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「材料面密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Applied-material areal density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均。這個失效與「材料面密度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查面積分布與質量帳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean. This failure and a measurement bias in Applied-material areal density can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check spatial distribution and mass balance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用面積分布與質量帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local accumulation and bare areas can share one mean." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 指數衰減是待驗證的分布模型，不是固定產品性能。本模型把 initial 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.315155 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定衰減尺度的一維模型。使用沿程惰性標記濃度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；天候與交通改變衰減尺度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分布衰減量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exponential decay is a distribution hypothesis rather than fixed product performance. In this model, initial is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.315155 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One-dimensional model with fixed decay length. Use inert tracer concentration with distance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Weather and traffic change the decay scale; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Carryover decay scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：base=10 mm3, managed=7 mm3；y=(base-managed)/base*100=30 percent。只把 base 增加百分之十，y=36.3636 percent。模型邊界：配對試驗且同一體積測法；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: base=10 mm3, managed=7 mm3; y=(base-managed)/base*100=30 percent. Increasing only base with a ten-percent increase gives y=36.3636 percent. Boundary: Paired tests with the same volume method; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以對照組與重複樣本區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片與盲測輪廓建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use control group and repeat specimens to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：base=10 mm3, managed=7 mm3；y=(base-managed)/base*100=30 percent。只把 base 增加百分之十，y=36.3636 percent。模型邊界：配對試驗且同一體積測法；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: base=10 mm3, managed=7 mm3; y=(base-managed)/base*100=30 percent. Increasing only base with a ten-percent increase gives y=36.3636 percent. Boundary: Paired tests with the same volume method; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.title: 磨耗改善比例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wear-reduction fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「磨耗改善比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wear-reduction fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以對照組與重複樣本區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片與盲測輪廓建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「磨耗改善比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use control group and repeat specimens to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load specimens and blinded profiles, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Wear-reduction fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「磨耗改善比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出配對試驗且同一體積測法如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足造成偏離的合成觀察，以對照組與重複樣本說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Wear-reduction fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Paired tests with the same volume method. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion. Explain which evidence in control group and repeat specimens distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以對照組與重複樣本區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片與盲測輪廓建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「磨耗改善比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use control group and repeat specimens to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load specimens and blinded profiles, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Wear-reduction fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「磨耗改善比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出配對試驗且同一體積測法如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足造成偏離的合成觀察，以對照組與重複樣本說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Wear-reduction fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Paired tests with the same volume method. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion. Explain which evidence in control group and repeat specimens distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磨耗改善比例」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wear-reduction fraction"?
options: 本單元以對照組與重複樣本區分模型與觀察，先用低載試片與盲測輪廓建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部堆積與空白區可共存於相同平均
optionsEn: Use control group and repeat specimens to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: Use control group and repeat specimens to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 磨耗改善比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wear-reduction fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磨耗改善比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wear-reduction fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足。這個失效與「磨耗改善比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查對照組與重複樣本，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion. This failure and a measurement bias in Wear-reduction fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check control group and repeat specimens rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用對照組與重複樣本作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足。這個失效與「磨耗改善比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查對照組與重複樣本，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion. This failure and a measurement bias in Wear-reduction fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check control group and repeat specimens rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磨耗改善比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wear-reduction fraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
磨耗降低仍可能伴隨黏著不足。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過量潤滑可能降低牽引可用力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reduced wear can coexist with inadequate adhesion.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Excess lubrication may reduce available traction.

title: 軌道旁儲能系統
summary: 軌道旁儲能系統以「再生能量回收儲存與功率限制」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌旁儲能需同時滿足能量容量、充放電功率與列車事件時序，再生能量存在並不保證能被當時的儲能設備接收。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops regenerative recovery storage and power limits through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Wayside storage must satisfy energy capacity, power limits and train-event timing; available regenerative energy does not guarantee that storage can accept it at that moment. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s；y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=12.2222 kWh。模型邊界：水平平動且不含旋轉慣量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=10 kWh, eta=0.85 1；y=E*eta=8.5 kWh。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=9.35 kWh。模型邊界：固定單段效率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=200000 kg, v=20 m/s; y=0.5*m*v**2/3.6e6=11.1111 kWh. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.2222 kWh. Boundary: Level translational motion excluding rotational inertia; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=10 kWh, eta=0.85 1; y=E*eta=8.5 kWh. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=9.35 kWh. Boundary: Fixed single-stage efficiency; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 列車動能上限與回收轉換能量
stages.titleEn: Train kinetic-energy ceiling & Recovered conversion energy
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列車動能上限」與「回收轉換能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train kinetic-energy ceiling" and "Recovered conversion energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列車動能上限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train kinetic-energy ceiling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列車動能上限」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train kinetic-energy ceiling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動能是可回收能量的上界之一，阻力與轉換損失需扣除。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 12.2222 kWh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水平平動且不含旋轉慣量。使用速度質量與減速能量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部動能當回收量會高估收益，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車動能上限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 只有足夠容量仍可能因功率不足而拒收。這個失效與「功率充電時間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查事件時長與充電功率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate capacity can still reject energy through inadequate power. This failure and a measurement bias in Power-limited charging time can produce similar symptoms. options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間
可用空間由當下荷電狀態與允許上界決定。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom.
Headroom depends on present state of charge and allowed upper bound.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity.
quiz.explanation: 可用空間由當下荷電狀態與允許上界決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Headroom depends on present state of charge and allowed upper bound. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用荷電空間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Available state-of-charge headroom: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用荷電空間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Available state-of-charge headroom” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1；y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh。只把 capacity 增加百分之十，y=11 kWh。模型邊界：線性能量荷電映射；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: capacity=50 kWh, SOC=0.7 1, maximum=0.9 1; y=capacity*(maximum-SOC)=10 kWh. Increasing only capacity with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 kWh. Boundary: Linear energy-to-state-of-charge mapping; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以荷電估計與庫倫帳區分模型與觀察，先用合成狀態估計與獨立能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 可用荷電空間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Available state-of-charge headroom: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用荷電空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Available state-of-charge headroom” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以荷電估計與庫倫帳區分模型與觀察，先用合成狀態估計與獨立能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「可用荷電空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic state estimate and independent energy ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Available state-of-charge headroom. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「可用荷電空間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性能量荷電映射如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間造成偏離的合成觀察，以荷電估計與庫倫帳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Available state-of-charge headroom, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear energy-to-state-of-charge mapping. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. Explain which evidence in state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用荷電空間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Available state-of-charge headroom"?
options: 本單元以荷電估計與庫倫帳區分模型與觀察，先用合成狀態估計與獨立能量帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把全部動能當回收量會高估收益

quiz.explanationEn: Use state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用荷電空間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Available state-of-charge headroom: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用荷電空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Available state-of-charge headroom” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間。這個失效與「可用荷電空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷電估計與庫倫帳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. This failure and a measurement bias in Available state-of-charge headroom can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用荷電估計與庫倫帳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間。這個失效與「可用荷電空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查荷電估計與庫倫帳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

Cross-check state-of-charge estimate and coulomb ledger rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用荷電空間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Available state-of-charge headroom" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
估計漂移可能錯判可接收空間。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity.

quiz.explanationEn: Estimator drift can misidentify available headroom. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 電容能量窗與內阻瞬時損耗
stages.titleEn: Capacitor usable energy window & Internal-resistance instantaneous loss
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電容能量窗」與「內阻瞬時損耗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Capacitor usable energy window" and "Internal-resistance instantaneous loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電容能量窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Capacitor usable energy window: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電容能量窗」如何影響軌道旁儲能系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capacitor usable energy window” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wayside energy-storage systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電容能量取決於電壓平方差而非電壓差。本模型把 C 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 24.4444 Wh。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想定電容量且不含內阻。使用電壓與實際電容量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電容能量窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Capacitor energy depends on squared-voltage difference rather than voltage difference. In this model, C is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 24.4444 Wh. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal constant capacitance without internal resistance. Use voltage and measured capacitance as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Capacitor usable energy window” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V；y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: C=100 F, Vhigh=50 V, Vlow=30 V; y=0.5*C*(Vhigh**2-Vlow**2)/3600=22.2222 Wh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電容能量窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Capacitor usable energy window”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電容能量窗
knowledge.text: 電容能量取決於電壓平方差而非電壓差。本模型把 C 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 24.4444 Wh。
knowledge.textEn: Capacitor energy depends on squared-voltage difference rather than voltage difference. In this model, C is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把能量對電壓作線性外推會錯估容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear energy-voltage extrapolation misestimates capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電容能量窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Capacitor usable energy window" is correct?

steps.instruction: 脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱。這個失效與「內阻瞬時損耗」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查電流有效值與內阻，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pulse-average current does not represent mean heating. This failure and a measurement bias in Internal-resistance instantaneous loss can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check RMS current and internal resistance rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pulse-average current does not represent mean heating; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：脈衝平均電流不能代表平均發熱」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instructionEn: Sequential conversion efficiencies multiply rather than average. In this model, charge is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. Use input and output of the same cycle as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元以相同循環的輸入與輸出區分模型與觀察，先用合成完整循環電能帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「往返效率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use input and output of the same cycle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic complete-cycle energy ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Round-trip efficiency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 往返效率：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「往返效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Round-trip efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率。這個失效與「往返效率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查相同循環的輸入與輸出，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency. This failure and a measurement bias in Round-trip efficiency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check input and output of the same cycle rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用相同循環的輸入與輸出作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略待機損耗會高估日常效率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring standby loss overstates daily efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instructionEn: Cycle count alone does not capture depth, temperature or rate. This failure and a measurement bias in Daily equivalent full cycles can produce similar symptoms. steps.instruction: 本單元以全部制動事件與拒收原因區分模型與觀察，先用合成事件日誌與能量守恆建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「再生能量接收比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 再生能量接收比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regenerated-energy acceptance fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「再生能量接收比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Regenerated-energy acceptance fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只分析成功接收事件會高估利用率。這個失效與「再生能量接收比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查全部制動事件與拒收原因，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Analyzing only successful events overstates utilization. This failure and a measurement bias in Regenerated-energy acceptance fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check all braking events and rejection reasons rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用全部制動事件與拒收原因作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只分析成功接收事件會高估利用率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Analyzing only successful events overstates utilization; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只分析成功接收事件會高估利用率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Analyzing only successful events overstates utilization." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 列車自動防護系統
summary: 列車自動防護系統以「制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。列車自動防護把速度位置、路線許可及制動能力組成可持續檢查的包絡，離線算例只解釋邊界，不能作可上線的安全控制器。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Automatic train protection combines speed/location, movement authority and braking capability into a continuously checked envelope; offline examples explain boundaries rather than forming a deployable safety controller. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2；y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=726 m。模型邊界：水平常減速度且無建立延遲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s；y=v*t=36 m。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=39.6 m。模型邊界：延遲期間速度固定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, a=0.75 m/s2; y=v**2/(2*a)=600 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=726 m. Boundary: Level constant deceleration with no build-up delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, t=1.2 s; y=v*t=36 m. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=39.6 m. Boundary: Fixed speed during the delay; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 常減速度停距：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 動能關係使停距隨速度平方增長。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 726 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。水平常減速度且無建立延遲。使用速度衰減與制動建立作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略制動建立與坡度會低估需求，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「常減速度停距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Constant-deceleration stop distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
