steps.instruction: 平均延遲不可替代有界最壞延遲。這個失效與「處理延遲行程」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查端到端時戳與速度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean delay cannot replace a bounded worst-case delay. This failure and a measurement bias in Processing-delay travel can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check end-to-end timestamps and speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均延遲不可替代有界最壞延遲」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.instruction: 重播舊訊息可能表面合理卻過期。這個失效與「資料新鮮度距離」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查發送接收時戳與序號，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A replayed old message can look plausible while stale. This failure and a measurement bias in Data-age distance scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check send/receive timestamps and sequence numbers rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用發送接收時戳與序號作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重播舊訊息可能表面合理卻過期，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A replayed old message can look plausible while stale; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重播舊訊息可能表面合理卻過期」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A replayed old message can look plausible while stale." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「離散狀態測試數」如何影響列車自動防護系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discrete-state test combinations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train protection systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二元輸入組合數不表示全部狀態皆可達或安全。本模型把 bits 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 32 states。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。整數二元輸入且另查時間次序。使用可達性與狀態轉移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測單一輸入變化會漏掉組合故障，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「離散狀態測試數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Binary input combinations do not imply that every state is reachable or safe. In this model, bits is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 32 states. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Integer binary inputs with temporal order checked separately. Use reachability and state transitions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Testing only individual inputs misses combined faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discrete-state test combinations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 離散狀態測試數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Discrete-state test combinations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「離散狀態測試數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Discrete-state test combinations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測單一輸入變化會漏掉組合故障。這個失效與「離散狀態測試數」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查可達性與狀態轉移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only individual inputs misses combined faults. This failure and a measurement bias in Discrete-state test combinations can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reachability and state transitions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用可達性與狀態轉移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測單一輸入變化會漏掉組合故障，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Testing only individual inputs misses combined faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只測單一輸入變化會漏掉組合故障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Testing only individual inputs misses combined faults." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Observed test-failure fraction" and "Speed quantization half-step": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測試失敗比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Observed test-failure fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測試失敗比例」如何影響列車自動防護系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Observed test-failure fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train protection systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 測試失敗比例不是系統危險失效率認證。本模型把 failed 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 0.3 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。指定離線測試集合。使用測試覆蓋與失效類別作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；人為測試樣本不能直接代表營運曝險，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測試失敗比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Observed test-failure fraction is not certified hazardous failure rate. In this model, failed is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 0.3 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Specified offline test set. Use test coverage and failure classification as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Artificial test cases do not directly represent operating exposure; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Observed test-failure fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：failed=2 count, tested=1000 count；y=failed/tested*100=0.2 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: failed=2 count, tested=1000 count; y=failed/tested*100=0.2 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：人為測試樣本不能直接代表營運曝險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Artificial test cases do not directly represent operating exposure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 測試失敗比例：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測試失敗比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：failed=2 count, tested=1000 count；y=failed/tested*100=0.2 percent。只把 failed 增加一個整數單位，y=0.3 percent。模型邊界：指定離線測試集合；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: failed=2 count, tested=1000 count; y=failed/tested*100=0.2 percent. Increasing only failed with an increase of one whole unit gives y=0.3 percent. Boundary: Specified offline test set; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以測試覆蓋與失效類別區分模型與觀察，先用可重現情境與結果日誌建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed quantization half-step” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把顯示解析度當總準確度會低估不確定度。這個失效與「速度量化半格差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始速度與顯示速度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty. This failure and a measurement bias in Speed quantization half-step can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check raw and displayed speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把顯示解析度當總準確度會低估不確定度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating display resolution as total accuracy understates uncertainty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

title: 列車自動駕駛系統
summary: 本課聚焦由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路。從停準制動軌跡建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把節能滑行與回生與速度閉迴路時序連成可驗證的介面，最後以停準重複試驗推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification. Start with stopping brake trajectory to define physical or information boundaries, connect coasting and regenerative energy with speed-loop timing budget as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from repeated stopping tests. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究停準制動軌跡。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究舒適加速度過渡：原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。公式 y=(a1-a0)/dt，代入得 y=0.3 m/s3。邊界：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate stopping brake trajectory. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate comfortable acceleration transitions: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s. Formula y=(a1-a0)/dt gives y=0.3 m/s3. Boundary: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 停準制動軌跡與舒適加速度過渡
stages.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory & Comfortable acceleration transitions
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停準制動軌跡」與「舒適加速度過渡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stopping brake trajectory" and "Comfortable acceleration transitions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準制動軌跡」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stopping brake trajectory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準制動軌跡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping brake trajectory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準制動軌跡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stopping brake trajectory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停準制動軌跡
knowledge.text: 本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。
knowledge.textEn: Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停準制動軌跡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stopping brake trajectory" is correct?
options: 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。
最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同
optionsEn: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration.
Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準制動軌跡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping brake trajectory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準制動軌跡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stopping brake trajectory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「停準制動軌跡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For stopping brake trajectory, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「停準制動軌跡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for stopping brake trajectory, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停準制動軌跡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準制動軌跡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping brake trajectory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「停準制動軌跡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for stopping brake trajectory. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「停準制動軌跡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for stopping brake trajectory. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停準制動軌跡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stopping brake trajectory" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。
最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes.
Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation.
quiz.explanation: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 舒適加速度過渡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Comfortable acceleration transitions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「舒適加速度過渡」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Comfortable acceleration transitions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把加速度命令的斜坡與站立乘客的短時擾動連結，明確區分平滑命令與平滑實際反應。加加速度描述加速度改變的快慢，與最高加速度是不同的舒適性指標。相同速度增量可由平滑過渡或突變控制產生，站立乘客受到的瞬態擾動卻不同；控制器飽和也會截斷原先規畫的平滑曲線。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「舒適加速度過渡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relate the acceleration-command ramp to short transient disturbance for standing passengers, distinguishing a smooth requested command from a smooth measured response. Jerk measures how rapidly acceleration changes and is distinct from peak acceleration. Smooth and abrupt commands can produce the same speed increment while imposing different transient disturbances on standing passengers. Actuator saturation can truncate an otherwise smooth planned transition. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Comfortable acceleration transitions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「舒適加速度過渡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Comfortable acceleration transitions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 舒適加速度過渡
knowledge.text: 本單元把加速度命令的斜坡與站立乘客的短時擾動連結，明確區分平滑命令與平滑實際反應。加加速度描述加速度改變的快慢，與最高加速度是不同的舒適性指標。
knowledge.textEn: Relate the acceleration-command ramp to short transient disturbance for standing passengers, distinguishing a smooth requested command from a smooth measured response. Jerk measures how rapidly acceleration changes and is distinct from peak acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「舒適加速度過渡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Comfortable acceleration transitions" is correct?
options: 最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同
牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快
本單元把加速度命令的斜坡與站立乘客的短時擾動連結，明確區分平滑命令與平滑實際反應。
optionsEn: Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation.
Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
Relate the acceleration-command ramp to short transient disturbance for standing passengers, distinguishing a smooth requested command from a smooth measured response.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把加速度命令的斜坡與站立乘客的短時擾動連結，明確區分平滑命令與平滑實際反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Comfortable acceleration transitions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。公式 y=(a1-a0)/dt，代入得 y=0.3 m/s3。邊界：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Formula y=(a1-a0)/dt gives y=0.3 m/s3. Boundary: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先去除速度微分造成的高頻雜訊，再比較加速度計與里程推估的斜坡時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Control differentiation noise before comparing ramp duration from an accelerometer with the duration inferred from odometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。公式 y=(a1-a0)/dt，代入得 y=0.3 m/s3。邊界：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s. Formula y=(a1-a0)/dt gives y=0.3 m/s3. Boundary: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 舒適加速度過渡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Comfortable acceleration transitions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「舒適加速度過渡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Comfortable acceleration transitions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先去除速度微分造成的高頻雜訊，再比較加速度計與里程推估的斜坡時間。以「舒適加速度過渡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Control differentiation noise before comparing ramp duration from an accelerometer with the duration inferred from odometry. For comfortable acceleration transitions, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把過渡時間 dt 從 3 改成 3.3 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.3 變為 0.272727 m/s3。先說明「舒適加速度過渡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only transition time dt from 3 to 3.3 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.3 to 0.272727 m/s3. Explain the causal direction for comfortable acceleration transitions, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過度濾波可能讓顯示曲線看似平順，卻掩蓋真實衝擊；致動飽和則留下平頂加速度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excessive filtering can hide a real shock behind a smooth display, whereas actuator saturation leaves a flat-topped acceleration trace. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 舒適加速度過渡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Comfortable acceleration transitions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「舒適加速度過渡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Comfortable acceleration transitions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過度濾波可能讓顯示曲線看似平順，卻掩蓋真實衝擊；致動飽和則留下平頂加速度。回到「舒適加速度過渡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excessive filtering can hide a real shock behind a smooth display, whereas actuator saturation leaves a flat-topped acceleration trace. Trace the input chain for comfortable acceleration transitions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過度濾波可能讓顯示曲線看似平順，卻掩蓋真實衝擊；致動飽和則留下平頂加速度。回到「舒適加速度過渡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Excessive filtering can hide a real shock behind a smooth display, whereas actuator saturation leaves a flat-topped acceleration trace. Trace the input chain for comfortable acceleration transitions. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「舒適加速度過渡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Comfortable acceleration transitions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration.
Excessive filtering can hide a real shock behind a smooth display, whereas actuator saturation leaves a flat-topped acceleration trace.
quiz.explanation: 過度濾波可能讓顯示曲線看似平順，卻掩蓋真實衝擊；致動飽和則留下平頂加速度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excessive filtering can hide a real shock behind a smooth display, whereas actuator saturation leaves a flat-topped acceleration trace. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 牽引力功率限制與節能滑行與回生
stages.titleEn: Traction force and power limits & Coasting and regenerative energy
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「牽引力功率限制」與「節能滑行與回生」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Traction force and power limits" and "Coasting and regenerative energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牽引力功率限制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction force and power limits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引力功率限制」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction force and power limits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較定力區與功率受限區的加速需求，檢查速度規畫是否要求致動器無法提供的力。牽引力先克服阻力，剩餘部分才增加列車動量。輪周機械功率等於牽引力乘速度，因此低速大力不必然等於高功率；電源側功率另受效率、輔助負載及回生可受納性影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引力功率限制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare acceleration demand in force-limited and power-limited regions, checking whether a speed plan asks for more force than the actuator can deliver. Traction force first overcomes resistance; the remainder changes train momentum. Mechanical power at the wheel equals force times speed, so a large low-speed force need not imply high power. Electrical input also depends on efficiency, auxiliaries and regenerative receptivity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Traction force and power limits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「牽引力功率限制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Traction force and power limits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 牽引力功率限制
knowledge.text: 本單元比較定力區與功率受限區的加速需求，檢查速度規畫是否要求致動器無法提供的力。牽引力先克服阻力，剩餘部分才增加列車動量。
knowledge.textEn: Compare acceleration demand in force-limited and power-limited regions, checking whether a speed plan asks for more force than the actuator can deliver. Traction force first overcomes resistance; the remainder changes train momentum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「牽引力功率限制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Traction force and power limits" is correct?

optionsEn: Compare acceleration demand in force-limited and power-limited regions, checking whether a speed plan asks for more force than the actuator can deliver.

steps.title: 牽引力功率限制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traction force and power limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引力功率限制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction force and power limits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車質量 m=180000 kg；加速度 a=0.6 m/s2；等效阻力 R=12000 N；速度 v=15 m/s。公式 y=(m*a+R)*v/1000，代入得 y=1800 kW。邊界：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train mass m=180000 kg; acceleration a=0.6 m/s2; equivalent resistance R=12000 N; speed v=15 m/s. Formula y=(m*a+R)*v/1000 gives y=1800 kW. Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將速度與牽引力同步取樣，對照加速度反推的慣性力，並另列輔助設備耗電。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize speed and traction-force samples, compare inertial force inferred from acceleration, and account separately for auxiliary consumption.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.

steps.title: 牽引力功率限制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traction force and power limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牽引力功率限制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Traction force and power limits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將速度與牽引力同步取樣，對照加速度反推的慣性力，並另列輔助設備耗電。以「牽引力功率限制」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize speed and traction-force samples, compare inertial force inferred from acceleration, and account separately for auxiliary consumption. For traction force and power limits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把列車質量 m 從 180000 改成 198000 kg（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1800 變為 1962 kW。先說明「牽引力功率限制」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only train mass m from 180000 to 198000 kg (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1800 to 1962 kW. Explain the causal direction for traction force and power limits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 牽引力功率限制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traction force and power limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牽引力功率限制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Traction force and power limits” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把電網輸入功率直接當成輪周功率會高估加速能力，低速輪滑亦可使電流很高而車速不升。回到「牽引力功率限制」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating grid input as wheel power overstates acceleration capability; low-speed slip can produce high current without increasing train speed. Trace the input chain for traction force and power limits. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Lumped mass and fixed resistance; rotating inertia, gradient and adhesion limits are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「牽引電流變大就能保證車速增加得更快」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher traction current guarantees a greater train acceleration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 節能滑行與回生：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Coasting and regenerative energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節能滑行與回生」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coasting and regenerative energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以同一抵達時刻比較滑行與回生的能量帳，將準點需求和可受納回生能量分開記錄。回生能量的上限先受列車動能限制，再受轉換損失與受電端容量限制。速度平方決定動能量級，回生率不能單獨說明整趟能耗；若鄰車或儲能無法接收，原可回收的能量仍可能轉為電阻熱。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節能滑行與回生」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare coasting and regeneration for an identical arrival time, keeping punctuality requirements separate from the energy that the receiving supply can accept. Recoverable energy is bounded first by kinetic energy and then by conversion losses and receiver capacity. The square of speed sets the energy scale, while recovery efficiency alone cannot describe journey consumption. Energy may still become resistor heat when nearby trains or storage cannot accept it. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coasting and regenerative energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent mass m=180000 kg; speed v=22 m/s; recovery efficiency eta=0.7 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節能滑行與回生」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Coasting and regenerative energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節能滑行與回生

knowledge.textEn: Compare coasting and regeneration for an identical arrival time, keeping punctuality requirements separate from the energy that the receiving supply can accept. Recoverable energy is bounded first by kinetic energy and then by conversion losses and receiver capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節能滑行與回生」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Compare coasting and regeneration for an identical arrival time, keeping punctuality requirements separate from the energy that the receiving supply can accept.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.

steps.title: 節能滑行與回生：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coasting and regenerative energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節能滑行與回生」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coasting and regenerative energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6，代入得 y=8.47 kWh。邊界：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: equivalent mass m=180000 kg; speed v=22 m/s; recovery efficiency eta=0.7 1. Formula y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6 gives y=8.47 kWh. Boundary: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare integrated machine-side and DC-bus energy, keeping braking-resistor dissipation distinct from energy stored.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only speed v from 22 to 24.2 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8.47 to 10.2487 kWh. Explain the causal direction for coasting and regenerative energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。以「節能滑行與回生」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Compare integrated machine-side and DC-bus energy, keeping braking-resistor dissipation distinct from energy stored. For coasting and regenerative energy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把速度 v 從 22 改成 24.2 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 8.47 變為 10.2487 kWh。先說明「節能滑行與回生」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only speed v from 22 to 24.2 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 8.47 to 10.2487 kWh. Explain the causal direction for coasting and regenerative energy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節能滑行與回生」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coasting and regenerative energy"?
options: 比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
optionsEn: Compare integrated machine-side and DC-bus energy, keeping braking-resistor dissipation distinct from energy stored.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 比較電機側與直流母線能量積分，分開記錄制動電阻消耗與儲能充電。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare integrated machine-side and DC-bus energy, keeping braking-resistor dissipation distinct from energy stored. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節能滑行與回生：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coasting and regenerative energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節能滑行與回生」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coasting and regenerative energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。回到「節能滑行與回生」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. Trace the input chain for coasting and regenerative energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Rotating energy, elevation and auxiliaries are omitted; efficiency is constant and receiving capacity is assumed adequate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。回到「節能滑行與回生」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. Trace the input chain for coasting and regenerative energy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節能滑行與回生」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coasting and regenerative energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 電壓過高限制回生時，制動力仍可能由混合制動維持，不能由低回收量直接判定制動失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High bus voltage can restrict regeneration while blended braking preserves stopping effort; low recovered energy alone does not prove brake failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 地標資料年齡與關門發車介面
stages.titleEn: Age of landmark observations & Door closure and departure interface
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地標資料年齡」與「關門發車介面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Age of landmark observations" and "Door closure and departure interface": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地標資料年齡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Age of landmark observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地標資料年齡」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Age of landmark observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤地標通過到速度控制器採用資料的時間，避免把高定位精度誤認為低控制延遲。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地標資料年齡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track time from landmark passage to use by the speed controller, avoiding confusion between precise positioning and low control-loop latency. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Age of landmark observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly received packet always contains the present position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地標資料年齡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Age of landmark observations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地標資料年齡
knowledge.text: 本單元追蹤地標通過到速度控制器採用資料的時間，避免把高定位精度誤認為低控制延遲。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。
knowledge.textEn: Track time from landmark passage to use by the speed controller, avoiding confusion between precise positioning and low control-loop latency. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A newly received packet always contains the present position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地標資料年齡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Age of landmark observations" is correct?
options: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元追蹤地標通過到速度控制器採用資料的時間，避免把高定位精度誤認為低控制延遲。
optionsEn: A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Track time from landmark passage to use by the speed controller, avoiding confusion between precise positioning and low control-loop latency.
quiz.explanation: 本單元追蹤地標通過到速度控制器採用資料的時間，避免把高定位精度誤認為低控制延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Track time from landmark passage to use by the speed controller, avoiding confusion between precise positioning and low control-loop latency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地標資料年齡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Age of landmark observations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地標資料年齡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Age of landmark observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地標資料年齡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Age of landmark observations", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地標資料年齡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Age of landmark observations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地標資料年齡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Age of landmark observations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「地標資料年齡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For age of landmark observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「地標資料年齡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for age of landmark observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「地標資料年齡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For age of landmark observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door closure and departure interface” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元分析旅客服務結束到發車條件成立的交接，車門狀態只是必要輸入而不是獨立發車授權。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關門發車介面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse the handoff from completed passenger service to departure readiness; door status is a necessary input rather than an independent departure authority. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door closure and departure interface” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Door closure and departure interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「關門發車介面」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for door closure and departure interface. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
