stages.title: 速度閉迴路時序與駕駛模式交接驗證
stages.titleEn: Speed-loop timing budget & Driving-mode handover verification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速度閉迴路時序」與「駕駛模式交接驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Speed-loop timing budget" and "Driving-mode handover verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 速度閉迴路時序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed-loop timing budget: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度閉迴路時序」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed-loop timing budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把速度感測、通訊、控制計算與牽引建立串成同一事件鏈，尋找真正限制反應的階段。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度閉迴路時序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link speed sensing, communication, control computation and traction build-up into one event chain to identify the stage that actually limits response. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed-loop timing budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度閉迴路時序」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Speed-loop timing budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 本單元把速度感測、通訊、控制計算與牽引建立串成同一事件鏈，尋找真正限制反應的階段。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。
knowledge.textEn: Link speed sensing, communication, control computation and traction build-up into one event chain to identify the stage that actually limits response. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.

steps.title: 速度閉迴路時序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed-loop timing budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度閉迴路時序」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed-loop timing budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 速度閉迴路時序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed-loop timing budget: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度閉迴路時序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed-loop timing budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「速度閉迴路時序」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For speed-loop timing budget, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for speed-loop timing budget, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自動駕駛服務恢復」與「停準重複試驗推論」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Automatic-operation service recovery" and "Inference from repeated stopping tests": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自動駕駛服務恢復：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Automatic-operation service recovery: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自動駕駛服務恢復」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Automatic-operation service recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較短暫模式退出與長時間設備維修的服務影響，避免把可用度當作行車安全證明。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自動駕駛服務恢復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare service effects of brief mode withdrawals and lengthy equipment repairs, avoiding the use of availability as proof of operating safety. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Automatic-operation service recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自動駕駛服務恢復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Automatic-operation service recovery”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自動駕駛服務恢復
knowledge.text: 本單元比較短暫模式退出與長時間設備維修的服務影響，避免把可用度當作行車安全證明。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。
knowledge.textEn: Compare service effects of brief mode withdrawals and lengthy equipment repairs, avoiding the use of availability as proof of operating safety. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自動駕駛服務恢復」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Automatic-operation service recovery" is correct?
options: 本單元比較短暫模式退出與長時間設備維修的服務影響，避免把可用度當作行車安全證明。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Compare service effects of brief mode withdrawals and lengthy equipment repairs, avoiding the use of availability as proof of operating safety.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較短暫模式退出與長時間設備維修的服務影響，避免把可用度當作行車安全證明。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare service effects of brief mode withdrawals and lengthy equipment repairs, avoiding the use of availability as proof of operating safety. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自動駕駛服務恢復：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Automatic-operation service recovery: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自動駕駛服務恢復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Automatic-operation service recovery” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自動駕駛服務恢復」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Automatic-operation service recovery", which statement holds?
options: 最高加速度相同就代表乘坐感受一定相同
原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
有回生制動的列車就不會產生任何制動熱
optionsEn: Equal peak acceleration guarantees an identical ride sensation.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
A train with regenerative braking produces no braking heat.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自動駕駛服務恢復：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Automatic-operation service recovery: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自動駕駛服務恢復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Automatic-operation service recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「自動駕駛服務恢復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For automatic-operation service recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「自動駕駛服務恢復」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for automatic-operation service recovery, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「自動駕駛服務恢復」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For automatic-operation service recovery, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「自動駕駛服務恢復」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for automatic-operation service recovery, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自動駕駛服務恢復」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Automatic-operation service recovery"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
quiz.explanation: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自動駕駛服務恢復：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Automatic-operation service recovery: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自動駕駛服務恢復」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Automatic-operation service recovery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「自動駕駛服務恢復」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for automatic-operation service recovery. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「自動駕駛服務恢復」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for automatic-operation service recovery. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自動駕駛服務恢復」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Automatic-operation service recovery" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停準重複試驗推論：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inference from repeated stopping tests: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準重複試驗推論」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inference from repeated stopping tests” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把停準測試的零失敗紀錄轉成有限的統計證據，明列載重、黏著與車型抽樣範圍。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準重複試驗推論」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turn a failure-free stopping-test record into bounded statistical evidence, explicitly defining the sampled loads, adhesion conditions and vehicle types. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inference from repeated stopping tests” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 停準重複試驗推論：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inference from repeated stopping tests: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準重複試驗推論」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inference from repeated stopping tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停準重複試驗推論：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準重複試驗推論」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inference from repeated stopping tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「停準重複試驗推論」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For inference from repeated stopping tests, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「停準重複試驗推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

title: 列車自動監督系統
summary: 本課聚焦列車監督排程與旅客資訊的一致性。從班距監督與瓶頸建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把旅客服務需求累積與營運異常警報排序連成可驗證的介面，最後以監督整合重播計畫整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies consistency of train supervision scheduling and passenger information. Start with headway supervision and bottlenecks to define physical or information boundaries, connect accumulation of passenger service demand with ordering operational alarms as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through supervision integration replay plan. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究班距監督與瓶頸。原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。敏感度只改 S=420 至 462 m，輸出變為 62.8 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究時刻偏差吸收：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate headway supervision and bottlenecks. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. For sensitivity, change only S=420 to 462 m; the output becomes 62.8 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate absorbing timetable deviation: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 班距監督與瓶頸與時刻偏差吸收
stages.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks & Absorbing timetable deviation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「班距監督與瓶頸」與「時刻偏差吸收」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Headway supervision and bottlenecks" and "Absorbing timetable deviation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「班距監督與瓶頸」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「班距監督與瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Headway supervision and bottlenecks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 班距監督與瓶頸
knowledge.text: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「班距監督與瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Headway supervision and bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。
同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
optionsEn: Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以月台占用和區間追蹤兩個資源比較班距，先找瓶頸再討論監督系統可調整的空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare platform occupation and open-line following as separate headway resources, identifying the bottleneck before considering what supervision can adjust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「班距監督與瓶頸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「班距監督與瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Headway supervision and bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致

optionsEn: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「班距監督與瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「班距監督與瓶頸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For headway supervision and bottlenecks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「班距監督與瓶頸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hypothetical protected distance S from 420 to 462 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 60 to 62.8 s. Explain the causal direction for headway supervision and bottlenecks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「班距監督與瓶頸」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For headway supervision and bottlenecks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「班距監督與瓶頸」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for headway supervision and bottlenecks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「班距監督與瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Headway supervision and bottlenecks"?
options: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。

狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 班距監督與瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Headway supervision and bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「班距監督與瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Headway supervision and bottlenecks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for headway supervision and bottlenecks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「班距監督與瓶頸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for headway supervision and bottlenecks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「班距監督與瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Headway supervision and bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。
同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時刻偏差吸收」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absorbing timetable deviation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。餘裕可以吸收小延誤，卻不是可隨意重複使用的免費容量；同一段緩衝若被兩個衝突約束同時借用，紙面上可行的時刻仍會在實際重播中互相追趕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時刻偏差吸收」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation. It can absorb small delays but is not free capacity that may be reused indefinitely. If two conflicting constraints both claim the same buffer, a timetable that appears feasible on paper can still produce converging delays in replay. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Absorbing timetable deviation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Absorbing timetable deviation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「時刻偏差吸收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Absorbing timetable deviation" is correct?

總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元將提前、延誤與可用餘裕列在同一時空圖，防止同一段緩衝被多項調整重複使用。

Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Place early running, delay and available margin on one time-distance diagram so several adjustments cannot silently consume the same recovery buffer.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時刻偏差吸收」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absorbing timetable deviation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。

Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「時刻偏差吸收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Absorbing timetable deviation", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。
平均頻寬足夠就保證每一個封包都準時抵達
操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決

Sufficient average bandwidth guarantees on-time arrival of every packet.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時刻偏差吸收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Absorbing timetable deviation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「時刻偏差吸收」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For absorbing timetable deviation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「時刻偏差吸收」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for absorbing timetable deviation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「時刻偏差吸收」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For absorbing timetable deviation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「時刻偏差吸收」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for absorbing timetable deviation, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時刻偏差吸收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Absorbing timetable deviation"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 時刻偏差吸收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Absorbing timetable deviation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時刻偏差吸收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Absorbing timetable deviation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for absorbing timetable deviation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「時刻偏差吸收」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for absorbing timetable deviation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「時刻偏差吸收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Absorbing timetable deviation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction.
quiz.explanation: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 停站延長決策與旅客服務需求累積
stages.titleEn: Dwell-extension decisions & Accumulation of passenger service demand
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停站延長決策」與「旅客服務需求累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dwell-extension decisions" and "Accumulation of passenger service demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停站延長決策：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dwell-extension decisions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停站延長決策」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dwell-extension decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較延長停站接續轉乘與保持後車間距的衝突，把旅客服務目標與線路容量一起呈現。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停站延長決策」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare holding a train for connections with preserving separation from its follower, presenting passenger-service objectives alongside the route-capacity consequences. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. steps.title: 停站延長決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dwell-extension decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停站延長決策」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dwell-extension decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dwell-extension decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「停站延長決策」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「停站延長決策」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 旅客服務需求累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Accumulation of passenger service demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旅客服務需求累積」如何影響列車自動監督系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accumulation of passenger service demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train supervision systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以旅客請求進出服務區的模型觀察需求累積，將未服務旅客保留在資料中而非刪除。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旅客服務需求累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use passenger entry and exit from a service area to observe demand accumulation, retaining unserved travellers in the data instead of removing them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Accumulation of passenger service demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旅客服務需求累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Accumulation of passenger service demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Use passenger entry and exit from a service area to observe demand accumulation, retaining unserved travellers in the data instead of removing them. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
