steps.title: 模式與有效性旗標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Modes and validity flags: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模式與有效性旗標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Modes and validity flags” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「模式與有效性旗標」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for modes and validity flags. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「模式與有效性旗標」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for modes and validity flags. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模式與有效性旗標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Modes and validity flags" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races.
quiz.explanation: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 無線交接案例矩陣與通訊試驗證據界限
stages.titleEn: Radio-handover case matrix & Limits of communication-test evidence
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無線交接案例矩陣」與「通訊試驗證據界限」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Radio-handover case matrix" and "Limits of communication-test evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無線交接案例矩陣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Radio-handover case matrix: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無線交接案例矩陣」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radio-handover case matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用離線重播覆蓋基地台交接邊界、重複資料與亂序資料，保留每項需求的判定證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無線交接案例矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use offline replay to cover access-point handover boundaries, duplicated data and out-of-order messages, retaining evidence for every requirement decision. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Radio-handover case matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無線交接案例矩陣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Radio-handover case matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Use offline replay to cover access-point handover boundaries, duplicated data and out-of-order messages, retaining evidence for every requirement decision. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無線交接案例矩陣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radio-handover case matrix" is correct?
options: 本單元用離線重播覆蓋基地台交接邊界、重複資料與亂序資料，保留每項需求的判定證據。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Radio-handover case matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「無線交接案例矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for radio-handover case matrix. steps.title: 通訊試驗證據界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Limits of communication-test evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通訊試驗證據界限」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Limits of communication-test evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元檢查大量成功封包是否其實集中在少數容易場景，將統計推論限制在真正抽樣的環境。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊試驗證據界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether many successful packets came from only a few easy scenarios, limiting statistical inference to the environments genuinely represented by the sample. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Limits of communication-test evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通訊試驗證據界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Limits of communication-test evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for limits of communication-test evidence, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「通訊試驗證據界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For limits of communication-test evidence, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「通訊試驗證據界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for limits of communication-test evidence, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通訊試驗證據界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Limits of communication-test evidence"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通訊試驗證據界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Limits of communication-test evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通訊試驗證據界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Limits of communication-test evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「通訊試驗證據界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for limits of communication-test evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「通訊試驗證據界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for limits of communication-test evidence. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通訊試驗證據界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Limits of communication-test evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 歐洲列車控制系統整合
summary: 本課聚焦歐洲列控版本介面與車地相容驗證。從列控制動模型輸入建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把車地資料交接與介面失配頂事件連成可驗證的介面，最後以互通試驗推論範圍整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies european train-control version interfaces and train–track compatibility. Start with train-control braking-model inputs to define physical or information boundaries, connect train–track data handoff with top event for interface mismatch as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through scope of interoperability inference. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究列控制動模型輸入。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究應答器位置與時效：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate train-control braking-model inputs. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate balise position and data freshness: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 列控制動模型輸入與應答器位置與時效
stages.titleEn: Train-control braking-model inputs & Balise position and data freshness
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「列控制動模型輸入」與「應答器位置與時效」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Train-control braking-model inputs" and "Balise position and data freshness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 列控制動模型輸入：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train-control braking-model inputs: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「列控制動模型輸入」如何影響歐洲列車控制系統整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train-control braking-model inputs” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “European Train Control System integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列控制動模型輸入」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train-control braking-model inputs” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「列控制動模型輸入」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Train-control braking-model inputs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列控制動模型輸入
knowledge.text: 本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。
knowledge.textEn: Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列控制動模型輸入」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Train-control braking-model inputs" is correct?
options: 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以簡化制動距離理解速度、反應時間與減速度的角色，避免將教材算例當成列控制動曲線。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use simplified stopping distance to understand speed, response and deceleration, without treating a teaching calculation as an operational ETCS braking curve. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列控制動模型輸入：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train-control braking-model inputs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「列控制動模型輸入」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train-control braking-model inputs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 列控制動模型輸入：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train-control braking-model inputs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「列控制動模型輸入」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Train-control braking-model inputs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「列控制動模型輸入」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For train-control braking-model inputs, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「列控制動模型輸入」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for train-control braking-model inputs, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 列控制動模型輸入：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train-control braking-model inputs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「列控制動模型輸入」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Train-control braking-model inputs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「列控制動模型輸入」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for train-control braking-model inputs. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 應答器位置與時效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Balise position and data freshness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應答器位置與時效」如何影響歐洲列車控制系統整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Balise position and data freshness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “European Train Control System integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元區分地標參考點的定位誤差與車載處理時間，追蹤資料從讀取到採用的整個路徑。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應答器位置與時效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate reference-point uncertainty from onboard processing time, tracing the complete path from landmark reading to use in the train-control calculation. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Balise position and data freshness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly received packet always contains the present position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應答器位置與時效」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Balise position and data freshness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 應答器位置與時效：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應答器位置與時效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Balise position and data freshness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 應答器位置與時效：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應答器位置與時效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Balise position and data freshness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「應答器位置與時效」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For balise position and data freshness, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「應答器位置與時效」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for balise position and data freshness, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 應答器間里程漂移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Odometry drift between balises: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應答器間里程漂移」如何影響歐洲列車控制系統整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Odometry drift between balises” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “European Train Control System integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較兩個地標之間的距離累積誤差，將輪徑比例偏差與單次地標校正偏移分開。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應答器間里程漂移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare distance accumulation between landmarks, separating wheel-scale bias from the one-time offset introduced by a landmark correction. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Odometry drift between balises” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應答器間里程漂移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Odometry drift between balises” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 車地資料交接：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Train–track data handoff” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「車地資料交接」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reachability of mode transitions" and "Version-compatibility requirement matrix": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模式轉換可達性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reachability of mode transitions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模式轉換可達性」如何影響歐洲列車控制系統整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reachability of mode transitions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “European Train Control System integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元在抽象狀態機中檢查合法轉換與拒絕轉換，不把版本名稱相同當作所有行為相容的證據。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模式轉換可達性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check allowed and rejected transitions in an abstract state machine, without treating a shared version name as proof that every behaviour is compatible. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reachability of mode transitions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模式轉換可達性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reachability of mode transitions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Check allowed and rejected transitions in an abstract state machine, without treating a shared version name as proof that every behaviour is compatible. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective.

steps.title: 模式轉換可達性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reachability of mode transitions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模式轉換可達性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reachability of mode transitions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

stages.title: 介面失配頂事件與測試記錄時間對齊

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「介面失配頂事件」與「測試記錄時間對齊」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 介面失配頂事件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Top event for interface mismatch: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「介面失配頂事件」如何影響歐洲列車控制系統整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top event for interface mismatch” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “European Train Control System integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把資料語意與設定檔錯配作為不同候選原因，先建立失效邏輯再討論假想機率。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「介面失配頂事件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat semantic mismatch and configuration mismatch as distinct candidate causes, defining fault logic before assigning hypothetical probabilities. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Top event for interface mismatch” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「介面失配頂事件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Top event for interface mismatch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 介面失配頂事件：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top event for interface mismatch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 介面失配頂事件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Top event for interface mismatch: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「介面失配頂事件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top event for interface mismatch” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「介面失配頂事件」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. For top event for interface mismatch, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把事件一機率 p1 從 0.001 改成 0.0011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.002998 變為 0.0030978 1。先說明「介面失配頂事件」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for top event for interface mismatch, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 本單元比較車載、地面和測試儀紀錄的時間差，避免把儀器時基誤差當成系統反應延遲。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測試記錄時間對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare timestamps from onboard equipment, wayside equipment and test instruments, avoiding confusion between reference-clock error and system response delay. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aligning integration-test clocks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 測試記錄時間對齊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aligning integration-test clocks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測試記錄時間對齊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aligning integration-test clocks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測試記錄時間對齊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.

steps.title: 測試記錄時間對齊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aligning integration-test clocks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測試記錄時間對齊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aligning integration-test clocks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「測試記錄時間對齊」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For aligning integration-test clocks, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「測試記錄時間對齊」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for aligning integration-test clocks, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 測試記錄時間對齊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aligning integration-test clocks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測試記錄時間對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aligning integration-test clocks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「測試記錄時間對齊」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for aligning integration-test clocks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for aligning integration-test clocks. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 跨版本回歸測試與互通試驗推論範圍
stages.titleEn: Cross-version regression testing & Scope of interoperability inference
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨版本回歸測試」與「互通試驗推論範圍」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cross-version regression testing" and "Scope of interoperability inference": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨版本回歸測試：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cross-version regression testing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨版本回歸測試」如何影響歐洲列車控制系統整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross-version regression testing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “European Train Control System integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元為每種版本組合保留環境還原與資料核對時間，明確追蹤變更後哪些證據需要重新取得。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨版本回歸測試」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Budget restoration and data checks for every version combination, explicitly tracking which evidence must be regenerated after a change. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
Limit successful-test inference to the tested function and version set, explaining why a zero-failure record does not cover untested national or equipment variants.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把成功試驗限制在已測功能與版本集合，說明零失敗紀錄不能外推到未測國別或設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Limit successful-test inference to the tested function and version set, explaining why a zero-failure record does not cover untested national or equipment variants. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 互通試驗推論範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scope of interoperability inference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互通試驗推論範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scope of interoperability inference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「互通試驗推論範圍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 互通試驗推論範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scope of interoperability inference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互通試驗推論範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scope of interoperability inference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「互通試驗推論範圍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For scope of interoperability inference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「互通試驗推論範圍」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for scope of interoperability inference, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「互通試驗推論範圍」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For scope of interoperability inference, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「互通試驗推論範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scope of interoperability inference"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
