steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Checking occupancy-event timing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「斷線與供電異常辨識」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for distinguishing disconnection and supply faults. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 本單元檢查重複接收器是否共用軌道輸入與電源，說明雙設備無法自行消除輸入共同失效。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接收鏈共同原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. steps.title: 接收鏈共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Common causes in receiving chains: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接收鏈共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Common causes in receiving chains” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「接收鏈共同原因」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For common causes in receiving chains, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「接收鏈共同原因」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only common-cause event probability common from 0.0001 to 0.00011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for common causes in receiving chains, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接收鏈共同原因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Common causes in receiving chains"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 接收鏈共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Common causes in receiving chains: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接收鏈共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Common causes in receiving chains” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「接收鏈共同原因」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for common causes in receiving chains. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「接收鏈共同原因」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for common causes in receiving chains. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接收鏈共同原因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Common causes in receiving chains" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch.
quiz.explanation: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 乾濕與故障情境矩陣與誤占用維修履歷
stages.titleEn: Dry wet and fault test matrix & Maintenance history of false occupancy
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」與「誤占用維修履歷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dry wet and fault test matrix" and "Maintenance history of false occupancy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 乾濕與故障情境矩陣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dry wet and fault test matrix: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」如何影響軌道電路列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry wet and fault test matrix” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-circuit train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以教具建立乾濕漏電、接觸變化與干擾案例，明列哪些狀態仍未取得測試證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build teaching-rig cases for dry/wet leakage, contact changes and interference, explicitly listing states for which test evidence is still absent. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dry wet and fault test matrix” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dry wet and fault test matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Dry wet and fault test matrix
knowledge.text: 本單元以教具建立乾濕漏電、接觸變化與干擾案例，明列哪些狀態仍未取得測試證據。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Build teaching-rig cases for dry/wet leakage, contact changes and interference, explicitly listing states for which test evidence is still absent. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 乾濕與故障情境矩陣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dry wet and fault test matrix: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dry wet and fault test matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dry wet and fault test matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「乾濕與故障情境矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for dry wet and fault test matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.title: 誤占用維修履歷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Maintenance history of false occupancy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「誤占用維修履歷」如何影響軌道電路列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance history of false occupancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Track-circuit train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元分開保守占用顯示與真正設備失效紀錄，將重複報修合併到同一根因而保留服務影響。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「誤占用維修履歷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate conservative occupied indications from equipment-failure records, linking repeated reports to one cause while retaining their service impact. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Maintenance history of false occupancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「誤占用維修履歷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Maintenance history of false occupancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Separate conservative occupied indications from equipment-failure records, linking repeated reports to one cause while retaining their service impact. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.explanationEn: Separate conservative occupied indications from equipment-failure records, linking repeated reports to one cause while retaining their service impact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「誤占用維修履歷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance history of false occupancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 誤占用維修履歷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Maintenance history of false occupancy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「誤占用維修履歷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance history of false occupancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「誤占用維修履歷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for maintenance history of false occupancy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「誤占用維修履歷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Maintenance history of false occupancy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。

Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.

title: 計軸器列車占用偵測
summary: 本課聚焦計軸事件守恆方向與資料有效性。從區段軸數守恆建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把輪感測訊號品質與未知占用狀態保存連成可驗證的介面，最後以漏計試驗統計界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies axle-count event conservation direction and data validity. Start with axle conservation within a section to define physical or information boundaries, connect wheel-sensor signal quality with preserving unknown occupancy states as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through statistical bounds for missed counts. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究區段軸數守恆。原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。敏感度只改 enter=48 至 49 axles，輸出變為 5 axles；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究雙感測點方向判別：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate axle conservation within a section. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. For sensitivity, change only enter=48 to 49 axles; the output becomes 5 axles. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate direction from paired sensing points: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 區段軸數守恆與雙感測點方向判別
stages.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section & Direction from paired sensing points
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「區段軸數守恆」與「雙感測點方向判別」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axle conservation within a section" and "Direction from paired sensing points": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 區段軸數守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區段軸數守恆」如何影響計軸器列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axle conservation within a section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Axle-counter train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段軸數守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Axle conservation within a section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段軸數守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Axle conservation within a section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 區段軸數守恆
knowledge.text: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。
knowledge.textEn: Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「區段軸數守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Axle conservation within a section" is correct?
options: 進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車
本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。

optionsEn: Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
Move marked model wheelsets through a section in both directions and compare entry, exit and actual occupancy without connecting to field equipment.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用標記輪對雙向進出模型區段，核對流入流出與實際區內存量而不連接現場設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 區段軸數守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區段軸數守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Axle conservation within a section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以標記輪對的玩具車雙向重播，對照人工真值、事件順序與感測器有效旗標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「區段軸數守恆」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Axle conservation within a section", which statement holds?
options: 總量測電壓越大就能保證訊號品質越好
只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性

steps.title: 區段軸數守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axle conservation within a section: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Axle conservation within a section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以標記輪對的玩具車雙向重播，對照人工真值、事件順序與感測器有效旗標。以「區段軸數守恆」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags. For axle conservation within a section, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 雙感測點方向判別：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「雙感測點方向判別」如何影響計軸器列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Direction from paired sensing points” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Axle-counter train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元利用同一輪對通過兩個感測點的先後順序，特別檢查低速回滾時的事件配對。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙感測點方向判別」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use the order in which one wheelset passes two sensing points, paying particular attention to event pairing during slow rollback. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Direction from paired sensing points” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙感測點方向判別」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Direction from paired sensing points” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元比較不同通過速度的脈衝寬度與取樣間隔，判斷資料列數是否足以保留事件邊界。固定時間取樣在移動系統中對應空間間隔，速度越高相同頻率越容易漏過狹窄特徵。時間戳抖動會讓空間取樣不均勻；提高取樣率仍需足夠感測頻寬與抗混疊處理，不能只增加資料列數。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速與等時間取樣的間距，不代表可以解析同樣大小的最小缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪脈衝時間解析度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pulse width and sampling interval at different passage speeds, assessing whether the samples preserve the event boundaries. steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: signal RMS signal=2 V_rms; noise RMS noise=0.1 V_rms. Formula y=20*log10(signal/noise) gives y=26.0206 dB. Boundary: RMS voltages with equal impedance and bandwidth; arbitrary peak ratios are not interchangeable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 計軸事件排序：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤分散感測點的時間偏差，檢查資料延後抵達時是否仍能保留原始事件順序。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「計軸事件排序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track clock offsets among distributed sensing points, checking whether original event order survives delayed message arrival. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ordering axle-count events” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 回滾與拆編情境：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回滾與拆編情境」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rollback and consist-change scenarios” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「回滾與拆編情境」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for rollback and consist-change scenarios. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 漏計試驗統計界限：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Statistical bounds for missed counts: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏計試驗統計界限」如何影響計軸器列車占用偵測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Statistical bounds for missed counts” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Axle-counter train-occupancy detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將輪對測試紀錄按速度與輪型分層，說明單一條件下零漏計不能證明所有條件無誤。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏計試驗統計界限」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stratify wheelset trials by speed and wheel type, explaining why zero missed counts in one condition cannot establish error-free behaviour everywhere. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Statistical bounds for missed counts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏計試驗統計界限」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「漏計試驗統計界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏計試驗統計界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Statistical bounds for missed counts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「漏計試驗統計界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. title: 鐵路道岔轉轍機
summary: 本課聚焦轉轍傳力鎖閉與狀態確認鏈。從轉轍力位移作功建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把馬達回路與接觸與鎖閉確認狀態機連成可驗證的介面，最後以轉轍維修服務影響整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies point-machine force transfer locking and state-confirmation chain. Start with point-machine force–travel work to define physical or information boundaries, connect motor circuit and contact behaviour with state machine for lock confirmation as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through service impact of point maintenance. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究轉轍力位移作功。原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。敏感度只改 F=4500 至 4950 N，輸出變為 913.846 J；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究連桿幾何與力矩：原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate point-machine force–travel work. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. For sensitivity, change only F=4500 to 4950 N; the output becomes 913.846 J. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate linkage geometry and torque: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 轉轍力位移作功與連桿幾何與力矩
stages.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work & Linkage geometry and torque
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉轍力位移作功」與「連桿幾何與力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Point-machine force–travel work" and "Linkage geometry and torque": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Point-machine force–travel work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉轍力位移作功」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Point-machine force–travel work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將轉轍機行程分段量測，尋找力位移曲線中局部卡滯而不只比較單一電流峰值。致動器輸入能量必須支應負載作功與摩擦損失。相同行程不代表相同負載，潤滑、對位與溫度會改變力的分布；只看總電流峰值可能忽略行程中某一位置的卡滯，需把力與位移配對。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉轍力位移作功」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss. Equal travel does not imply equal loading because lubrication, alignment and temperature change force distribution. A single current peak can miss binding at a particular position, so force should be paired with displacement. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Point-machine force–travel work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器走完行程就能保證機構已完成安全鎖閉」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Measure point-machine travel in segments, seeking localized binding in the force-displacement curve rather than comparing only one current peak. Actuator input energy must cover load work and frictional loss.

steps.title: 轉轍力位移作功：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Point-machine force–travel work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：作用力 F=4500 N；作用行程 s=0.12 m；機械效率 eta=0.65 1。公式 y=F*s/eta，代入得 y=830.769 J。邊界：定力準靜態行程與定效率，不含撞擊、慣性及實際轉轍鎖閉要求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: applied force F=4500 N; travel s=0.12 m; mechanical efficiency eta=0.65 1. Formula y=F*s/eta gives y=830.769 J. Boundary: Constant-force quasistatic travel and fixed efficiency; impacts, inertia and real point-locking requirements are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在隔離試驗台同步記錄力、位移與電流，積分力位移曲線並比較往返差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On an isolated bench, synchronize force, displacement and current, integrate the force-travel curve and compare both directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Draw the force path from motor to switch blade and examine effective lever arm and output force as linkage angle changes. Torque measured at the housing need not equal effective force at the switch blade. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：切向作用力 F=1800 N；力臂 r=0.08 m。公式 y=F*r，代入得 y=144 N*m。邊界：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Formula y=F*r gives y=144 N*m. Boundary: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: tangential force F=1800 N; lever arm r=0.08 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連桿幾何與力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Linkage geometry and torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。以「連桿幾何與力矩」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. For linkage geometry and torque, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把力臂 r 從 0.08 改成 0.088 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 144 變為 158.4 N*m。先說明「連桿幾何與力矩」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only lever arm r from 0.08 to 0.088 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 144 to 158.4 N*m. Explain the causal direction for linkage geometry and torque, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以量測幾何核對力臂方向，分別量輸入扭矩與輸出推力，建立行程對應曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check lever-arm direction from measured geometry, measure input torque and output force separately, and map both against travel. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 連桿幾何與力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Linkage geometry and torque: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連桿幾何與力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Linkage geometry and torque” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。回到「連桿幾何與力矩」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：垂直定力臂的靜力模型，忽略齒輪摩擦與連桿角度變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static perpendicular constant lever arm; gear friction and changing linkage angle are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「力臂變短時相同作用力一定產生更大的力矩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Trace the input chain for linkage geometry and torque. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「連桿幾何與力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Linkage geometry and torque" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零
把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel.
quiz.explanation: 把半徑當成所有位置的有效力臂會造成系統性誤差，鬆動連接則可能有高轉矩卻沒有有效位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using radius as the effective lever arm at every position causes systematic error; loose connections can absorb torque without useful travel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 雙端行程差異與馬達回路與接觸
stages.titleEn: Travel mismatch between coupled ends & Motor circuit and contact behaviour
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙端行程差異」與「馬達回路與接觸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Travel mismatch between coupled ends" and "Motor circuit and contact behaviour": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙端行程差異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Travel mismatch between coupled ends: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙端行程差異」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Travel mismatch between coupled ends” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以雙致動教具觀察小速度差如何累積為位置差，將同步需求與機械柔度分開。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。位置回授能限制累積，卻仍需共同座標和獨立零點檢查；兩個馬達瞬間轉速相同只代表該時刻差值不再增加，並不能消除先前留下的位置偏移。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙端行程差異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use coupled actuators on a teaching rig to observe small speed differences accumulating into displacement mismatch, separating synchronization from mechanical compliance. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance. Position feedback can limit accumulation but requires a common coordinate and independent zero checks. Equal instantaneous motor speeds only stop further growth at that instant; they do not remove the position offset already accumulated. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Travel mismatch between coupled ends” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙端行程差異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Travel mismatch between coupled ends”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙端行程差異
knowledge.text: 本單元以雙致動教具觀察小速度差如何累積為位置差，將同步需求與機械柔度分開。耦合致動器的小速度差會隨動作時間累積成行程差，使連桿扭轉或局部阻力增加。
knowledge.textEn: Use coupled actuators on a teaching rig to observe small speed differences accumulating into displacement mismatch, separating synchronization from mechanical compliance. A small speed difference between coupled actuators accumulates into travel mismatch, twisting linkages or increasing local resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩致動器瞬間速度相同就能證明已累積的位置差為零 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙端行程差異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Travel mismatch between coupled ends" is correct?
options: 本單元以雙致動教具觀察小速度差如何累積為位置差，將同步需求與機械柔度分開。

optionsEn: Use coupled actuators on a teaching rig to observe small speed differences accumulating into displacement mismatch, separating synchronization from mechanical compliance.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以雙致動教具觀察小速度差如何累積為位置差，將同步需求與機械柔度分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 雙端行程差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Travel mismatch between coupled ends: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙端行程差異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Travel mismatch between coupled ends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：致動端一速度 v1=0.012 m/s；致動端二速度 v2=0.0115 m/s；動作時間 t=20 s。公式 y=(v1-v2)*t*1000，代入得 y=10 mm。邊界：定速度差的運動學模型，未含閉迴路補償與結構柔度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first actuator speed v1=0.012 m/s; second actuator speed v2=0.0115 m/s; motion time t=20 s. Formula y=(v1-v2)*t*1000 gives y=10 mm. Boundary: Kinematic model with constant speed difference; feedback correction and structural compliance are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立位移計同時量測兩個連接點，對照編碼器零點與連桿幾何，再比較低負載及偏載時的誤差斜率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure both connection points simultaneously with independent displacement sensors, compare encoder zeros and linkage geometry, then compare drift slopes at low and uneven load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Motor circuit and contact behaviour” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用隔離直流回路分析接點電阻與供電下降，避免將低電流直接解讀為機械負載低。電壓與電流的關係取決於完整回路阻抗，不能只看單一導體。簡化電阻模型能用來辨認分流、接觸與漏電的量級，但交流軌道電路還涉及頻率、相位與耦合；量到電壓存在並不等於接收端已可靠判定。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「馬達回路與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an isolated DC circuit to examine contact resistance and supply drop, avoiding interpretation of low current as necessarily low mechanical load. Voltage presence alone does not establish a valid receiver decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included. Explain the causal direction for motor circuit and contact behaviour, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.title: 馬達回路與接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Motor circuit and contact behaviour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「馬達回路與接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Motor circuit and contact behaviour” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。回到「馬達回路與接觸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Such experiments do not belong on an operating track. Trace the input chain for motor circuit and contact behaviour. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：純電阻穩態概念模型，未含交流電抗或任何現場占用判定門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Steady resistive teaching model; AC reactance and real occupancy thresholds are not included.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只量到供電端有電壓就可確認接收端一定正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Voltage at the supply terminal proves the receiver is operating correctly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。回到「馬達回路與接觸」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
