Trace the input chain for motor circuit and contact behaviour. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「馬達回路與接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Motor circuit and contact behaviour" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。
外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them.
A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating.
quiz.explanation: 接觸阻抗上升與供電下降都會降低電流，可用兩端電壓分布辨認，不能直接在營運軌道上試驗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Contact resistance and supply drop both reduce current; terminal voltage distribution distinguishes them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 等效持續發熱估算與傳動磨耗履歷
stages.titleEn: Equivalent sustained heating estimate & Transmission-wear history
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「等效持續發熱估算」與「傳動磨耗履歷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equivalent sustained heating estimate" and "Transmission-wear history": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 等效持續發熱估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equivalent sustained heating estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「等效持續發熱估算」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把頻繁轉換的週期平均發熱視為等效持續功率，僅估穩態溫度並檢查外殼量測是否漏掉內部熱點。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等效持續發熱估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「等效持續發熱估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equivalent sustained heating estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 等效持續發熱估算
knowledge.text: 本單元把頻繁轉換的週期平均發熱視為等效持續功率，僅估穩態溫度並檢查外殼量測是否漏掉內部熱點。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。
knowledge.textEn: Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal enclosure temperature proves that every internal component is free from overheating. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「等效持續發熱估算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equivalent sustained heating estimate" is correct?
options: 外殼溫度正常就能證明所有內部元件都沒有過熱

The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life.
Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot.

quiz.explanationEn: Treat duty-averaged heat from repeated movements as equivalent sustained power, estimating steady temperature only and checking whether enclosure measurements miss an internal hotspot. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 等效持續發熱估算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equivalent sustained heating estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「等效持續發熱估算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equivalent sustained heating estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：持續發熱 P=900 W；等效熱阻 Rth=0.035 K/W；環境溫度 ambient=30 degC。公式 y=ambient+P*Rth，代入得 y=61.5 degC。邊界：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: continuous heat P=900 W; equivalent thermal resistance Rth=0.035 K/W; ambient temperature ambient=30 degC. Formula y=ambient+P*Rth gives y=61.5 degC. Boundary: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄功率、環境與多點溫度，改變一項邊界條件以辨認熱源與熱阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record power, ambient and several temperatures together, changing one boundary to distinguish source and resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transmission-wear history” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤連接銷與齒輪間隙隨動作次數的變化，避免把短期磨合率當成全壽命磨耗率。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳動磨耗履歷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track pin and gear clearance with movement count rather than treating short running-in wear as a lifetime wear rate. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transmission-wear history” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation. For transmission-wear history, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把外推循環數 future 從 10000 改成 10001 cycles（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.2 變為 0.20002 mm。先說明「傳動磨耗履歷」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only extrapolated cycles future from 10000 to 10001 cycles (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.2 to 0.20002 mm. Explain the causal direction for transmission-wear history, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「傳動磨耗履歷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equal instantaneous actuator speeds prove that the accumulated position difference is zero.
Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation.

quiz.explanationEn: Repeat profile and cumulative-load measurements at identical positions, examine changes in segment slopes, and only then judge extrapolation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 傳動磨耗履歷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transmission-wear history: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「傳動磨耗履歷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transmission-wear history” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測基準改變可產生假磨耗，潤滑中斷則可能使後續斜率突然增大。回到「傳動磨耗履歷」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. Trace the input chain for transmission-wear history. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「前一個月的平均磨耗率能保證整個使用壽命都不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The previous month average wear rate is guaranteed to remain unchanged throughout life." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Changed measurement datum can create apparent wear; interrupted lubrication can sharply increase later wear rate. Trace the input chain for transmission-wear history. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機與動作與回授時間鏈
stages.titleEn: State machine for lock confirmation & Motion and feedback timing chain
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖閉確認狀態機」與「動作與回授時間鏈」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "State machine for lock confirmation" and "Motion and feedback timing chain": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: State machine for lock confirmation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鎖閉確認狀態機」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “State machine for lock confirmation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將行程完成、鎖閉與位置確認分成獨立條件，檢查任何單一訊號是否被錯當全部成立。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鎖閉確認狀態機」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate completed travel, locking and position confirmation, checking whether any one signal is incorrectly treated as proof of all conditions. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “State machine for lock confirmation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鎖閉確認狀態機」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “State machine for lock confirmation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機
knowledge.text: 本單元將行程完成、鎖閉與位置確認分成獨立條件，檢查任何單一訊號是否被錯當全部成立。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。
knowledge.textEn: Separate completed travel, locking and position confirmation, checking whether any one signal is incorrectly treated as proof of all conditions. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鎖閉確認狀態機」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "State machine for lock confirmation" is correct?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合

optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Separate completed travel, locking and position confirmation, checking whether any one signal is incorrectly treated as proof of all conditions.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將行程完成、鎖閉與位置確認分成獨立條件，檢查任何單一訊號是否被錯當全部成立。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機：定量估算
steps.titleEn: State machine for lock confirmation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鎖閉確認狀態機」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “State machine for lock confirmation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鎖閉確認狀態機」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的

A shorter lever arm always produces greater torque from the same force.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: State machine for lock confirmation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鎖閉確認狀態機」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “State machine for lock confirmation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用小型模型列舉轉移，再與需求允許的轉移表比較，對被排除狀態留下理由。以「鎖閉確認狀態機」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Enumerate transitions in a small model, compare against the required transition table, and document reasons for excluded states. For state machine for lock confirmation, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 鎖閉確認狀態機：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: State machine for lock confirmation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鎖閉確認狀態機」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “State machine for lock confirmation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「鎖閉確認狀態機」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for state machine for lock confirmation. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 動作與回授時間鏈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Motion and feedback timing chain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動作與回授時間鏈」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Motion and feedback timing chain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較命令、馬達啟動、行程結束與回授採用時刻，辨認機械延遲及介面延遲。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動作與回授時間鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare command, motor start, end of travel and feedback adoption to distinguish mechanical delay from interface delay. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Motion and feedback timing chain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「動作與回授時間鏈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Motion and feedback timing chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 動作與回授時間鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Motion and feedback timing chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動作與回授時間鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Motion and feedback timing chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 動作與回授時間鏈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Motion and feedback timing chain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動作與回授時間鏈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Motion and feedback timing chain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「動作與回授時間鏈」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For motion and feedback timing chain, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for motion and feedback timing chain, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉轍維修服務影響」如何影響鐵路道岔轉轍機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Service impact of point maintenance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway point machines”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將故障頻率與修復等待分開，辨認備品、定位診斷或機械調整何者主導不可用時間。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉轍維修服務影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate failure frequency from repair waiting to identify whether spares, diagnosis or mechanical adjustment dominates unavailable time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Service impact of point maintenance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉轍維修服務影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Service impact of point maintenance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉轍維修服務影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Service impact of point maintenance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉轍維修服務影響」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Service impact of point maintenance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「轉轍維修服務影響」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For service impact of point maintenance, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「轉轍維修服務影響」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for service impact of point maintenance, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「轉轍維修服務影響」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

steps.title: 轉轍維修服務影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service impact of point maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉轍維修服務影響」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Service impact of point maintenance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「轉轍維修服務影響」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for service impact of point maintenance. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「轉轍維修服務影響」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
Completing actuator travel guarantees safe mechanical locking.

title: 列車定位與里程融合
summary: 本課聚焦多感測定位的誤差相關性與完整性。從輪徑比例與里程建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把定位不確定度合成與融合感測時基漂移連成可驗證的介面，最後以失訊與錯圖案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies error correlation and integrity in multisensor train localization. Start with wheel-scale error and odometry to define physical or information boundaries, connect combining localization uncertainty with clock drift in sensor fusion as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through signal-loss and map-error cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑比例與里程。原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。敏感度只改 distance=1500 至 1650 m，輸出變為 6.8 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究局部通過速度觀測：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel-scale error and odometry. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. For sensitivity, change only distance=1500 to 1650 m; the output becomes 6.8 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate local passage-speed observations: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 輪徑比例與里程與局部通過速度觀測
stages.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry & Local passage-speed observations
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪徑比例與里程」與「局部通過速度觀測」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel-scale error and odometry" and "Local passage-speed observations": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪徑比例與里程」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel-scale error and odometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。輪滑與空轉使輪周距離不等於地面位移；定期地標校正能約束累積誤差，但地標本身的位置與辨識可信度仍須驗證。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪徑比例與里程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow. Slip makes wheel travel differ from ground displacement. Landmark updates can constrain drift, but the landmark position and identification credibility still require verification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel-scale error and odometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wheel-scale error and odometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪徑比例與里程
knowledge.text: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。輪徑與脈衝換算比例的誤差會隨行走距離累積，固定零點偏差則不隨距離放大。
knowledge.textEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. Wheel diameter and pulse-scale error accumulate with distance, whereas a fixed zero offset does not grow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪徑比例與里程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel-scale error and odometry" is correct?
options: 短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確
本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
optionsEn: Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以長短兩段已知路程分離比例誤差與固定偏移，避免單點校正掩蓋長距離漂移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use short and long known distances to separate scale error from fixed offset, preventing a single calibration point from concealing long-distance drift. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪徑比例與里程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel-scale error and odometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Formula y=distance*scale+bias gives y=6.2 m. Boundary: Constant scale error plus fixed offset; variable slip and wheel-wear history are not modelled. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。公式 y=distance*scale+bias，代入得 y=6.2 m。邊界：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪徑比例與里程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wheel-scale error and odometry", which statement holds?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
取樣頻率固定時不同速度的空間解析度也一定相同

Fixed sampling frequency gives identical spatial resolution at every speed.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=1500 m；比例誤差 scale=0.004 1；固定偏差 bias=0.2 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: travelled distance distance=1500 m; scale error scale=0.004 1; fixed offset bias=0.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪徑比例與里程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel-scale error and odometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在多個已知距離區段繪製殘差對距離，利用斜率與截距分別估計比例及零點。以「輪徑比例與里程」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot residual against several known travel distances and use slope and intercept to separate scale and zero-offset effects. For wheel-scale error and odometry, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把行走距離 distance 從 1500 改成 1650 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 6.2 變為 6.8 m。先說明「輪徑比例與里程」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only travelled distance distance from 1500 to 1650 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 6.2 to 6.8 m. Explain the causal direction for wheel-scale error and odometry, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wheel-scale error and odometry"?

Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.

steps.title: 輪徑比例與里程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel-scale error and odometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪徑比例與里程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel-scale error and odometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Trace the input chain for wheel-scale error and odometry. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定比例誤差與固定偏移，未包含時變輪滑或輪徑磨耗歷程。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。回到「輪徑比例與里程」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪徑比例與里程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wheel-scale error and odometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。
感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope.
Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
quiz.explanation: 一次短距離校正可能掩蓋比例誤差，輪滑事件則在殘差曲線留下突跳而非固定斜率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short calibration run can hide scale error; slip events cause residual jumps rather than a constant slope. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部通過速度觀測」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local passage-speed observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以雙感測點估計局部速度，討論事件配對錯誤如何在里程積分中變成位置跳變。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。時間解析度與輪緣幾何都影響結果；接近停車或往返擺動時，事件配對比公式本身更容易出錯。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部通過速度觀測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate local speed with paired sensing points and examine how event-pairing errors become position jumps when integrated into odometry. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed. Timing resolution and wheel geometry affect the estimate. Near standstill or during oscillatory movement, pairing the correct events is often harder than evaluating the equation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local passage-speed observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部通過速度觀測」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local passage-speed observations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部通過速度觀測
knowledge.text: 本單元以雙感測點估計局部速度，討論事件配對錯誤如何在里程積分中變成位置跳變。兩個相鄰感測點的事件先後順序可提供方向，間距除以時間差可估局部速度。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate local speed with paired sensing points and examine how event-pairing errors become position jumps when integrated into odometry. Event ordering across two nearby sensors provides direction, while separation divided by transit time estimates local speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部通過速度觀測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local passage-speed observations" is correct?
options: 感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度
兩個感測器讀值一致就能保證融合位置正確
本單元以雙感測點估計局部速度，討論事件配對錯誤如何在里程積分中變成位置跳變。
optionsEn: Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed.
Agreement between two sensors guarantees a correct fused position.
Estimate local speed with paired sensing points and examine how event-pairing errors become position jumps when integrated into odometry.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以雙感測點估計局部速度，討論事件配對錯誤如何在里程積分中變成位置跳變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate local speed with paired sensing points and examine how event-pairing errors become position jumps when integrated into odometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部通過速度觀測」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local passage-speed observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Formula y=spacing/dt gives y=20 m/s. Boundary: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。公式 y=spacing/dt，代入得 y=20 m/s。邊界：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「局部通過速度觀測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local passage-speed observations", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：感測點間距 spacing=0.3 m；通過時間差 dt=0.015 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensor separation spacing=0.3 m; passage time difference dt=0.015 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部通過速度觀測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local passage-speed observations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。以「局部通過速度觀測」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests. For local passage-speed observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把通過時間差 dt 從 0.015 改成 0.0165 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 20 變為 18.1818 m/s。先說明「局部通過速度觀測」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only passage time difference dt from 0.015 to 0.0165 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 20 to 18.1818 m/s. Explain the causal direction for local passage-speed observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。以「局部通過速度觀測」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For local passage-speed observations, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

Explain the causal direction for local passage-speed observations, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部通過速度觀測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local passage-speed observations"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 使用獨立位置尺與時間基準核對事件配對，包含低速、停止與反向的離線測試。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check event pairing against an independent ruler and clock, including low-speed, stopped and reversed offline tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部通過速度觀測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local passage-speed observations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部通過速度觀測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local passage-speed observations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將不同輪對的脈衝配成一對會產生不合理速度，反向回滾也會破壞單純遞增事件假設。回到「局部通過速度觀測」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pairing pulses from different wheelsets produces implausible speed; rollback violates assumptions of monotonically ordered events. Trace the input chain for local passage-speed observations. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同一輪對等速通過且事件配對正確，忽略感測區域寬度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One wheelset moving at constant speed with correct event pairing; sensing-zone width is neglected.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測點越近就能在所有速度下得到越精準的速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closer sensors always give more accurate speed at every operating speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 獨立觀測加權融合與定位不確定度合成
stages.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations & Combining localization uncertainty
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「獨立觀測加權融合」與「定位不確定度合成」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weighted fusion of independent observations" and "Combining localization uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations: mechanism and system paths

steps.title: 獨立觀測加權融合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weighted fusion of independent observations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立觀測加權融合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weighted fusion of independent observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：觀測一位置 x1=100 m；觀測二位置 x2=104 m；觀測一標準差 s1=2 m；觀測二標準差 s2=4 m。公式 y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)，代入得 y=100.8 m。邊界：兩個獨立高斯無偏位置觀測，不含跨時間濾波與完整性保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first observed position x1=100 m; second observed position x2=104 m; first standard deviation s1=2 m; second standard deviation s2=4 m. Formula y=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2) gives y=100.8 m. Boundary: Two independent Gaussian unbiased position observations, without temporal filtering or integrity assurance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use held-out independent truth to examine residual mean and spread, then test whether a shared offset remains detectable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weighted fusion of independent observations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以保留的獨立真值資料檢查殘差平均與分布，另測共同偏移時是否仍能被辨識。以「獨立觀測加權融合」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立觀測加權融合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weighted fusion of independent observations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同地圖誤差可讓兩感測器互相同意卻都錯，將相關性忽略會縮小不合理的信賴區間。回到「獨立觀測加權融合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 定位不確定度合成：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Combining localization uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「定位不確定度合成」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Combining localization uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元區分隨機標準差、最大界限與共同偏差，避免以平方和開根號縮小所有誤差。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定位不確定度合成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish random standard deviation, maximum bounds and common bias rather than reducing every error through root-sum-square combination. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「定位不確定度合成」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 本單元保留量測原始時間並估算資料變舊期間的前進距離，檢查高速時的誤差放大。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「延遲定位外推」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融合感測時基漂移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clock drift in sensor fusion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「融合感測時基漂移」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For clock drift in sensor fusion, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「融合感測時基漂移」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for clock drift in sensor fusion, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 區段占用作粗定位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Section occupancy as coarse location: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區段占用作粗定位」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section occupancy as coarse location” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把計軸區段占用當作粗範圍約束，明確指出它不能直接提供連續車頭位置。計軸占用利用邊界流入與流出守恆，計數差不是列車位置量測。差值為零仍需邊界感測器、方向判斷與狀態可信度成立；未知或故障狀態不能僅因兩個數字相等就自動宣告清空。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段占用作粗定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use axle-count section occupancy as a coarse range constraint, explicitly showing why it cannot directly provide continuous train-front position. Axle counting applies conservation at section boundaries; the count difference is not a position measurement. A zero difference is useful only when boundary sensing, direction and state validity are trustworthy. Unknown or failed states cannot be declared clear merely because two numbers match. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section occupancy as coarse location” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「進出計數剛好相同就能無條件證明區段無車」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段占用作粗定位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Section occupancy as coarse location”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
