steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：進入軸數 enter=48 axles；離開軸數 leave=44 axles。公式 y=enter-leave，代入得 y=4 axles。邊界：離線整數守恆模型，不含任何現場重置或解鎖程序。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: entering axles enter=48 axles; leaving axles leave=44 axles. Formula y=enter-leave gives y=4 axles. Boundary: Offline integer-conservation model without any real reset or release procedure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay a marked model vehicle in both directions and compare manual truth, event ordering and sensor-validity flags.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 漏計與多計可能互相抵消形成假零值，方向錯誤則會讓計數增減的符號顛倒。回到「區段占用作粗定位」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 定位處理管線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Localization processing pipeline: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「定位處理管線」如何影響列車定位與里程融合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Localization processing pipeline” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Train-position and odometry fusion”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤感測、濾波、地圖比對與輸出更新的時間，防止漂亮的定位誤差掩蓋過時結果。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定位處理管線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace sensing, filtering, map matching and output-update timing so an attractive position-error statistic cannot conceal stale results. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Localization processing pipeline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 定位處理管線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Localization processing pipeline: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定位處理管線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Localization processing pipeline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 定位處理管線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Localization processing pipeline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定位處理管線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Localization processing pipeline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「定位處理管線」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for localization processing pipeline. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 本單元建立隧道失訊、地圖偏移與輪滑的離線案例，要求融合結果能顯示不確定度而非假精準。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「失訊與錯圖案例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build offline cases for signal loss, map offset and wheel slip, requiring uncertainty to remain visible rather than reporting false precision. steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「失訊與錯圖案例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「失訊與錯圖案例」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「失訊與錯圖案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for signal-loss and map-error cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「失訊與錯圖案例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Signal-loss and map-error cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
短距離校正準確就能保證長距離里程也完全準確
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Accurate short-distance calibration guarantees perfectly accurate long-distance odometry.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鐵路時刻表衝突消解
summary: 本課聚焦資源占用與延誤傳播的時刻衝突消解。從區間占用時間建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把折返資源利用率與衝突優先權狀態連成可驗證的介面，最後以穩健時刻證據限制整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies timetable conflict resolution through resource occupation and delay propagation. Start with open-line occupation time to define physical or information boundaries, connect utilization of reversal resources with conflict-priority states as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through evidence limits for robust timetables. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究區間占用時間。原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。敏感度只改 S=420 至 462 m，輸出變為 62.8 s；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究交會緩衝分配：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate open-line occupation time. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. For sensitivity, change only S=420 to 462 m; the output becomes 62.8 s. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate allocating crossing buffers: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 區間占用時間與交會緩衝分配
stages.titleEn: Open-line occupation time & Allocating crossing buffers
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「區間占用時間」與「交會緩衝分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Open-line occupation time" and "Allocating crossing buffers": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 區間占用時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Open-line occupation time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區間占用時間」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Open-line occupation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。列車長度、防護距離與釋放時間會共同占用線路；車站停靠、路口衝突或折返可能比區間運轉更先成為瓶頸，所以縮小單一間隔不等於全線增能。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區間占用時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts. Train length, protected separation and release time occupy the route together. Dwell, conflicting junctions or terminal reversals can dominate capacity before open-line running does, so reducing one interval need not raise line throughput. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Open-line occupation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區間占用時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Open-line occupation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 區間占用時間
knowledge.text: 本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。班距是時間資源問題，不能僅用兩車車頭距離判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. Headway is a time-resource problem, not merely a distance between train fronts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「區間占用時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Open-line occupation time" is correct?
options: 只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。
同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
optionsEn: Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 本單元先將車長與防護間隔轉成時間，再比較不同區間的占用以找出最限制排程的資源。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert train length and protected spacing into time before comparing section occupations to identify the resource most restrictive to scheduling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 區間占用時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Open-line occupation time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區間占用時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Open-line occupation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。公式 y=(L+S)/v+td，代入得 y=60 s。邊界：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Formula y=(L+S)/v+td gives y=60 s. Boundary: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「區間占用時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Open-line occupation time", which statement holds?
options: 平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
原創假想教學輸入：列車占用長度 L=180 m；假想防護距離 S=420 m；等速速度 v=15 m/s；附加處理時間 td=20 s。
optionsEn: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupied train length L=180 m; hypothetical protected distance S=420 m; constant speed v=15 m/s; additional processing time td=20 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 區間占用時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Open-line occupation time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「區間占用時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Open-line occupation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。以「區間占用時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. For open-line occupation time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「區間占用時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only hypothetical protected distance S from 420 to 462 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 60 to 62.8 s. Explain the causal direction for open-line occupation time, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

For open-line occupation time, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把假想防護距離 S 從 420 改成 462 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 60 變為 62.8 s。先說明「區間占用時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

quiz.question: 要驗證「區間占用時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Open-line occupation time"?
options: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 以時空圖標出車尾清空與資源釋放時刻，再檢查月台、道岔及折返各自的占用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark rear clearance and resource release on a time-distance diagram, then examine platform, point and reversal occupation separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 區間占用時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Open-line occupation time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「區間占用時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Open-line occupation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「區間占用時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Trace the input chain for open-line occupation time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速單一資源的概念下界，不是任何號誌系統的實際最小班距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual lower bound for one resource at constant speed, not an operating minimum for any signalling system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。回到「區間占用時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for open-line occupation time. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「區間占用時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Open-line occupation time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。
同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere.
The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 將車頭離站當成月台路徑已清空會低估占用時間，瓶頸轉移則會造成局部改善卻全線延誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating front departure as complete route clearance understates occupation; a shifted bottleneck can improve one section while delays persist elsewhere. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 交會緩衝分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Allocating crossing buffers: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「交會緩衝分配」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Allocating crossing buffers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元為單線交會配置獨立餘裕，檢查一列車晚到時另一列車的等待如何向後傳播。時刻表餘裕是已排間隔扣除占用與擾動後的剩餘時間。餘裕可以吸收小延誤，卻不是可隨意重複使用的免費容量；同一段緩衝若被兩個衝突約束同時借用，紙面上可行的時刻仍會在實際重播中互相追趕。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「交會緩衝分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Assign distinct margins to a single-track meet and examine how one late arrival propagates waiting to the opposing train. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation. It can absorb small delays but is not free capacity that may be reused indefinitely. If two conflicting constraints both claim the same buffer, a timetable that appears feasible on paper can still produce converging delays in replay. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Allocating crossing buffers” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「交會緩衝分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Allocating crossing buffers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Assign distinct margins to a single-track meet and examine how one late arrival propagates waiting to the opposing train. Timetable margin is scheduled separation less occupation and perturbation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交會緩衝分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Allocating crossing buffers" is correct?
options: 同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元為單線交會配置獨立餘裕，檢查一列車晚到時另一列車的等待如何向後傳播。
optionsEn: The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Assign distinct margins to a single-track meet and examine how one late arrival propagates waiting to the opposing train.
quiz.explanation: 本單元為單線交會配置獨立餘裕，檢查一列車晚到時另一列車的等待如何向後傳播。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Assign distinct margins to a single-track meet and examine how one late arrival propagates waiting to the opposing train. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交會緩衝分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Allocating crossing buffers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交會緩衝分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Allocating crossing buffers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：排定間隔 scheduled=140 s；資源占用 occupied=110 s；入侵延誤 delay=18 s。公式 y=scheduled-occupied-delay，代入得 y=12 s。邊界：單一衝突資源與確定延誤，未求解整個網路的隨機時刻最佳化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: scheduled interval scheduled=140 s; resource occupation occupied=110 s; incoming delay delay=18 s. Formula y=scheduled-occupied-delay gives y=12 s. Boundary: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 交會緩衝分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Allocating crossing buffers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「交會緩衝分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Allocating crossing buffers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每一段餘裕標記唯一用途，逐列重播延誤，檢查負餘裕是否傳到下一個路口。以「交會緩衝分配」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assign each buffer a unique purpose, replay train delays in sequence, and check whether negative margin propagates to the next junction. For allocating crossing buffers, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把入侵延誤 delay 從 18 改成 19.8 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 12 變為 10.2 s。先說明「交會緩衝分配」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only incoming delay delay from 18 to 19.8 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 12 to 10.2 s. Explain the causal direction for allocating crossing buffers, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: One conflicting resource and a deterministic delay; no stochastic network-wide timetable optimization is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一段時刻餘裕可以同時完整吸收所有列車延誤」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same timetable buffer can fully absorb every train delay simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複計入同一緩衝會掩蓋衝突；把終點補時誤算為上游路口可用時間也會高估穩健度。回到「交會緩衝分配」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Trace the input chain for allocating crossing buffers. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「交會緩衝分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.

quiz.explanationEn: Double-counted buffers hide conflicts; recovery time at a terminus cannot automatically be used at an earlier junction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 停站變異傳播與折返資源利用率
stages.titleEn: Propagation of dwell variability & Utilization of reversal resources
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停站變異傳播」與「折返資源利用率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Propagation of dwell variability" and "Utilization of reversal resources": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停站變異傳播：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Propagation of dwell variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停站變異傳播」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Propagation of dwell variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停站變異傳播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Propagation of dwell variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停站變異傳播」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Propagation of dwell variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停站變異傳播
knowledge.text: 本單元把旅客登車波動轉成停站時間變化，檢查月台服務是否比區間運轉更先控制容量。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。

quiz.question: 關於「停站變異傳播」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
optionsEn: Convert boarding variation into dwell-time change and test whether platform service constrains capacity before open-line running does.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.

steps.title: 停站變異傳播：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Propagation of dwell variability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「停站變異傳播」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停站變異傳播」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Propagation of dwell variability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
optionsEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
quiz.explanation: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Utilization of reversal resources: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「折返資源利用率」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Utilization of reversal resources” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將折返股道視為有限服務通道，檢查平均需求、尖峰到達與設備中斷的差異。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。平均需求小於平均容量仍可能出現短暫尖峰與排隊；若排程把所有時段填滿，任何變異都只能向後傳播，缺乏讓系統恢復的空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「折返資源利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Treat reversal tracks as finite service channels and distinguish mean demand, peak arrivals and equipment interruptions. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer. Mean demand below mean capacity still permits bursts and queues. When every interval is fully occupied, variability propagates downstream because no recovery space remains. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Utilization of reversal resources” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「折返資源利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Utilization of reversal resources”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 折返資源利用率
knowledge.text: 本單元將折返股道視為有限服務通道，檢查平均需求、尖峰到達與設備中斷的差異。利用率比較需求與服務能力，是穩定性檢查而非等待時間的完整答案。
knowledge.textEn: Treat reversal tracks as finite service channels and distinguish mean demand, peak arrivals and equipment interruptions. Utilization compares demand with service capacity; it is a stability check rather than a complete waiting-time answer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「折返資源利用率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Utilization of reversal resources" is correct?
options: 平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊
本單元將折返股道視為有限服務通道，檢查平均需求、尖峰到達與設備中斷的差異。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms.
Treat reversal tracks as finite service channels and distinguish mean demand, peak arrivals and equipment interruptions.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將折返股道視為有限服務通道，檢查平均需求、尖峰到達與設備中斷的差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Treat reversal tracks as finite service channels and distinguish mean demand, peak arrivals and equipment interruptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Utilization of reversal resources: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「折返資源利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Utilization of reversal resources” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。公式 y=arrival/service，代入得 y=0.666667 1。邊界：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Formula y=arrival/service gives y=0.666667 1. Boundary: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「折返資源利用率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Utilization of reversal resources", which statement holds?
options: 狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。
optionsEn: Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=8 jobs/h；單通道服務率 service=12 jobs/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=8 jobs/h; single-channel service rate service=12 jobs/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Utilization of reversal resources: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「折返資源利用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Utilization of reversal resources” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「折返資源利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of reversal resources, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「折返資源利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of reversal resources, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。以「折返資源利用率」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. For utilization of reversal resources, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把平均到達率 arrival 從 8 改成 8.8 jobs/h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.666667 變為 0.733333 1。先說明「折返資源利用率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only mean arrival rate arrival from 8 to 8.8 jobs/h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.666667 to 0.733333 1. Explain the causal direction for utilization of reversal resources, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「折返資源利用率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Utilization of reversal resources"?
options: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
optionsEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
quiz.explanation: 以不同時間窗統計到達與完成數，檢查平均值是否掩蓋短時過載，並保留未完成工作。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count arrivals and completions over several windows, test for hidden bursts, and retain unfinished work in the accounting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 折返資源利用率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Utilization of reversal resources: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「折返資源利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Utilization of reversal resources” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「折返資源利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of reversal resources. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定平均率且單一服務通道；實際批次、優先權與休息中斷須另建模。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Fixed mean rates and one service channel; batches, priorities and interruptions require separate modelling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均利用率低於百分之百就保證完全不會排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean utilization below one hundred percent guarantees that no queue ever forms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。回到「折返資源利用率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Trace the input chain for utilization of reversal resources. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「折返資源利用率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Utilization of reversal resources" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。
出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 只統計完成案件會漏掉被延後或放棄者，使負荷被低估；設備停機又會降低可用服務率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting only completed jobs omits deferred or abandoned demand and understates loading; downtime also reduces available service rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 月台旅客積壓與實績時刻對齊
stages.titleEn: Passenger accumulation at platforms & Aligning recorded operating times
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台旅客積壓」與「實績時刻對齊」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Passenger accumulation at platforms" and "Aligning recorded operating times": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台旅客積壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Passenger accumulation at platforms: mechanism and system paths

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aligning recorded operating times” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元核對車站與列車記錄的時基，避免把系統時間偏差當作需要調整的時刻衝突。時鐘頻率偏差會隨時間累積成時間差，校時瞬間的偏移與之不同。多系統事件排序若依不同時鐘，可能把因果順序顛倒；校時跳變又會使量測區間長度失真，所以需記錄時鐘品質與校正事件。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「實績時刻對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Check clocks in station and train records so timebase offset is not misidentified as a timetable conflict requiring intervention. Clock frequency error accumulates into time offset and differs from initial synchronization offset. Ordering multisystem events on different clocks can reverse apparent causality. Synchronization jumps can distort interval lengths, so clock quality and correction events must be recorded. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aligning recorded operating times” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 實績時刻對齊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aligning recorded operating times: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實績時刻對齊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aligning recorded operating times” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：時鐘頻率偏差 drift=20 ppm；未校時期間 duration=3600 s。公式 y=drift*1e-6*duration，代入得 y=0.072 s。邊界：固定頻率偏差的線性累積，忽略溫度漂移與校時伺服動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: clock frequency offset drift=20 ppm; unsynchronized interval duration=3600 s. Formula y=drift*1e-6*duration gives y=0.072 s. Boundary: Linear accumulation at fixed frequency offset; temperature drift and synchronization-servo dynamics are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 實績時刻對齊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aligning recorded operating times: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實績時刻對齊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aligning recorded operating times” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立時間基準比較多個時刻的偏移，從斜率分辨頻率誤差與一次性跳變。以「實績時刻對齊」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare offsets at several times against an independent reference, using slope to distinguish frequency error from a one-time jump. For aligning recorded operating times, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把未校時期間 duration 從 3600 改成 3960 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072 變為 0.0792 s。先說明「實績時刻對齊」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only unsynchronized interval duration from 3600 to 3960 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.072 to 0.0792 s. Explain the causal direction for aligning recorded operating times, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 實績時刻對齊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aligning recorded operating times: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實績時刻對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aligning recorded operating times” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只對齊開始時刻卻忽略頻率漂移，會讓長測試中的事件逐漸錯位，並誤判通訊延遲。回到「實績時刻對齊」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aligning only the initial instant leaves frequency drift uncorrected, progressively misaligning events and suggesting false network delay. Trace the input chain for aligning recorded operating times. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 衝突優先權狀態：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 本單元列舉讓行、等待與資源保留的抽象狀態，檢查局部決策是否形成循環等待。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衝突優先權狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Enumerate abstract yield, wait and reservation states to check whether local decisions create a circular wait. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。公式 y=2**bits，代入得 y=256 states。邊界：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: number of Boolean state variables bits=8 bits. Formula y=2**bits gives y=256 states. Boundary: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「擾動情境覆蓋」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擾動情境覆蓋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coverage of disruption scenarios” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「擾動情境覆蓋」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for coverage of disruption scenarios. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 時刻重播工作量與穩健時刻證據限制
stages.titleEn: Timetable-replay effort & Evidence limits for robust timetables
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「時刻重播工作量」與「穩健時刻證據限制」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Timetable-replay effort" and "Evidence limits for robust timetables": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 時刻重播工作量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Timetable-replay effort: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時刻重播工作量」如何影響鐵路時刻表衝突消解的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Timetable-replay effort” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway timetable conflict resolution”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元規畫多個需求水準與擾動組合的重播，保留初始列車位置和旅客需求以利比較。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時刻重播工作量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Plan replay over demand levels and disruption combinations, retaining initial train positions and passenger demand for meaningful comparison. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Timetable-replay effort” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時刻重播工作量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 時刻重播工作量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時刻重播工作量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Timetable-replay effort” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：測試案例數 cases=120 cases；平均案例時間 minutes=8 min/case；設定與恢復時間 setup=180 min。公式 y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60，代入得 y=19 h。邊界：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: test cases cases=120 cases; mean case duration minutes=8 min/case; setup and recovery time setup=180 min. Formula y=(cases*minutes+setup)/60 gives y=19 h. Boundary: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐案記錄前置狀態、執行時間與復原時間，分開列出正常完成和失敗重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record preconditions, execution and restoration for every case, separating normal completion from failure reruns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
