quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 少量受試結果外推：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Extrapolating limited user trials: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「少量受試結果外推」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Extrapolating limited user trials” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「少量受試結果外推」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For extrapolating limited user trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「少量受試結果外推」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for extrapolating limited user trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「少量受試結果外推」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For extrapolating limited user trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「少量受試結果外推」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for extrapolating limited user trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「少量受試結果外推」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Extrapolating limited user trials"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
照明平均值足夠就保證所有角落都能清楚辨識出口
optionsEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate mean lighting guarantees clear exit recognition at every corner.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 少量受試結果外推：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Extrapolating limited user trials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「少量受試結果外推」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Extrapolating limited user trials” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「少量受試結果外推」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for extrapolating limited user trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「少量受試結果外推」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for extrapolating limited user trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「少量受試結果外推」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Extrapolating limited user trials" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
操作員把所有警報點選確認就代表根本問題都已解決
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Acknowledging every alarm means that all underlying problems have been solved.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鐵路號誌失效安全分析
summary: 本課聚焦號誌危害邏輯共同原因與證據鏈。從頂事件邏輯選擇建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把安全性質的狀態域與危害需求追溯連成可驗證的介面，最後以變更後證據重建整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies signalling hazard logic common causes and evidence chains. Start with selecting top-event logic to define physical or information boundaries, connect state domain of safety properties with tracing hazards to requirements as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through rebuilding evidence after change. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究頂事件邏輯選擇。原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。敏感度只改 p1=0.001 至 0.0011 1，輸出變為 0.0030978 1；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究共同原因殘餘風險：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate selecting top-event logic. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. For sensitivity, change only p1=0.001 to 0.0011 1; the output becomes 0.0030978 1. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate residual common-cause risk: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇與共同原因殘餘風險
stages.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic & Residual common-cause risk
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂事件邏輯選擇」與「共同原因殘餘風險」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Selecting top-event logic" and "Residual common-cause risk": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂事件邏輯選擇」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Selecting top-event logic” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂事件邏輯選擇」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Selecting top-event logic” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂事件邏輯選擇」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Selecting top-event logic”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇
knowledge.text: 本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂事件邏輯選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Selecting top-event logic" is correct?
options: 任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘
本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
optionsEn: If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product.
Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
quiz.explanation: 本單元先辨認任一失效與同時失效的差別，再以原創機率練習檢查失效樹的邏輯。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish either-failure from simultaneous-failure conditions before using original probability exercises to check fault-tree logic. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂事件邏輯選擇」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Selecting top-event logic” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。公式 y=p1+p2-p1*p2，代入得 y=0.002998 1。邊界：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: event one probability p1=0.001 1; event two probability p2=0.002 1. Formula y=p1+p2-p1*p2 gives y=0.002998 1. Boundary: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 先畫頂事件邏輯再代機率，明列共享資源並檢查事件時間窗是否一致。以「頂事件邏輯選擇」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw top-event logic before inserting probabilities, list shared resources, and check consistent time windows. Explain the causal direction for selecting top-event logic, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂事件邏輯選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Selecting top-event logic"?

steps.title: 頂事件邏輯選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Selecting top-event logic: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂事件邏輯選擇」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Selecting top-event logic” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「頂事件邏輯選擇」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for selecting top-event logic. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任一支路故障即失效時總機率等於兩機率相乘」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。回到「頂事件邏輯選擇」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Trace the input chain for selecting top-event logic. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂事件邏輯選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Selecting top-event logic" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
quiz.explanation: 把聯集誤寫成交集會低估危險；混合年度機率與每小時機率則使結果失去量綱意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing a union with an intersection understates risk; mixing annual and hourly probabilities destroys the intended meaning. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 共同原因殘餘風險：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual common-cause risk: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共同原因殘餘風險」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual common-cause risk” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將共享電源、環境與需求錯誤列入雙通道分析，觀察獨立故障降低後何者成為主導。兩支路都失效才失去功能的架構可降低獨立故障貢獻，卻不能消除共同原因。共同電源、相同軟體缺陷或同處淹水會同時影響兩支路；因此增加硬體數量不能取代分離、異質性與失效偵測的證據。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同原因殘餘風險」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Include shared power, environment and requirement errors in a dual-channel analysis, observing what dominates after independent failures are reduced. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes. Shared power, identical software defects or flooding at one location can affect both branches. More hardware does not replace evidence for separation, diversity and fault detection. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual common-cause risk” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共同原因殘餘風險」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual common-cause risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共同原因殘餘風險

knowledge.textEn: Include shared power, environment and requirement errors in a dual-channel analysis, observing what dominates after independent failures are reduced. A function lost only when both branches fail can reduce independent contributions but cannot eliminate common causes.

knowledge.text: 誤解：裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共同原因殘餘風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障

optionsEn: Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.

steps.observation: 如何核對：把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。公式 y=common+(1-common)*p*p，代入得 y=0.000104 1。邊界：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Formula y=common+(1-common)*p*p gives y=0.000104 1. Boundary: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共同原因殘餘風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Residual common-cause risk", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立支路失效機率 p=0.002 1；共同原因事件機率 common=0.0001 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent branch failure probability p=0.002 1; common-cause event probability common=0.0001 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共同原因殘餘風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual common-cause risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共同原因殘餘風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual common-cause risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「共同原因殘餘風險」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For residual common-cause risk, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「共同原因殘餘風險」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only common-cause event probability common from 0.0001 to 0.00011 1 (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.000104 to 0.000114 1. Explain the causal direction for residual common-cause risk, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。以「共同原因殘餘風險」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. For residual common-cause risk, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把共同原因事件機率 common 從 0.0001 改成 0.00011 1（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.000104 變為 0.000114 1。先說明「共同原因殘餘風險」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。

Explain the causal direction for residual common-cause risk, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共同原因殘餘風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Residual common-cause risk"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
quiz.explanation: 把獨立與共同原因兩類試驗分開，在隔離試驗台檢查共享介面失效的影響。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate independent and common-cause tests, using an isolated bench to examine failures of shared interfaces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共同原因殘餘風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Residual common-cause risk: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共同原因殘餘風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual common-cause risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「共同原因殘餘風險」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for residual common-cause risk. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：共同原因先發生的簡化條件模型，其餘支路相互獨立；非安全等級認證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple conditional model with common cause considered first and remaining branches independent; no safety-level certification is implied.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。回到「共同原因殘餘風險」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Trace the input chain for residual common-cause risk. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共同原因殘餘風險」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Residual common-cause risk" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch.
quiz.explanation: 共享電源中斷會讓看似雙備援同時失去功能，若故障偵測也共用同一支路更可能誤報正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Loss of a shared supply can defeat apparently duplicated equipment, especially if fault detection depends on that same branch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 安全性與可用度分離與安全性質的狀態域
stages.titleEn: Separating safety and availability & State domain of safety properties
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安全性與可用度分離」與「安全性質的狀態域」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Separating safety and availability" and "State domain of safety properties": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安全性與可用度分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Separating safety and availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「安全性與可用度分離」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Separating safety and availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較安全停止與危險繼續輸出兩種後果，避免以服務持續時間推論危害發生機率。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安全性與可用度分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare safe withdrawal with hazardous continued output, avoiding inference of hazard probability from service uptime. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Separating safety and availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「安全性與可用度分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Separating safety and availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安全性與可用度分離
knowledge.text: 本單元比較安全停止與危險繼續輸出兩種後果，避免以服務持續時間推論危害發生機率。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。
knowledge.textEn: Compare safe withdrawal with hazardous continued output, avoiding inference of hazard probability from service uptime. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安全性與可用度分離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Separating safety and availability" is correct?
options: 本單元比較安全停止與危險繼續輸出兩種後果，避免以服務持續時間推論危害發生機率。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Compare safe withdrawal with hazardous continued output, avoiding inference of hazard probability from service uptime.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較安全停止與危險繼續輸出兩種後果，避免以服務持續時間推論危害發生機率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare safe withdrawal with hazardous continued output, avoiding inference of hazard probability from service uptime. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安全性與可用度分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Separating safety and availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安全性與可用度分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Separating safety and availability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。

steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「安全性與可用度分離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “State domain of safety properties” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元定義性質需涵蓋的可達狀態，特別保留故障與恢復而不只列正常運轉。布林狀態組合隨變數個數指數成長，這說明逐一人工檢查很快失去效率。可達性約束能排除不可能組合，但刪除條件必須有證據；安全性質通常針對所有可達狀態，而非幾個畫面上看起來合理的狀態。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安全性質的狀態域」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Define the reachable states over which a property must hold, retaining fault and recovery states rather than only normal operation. Boolean combinations grow exponentially with variable count, explaining why manual enumeration soon becomes ineffective. Reachability constraints can eliminate impossible combinations, but each exclusion needs justification. Safety properties normally concern every reachable state rather than a few states that look plausible on a display. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “State domain of safety properties” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：布林變數數量 bits=8 bits。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 安全性質的狀態域：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: State domain of safety properties: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安全性質的狀態域」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “State domain of safety properties” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。回到「安全性質的狀態域」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races. Trace the input chain for state domain of safety properties. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：未限制的布林笛卡兒積；實際可達狀態通常較少，但需另證明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Unconstrained Boolean Cartesian product; actual reachability can be smaller but must be established separately.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for state domain of safety properties. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安全性質的狀態域」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "State domain of safety properties" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Excluding sensor-fault states can remove the crucial boundary from a proof; overly coarse abstraction may hide timing races.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 把感測器故障狀態預先刪掉會讓證明失去關鍵邊界，狀態抽象過粗也可能隱藏時序競爭。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 偵測與安全反應時間與故障資訊可靠傳遞
stages.titleEn: Detection and safe-response timing & Reliable transfer of fault information
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「偵測與安全反應時間」與「故障資訊可靠傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Detection and safe-response timing" and "Reliable transfer of fault information": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 偵測與安全反應時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Detection and safe-response timing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「偵測與安全反應時間」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Detection and safe-response timing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元串接異常感測、判定與安全反應時間，清楚標示各段假設與未建模的致動延遲。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偵測與安全反應時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link anomaly sensing, decision and safe response timing, explicitly marking assumptions and actuator delays not represented by a model. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Detection and safe-response timing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「偵測與安全反應時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Detection and safe-response timing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 偵測與安全反應時間
knowledge.text: 本單元串接異常感測、判定與安全反應時間，清楚標示各段假設與未建模的致動延遲。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。
knowledge.textEn: Link anomaly sensing, decision and safe response timing, explicitly marking assumptions and actuator delays not represented by a model. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性
本單元串接異常感測、判定與安全反應時間，清楚標示各段假設與未建模的致動延遲。

The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
Link anomaly sensing, decision and safe response timing, explicitly marking assumptions and actuator delays not represented by a model.

steps.title: 偵測與安全反應時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detection and safe-response timing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「偵測與安全反應時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Detection and safe-response timing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。

Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「偵測與安全反應時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Detection and safe-response timing", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s。
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果

Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 偵測與安全反應時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Detection and safe-response timing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「偵測與安全反應時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Detection and safe-response timing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「偵測與安全反應時間」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For detection and safe-response timing, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「偵測與安全反應時間」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for detection and safe-response timing, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. steps.instruction: 本單元比較獨立丟包與共同失聯對故障通報的影響，將訊息可靠送達與仍然及時分開。獨立封包遺失可以相乘得到連續遺失機率，但實際無線遮蔽常造成成串遺失。增加重送次數會占用時間與頻寬，不能把可靠度與時效分開最佳化；舊封包即使最後送達，也可能已不適合當前控制。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「故障資訊可靠傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare independent losses and common outages in fault reporting, separating eventual delivery from delivery while the information remains timely. Retransmissions consume time and bandwidth, so reliability and freshness cannot be optimized independently. A packet eventually delivered may already be too old for the current control decision. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model. quiz.explanation: 同時統計單包遺失率與最長連續遺失段，將結果和獨立模型比較以辨識相關性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure single-packet loss and the longest loss burst together, then compare them with the independent model to identify correlation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 故障資訊可靠傳遞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reliable transfer of fault information: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「故障資訊可靠傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reliable transfer of fault information” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把成串失聯當成獨立事件會嚴重低估尾端風險，時間戳重排也可能讓重送掩蓋陳舊資料。回到「故障資訊可靠傳遞」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating burst outages as independent events understates tail risk; reordered timestamps may also hide stale retransmissions. Trace the input chain for reliable transfer of fault information. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：明確假設各次遺失獨立同分布，不適用遮蔽引起的相關失聯。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Losses are explicitly independent and identically distributed; correlated outages are outside the model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把成串失聯當成獨立事件會嚴重低估尾端風險，時間戳重排也可能讓重送掩蓋陳舊資料。回到「故障資訊可靠傳遞」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Treating burst outages as independent events understates tail risk; reordered timestamps may also hide stale retransmissions. Trace the input chain for reliable transfer of fault information. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「故障資訊可靠傳遞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reliable transfer of fault information" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Treating burst outages as independent events understates tail risk; reordered timestamps may also hide stale retransmissions.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating burst outages as independent events understates tail risk; reordered timestamps may also hide stale retransmissions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 危害需求追溯與零失效證據解讀
stages.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements & Interpreting zero-failure evidence
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「危害需求追溯」與「零失效證據解讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tracing hazards to requirements" and "Interpreting zero-failure evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「危害需求追溯」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tracing hazards to requirements” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「危害需求追溯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tracing hazards to requirements” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「危害需求追溯」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tracing hazards to requirements”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 危害需求追溯
knowledge.text: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。
knowledge.textEn: Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「危害需求追溯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tracing hazards to requirements" is correct?
options: 測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。

optionsEn: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 本單元建立危害、控制措施、需求與試驗的連結，將缺少證據的項目明列而不以總百分比掩蓋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Link hazards, controls, requirements and tests, listing missing evidence explicitly rather than concealing it inside an overall percentage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「危害需求追溯」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tracing hazards to requirements” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。公式 y=tested/total，代入得 y=0.8 1。邊界：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Formula y=tested/total gives y=0.8 1. Boundary: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「危害需求追溯」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tracing hazards to requirements", which statement holds?
options: 所有整合測試都可以同時執行而完全不影響結果
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
optionsEn: All integration tests can run simultaneously without affecting results.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 危害需求追溯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tracing hazards to requirements: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「危害需求追溯」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tracing hazards to requirements” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。以「危害需求追溯」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. For tracing hazards to requirements, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把已執行案例 tested 從 72 改成 73 cases（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.8 變為 0.811111 1。先說明「危害需求追溯」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only executed cases tested from 72 to 73 cases (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.8 to 0.811111 1. Explain the causal direction for tracing hazards to requirements, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tracing hazards to requirements"?

steps.title: 零失效證據解讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「零失效證據解讀」如何影響鐵路號誌失效安全分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fail-safe analysis of railway signaling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從有限試驗推導單側機率上界，說明不能以零失敗取代系統性故障的設計論證。零次觀察到失效不代表真實失效機率為零。獨立伯努利試驗可由全數成功的機率反推單側上界，試驗數增加才會縮小界限；相關測試或只選容易案例會使這個統計推論不再成立，也不能由此宣告達到安全完整性等級。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「零失效證據解讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Derive a one-sided probability bound from finite trials and explain why zero failures cannot replace arguments about systematic design faults. Zero observed failures does not imply zero true failure probability. Independent Bernoulli trials allow a one-sided upper bound from the probability of all successes, which decreases with sample count. Correlated or selectively easy cases invalidate this inference and cannot establish a safety-integrity level. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「零失效證據解讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Interpreting zero-failure evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 零失效證據解讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「零失效證據解讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。公式 y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests)，代入得 y=0.00993608 failure probability。邊界：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.titleEn: Interpreting zero-failure evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「零失效證據解讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interpreting zero-failure evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「零失效證據解讀」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies.
