Equal entry and exit counts unconditionally prove that a section is empty.
quiz.explanation: 建立需求到案例的一對多追溯表，將未測、失敗與不適用分開，抽查原始證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build requirement-to-case traceability, separate untested, failed and inapplicable cases, and sample raw evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 路鐵整合情境矩陣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Road–rail integration scenario matrix: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路鐵整合情境矩陣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Road–rail integration scenario matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「路鐵整合情境矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for road–rail integration scenario matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「路鐵整合情境矩陣」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for road–rail integration scenario matrix. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「路鐵整合情境矩陣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Road–rail integration scenario matrix" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。
制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised.
Good braking performance allows reaction distance to be ignored completely.
quiz.explanation: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 月台門列車停準整合
summary: 本課聚焦停車位置門控時序與月台介面誤差預算。從停準接近軌跡建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把重複停準統計分散與旅客交換與門週期連成可驗證的介面，最後以停準試驗樣本界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies stopping position door timing and platform-interface error budgets. Start with precision-stop approach trajectory to define physical or information boundaries, connect statistical spread of repeated stops with passenger exchange and door cycle as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through sampling limits of stopping trials. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究停準接近軌跡。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究停準資訊有效時間：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate precision-stop approach trajectory. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate freshness of stopping information: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 停準接近軌跡與停準資訊有效時間
stages.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory & Freshness of stopping information
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停準接近軌跡」與「停準資訊有效時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Precision-stop approach trajectory" and "Freshness of stopping information": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準接近軌跡」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Precision-stop approach trajectory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準接近軌跡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Precision-stop approach trajectory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準接近軌跡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Precision-stop approach trajectory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停準接近軌跡
knowledge.text: 本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。
knowledge.textEn: Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停準接近軌跡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Precision-stop approach trajectory" is correct?
options: 速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
optionsEn: Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將車門對位誤差追溯到進站速度與制動建立時間，分開縱向停準與橫向月台間隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace door-alignment errors to approach speed and brake build-up, distinguishing longitudinal stopping accuracy from the lateral platform gap. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準接近軌跡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Precision-stop approach trajectory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停準接近軌跡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Precision-stop approach trajectory", which statement holds?
options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
optionsEn: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停準接近軌跡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Precision-stop approach trajectory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準接近軌跡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Precision-stop approach trajectory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「停準接近軌跡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For precision-stop approach trajectory, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「停準接近軌跡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for precision-stop approach trajectory, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Precision-stop approach trajectory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「停準接近軌跡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 停準資訊有效時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Freshness of stopping information: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準資訊有效時間」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freshness of stopping information” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較最後定位點到開門判定的資料年齡，理解車速接近零仍不代表資料來源已被確認。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準資訊有效時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare data age between the final position observation and the door decision; near-zero speed does not establish that the position source has been validated. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Freshness of stopping information” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly received packet always contains the present position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準資訊有效時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準資訊有效時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freshness of stopping information” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.

steps.title: 停準資訊有效時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Freshness of stopping information: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準資訊有效時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Freshness of stopping information” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「停準資訊有效時間」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for freshness of stopping information. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A newly received packet always contains the present position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 車門月台橫向容差與重複停準統計分散
stages.titleEn: Lateral door–platform tolerances & Statistical spread of repeated stops
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「車門月台橫向容差」與「重複停準統計分散」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lateral door–platform tolerances" and "Statistical spread of repeated stops": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 車門月台橫向容差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral door–platform tolerances: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車門月台橫向容差」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral door–platform tolerances” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元列出軌道偏移、車體側移與量測基準的界限，避免把縱向停準良好誤當全部幾何介面良好。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。保守界限可直接相加，而隨機誤差合成必須有分布與相關性證據；只在空車靜止狀態量一個間隙，無法代表載重與動態情境。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車門月台橫向容差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: List bounds for track offset, body movement and survey references, avoiding the assumption that good longitudinal stopping establishes every geometric interface. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error. Conservative bounds can be summed, while stochastic combination requires evidence for distributions and correlation. One stationary empty-vehicle measurement cannot represent loaded and dynamic conditions. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral door–platform tolerances” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車門月台橫向容差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lateral door–platform tolerances”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 本單元列出軌道偏移、車體側移與量測基準的界限，避免把縱向停準良好誤當全部幾何介面良好。月台與車體介面的間隙預算需分開列入軌道幾何、懸吊移動與測量誤差。
knowledge.textEn: List bounds for track offset, body movement and survey references, avoiding the assumption that good longitudinal stopping establishes every geometric interface. A platform-vehicle gap budget separates track geometry, suspension movement and survey error.

knowledge.text: 誤解：三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車門月台橫向容差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: List bounds for track offset, body movement and survey references, avoiding the assumption that good longitudinal stopping establishes every geometric interface.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.

steps.title: 車門月台橫向容差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral door–platform tolerances: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車門月台橫向容差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral door–platform tolerances” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：軌道偏移界 track=8 mm；車體位移界 body=10 mm；測量誤差界 survey=3 mm。公式 y=track+body+survey，代入得 y=21 mm。邊界：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: track offset bound track=8 mm; body displacement bound body=10 mm; survey error bound survey=3 mm. Formula y=track+body+survey gives y=21 mm. Boundary: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 車門月台橫向容差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral door–platform tolerances: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車門月台橫向容差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral door–platform tolerances” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立共同座標，對空載、載重及不同車型分別量測，並保留各誤差來源的符號。以「車門月台橫向容差」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish one coordinate system, measure empty and loaded vehicles of each type, and retain signs of individual error sources. For lateral door–platform tolerances, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把車體位移界 body 從 10 改成 11 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 21 變為 22 mm。先說明「車門月台橫向容差」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only body displacement bound body from 10 to 11 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 21 to 22 mm. Explain the causal direction for lateral door–platform tolerances, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 車門月台橫向容差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral door–platform tolerances: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車門月台橫向容差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral door–platform tolerances” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「車門月台橫向容差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for lateral door–platform tolerances. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：三項同向有界誤差的保守和，不是法定間隙允收值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conservative sum of three same-direction bounded errors, not a statutory gap allowance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。回到「車門月台橫向容差」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Trace the input chain for lateral door–platform tolerances. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車門月台橫向容差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral door–platform tolerances" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把最大值當成標準差再作均方根合成會失去保守性，基準點沉陷也會造成整排讀值偏移。

optionsEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating maxima as standard deviations and applying root-sum-square loses conservatism; datum settlement can bias the whole measurement row. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重複停準統計分散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Statistical spread of repeated stops: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複停準統計分散」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Statistical spread of repeated stops” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將平均停車偏移與隨機分散分開，只有獨立誤差才能以變異數相加而不隱藏共同基準偏差。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複停準統計分散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate mean stopping offset from random spread, adding variances only for independent errors without concealing a shared reference bias. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Statistical spread of repeated stops” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複停準統計分散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Statistical spread of repeated stops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複停準統計分散」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
本單元將平均停車偏移與隨機分散分開，只有獨立誤差才能以變異數相加而不隱藏共同基準偏差。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短

Separate mean stopping offset from random spread, adding variances only for independent errors without concealing a shared reference bias.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.

steps.title: 重複停準統計分散：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Statistical spread of repeated stops: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複停準統計分散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Statistical spread of repeated stops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：獨立誤差一標準差 s1=3 mm；獨立誤差二標準差 s2=4 mm。公式 y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2)，代入得 y=5 mm。邊界：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Formula y=sqrt(s1*s1+s2*s2) gives y=5 mm. Boundary: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: first independent standard deviation s1=3 mm; second independent standard deviation s2=4 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複停準統計分散：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Statistical spread of repeated stops: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複停準統計分散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Statistical spread of repeated stops” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以重複量測估計標準差與相關係數，將固定偏差另列，再核對合成殘差。以「重複停準統計分散」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate standard deviations and correlation from repeated observations, separate fixed bias, and compare combined residuals. For statistical spread of repeated stops, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立誤差一標準差 s1 從 3 改成 3.3 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5 變為 5.18556 mm。先說明「重複停準統計分散」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only first independent standard deviation s1 from 3 to 3.3 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5 to 5.18556 mm. Explain the causal direction for statistical spread of repeated stops, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 本單元記錄停穩、位置確認、門控接收與動作回授的順序，找出跨設備等待而非只看單門動作時間。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「列車與月台門交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Record stopped state, position confirmation, command reception and movement feedback to identify inter-device waiting rather than only individual door travel time. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旅客交換與門週期」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Passenger exchange and door cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把旅客交換時間與關門確認時間分開，分析窄門、行李及重複開門如何改變站停變異。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旅客交換與門週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Passenger exchange and door cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旅客交換與門週期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Passenger exchange and door cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 旅客交換與門週期
knowledge.text: 本單元把旅客交換時間與關門確認時間分開，分析窄門、行李及重複開門如何改變站停變異。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。
knowledge.textEn: Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旅客交換與門週期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Passenger exchange and door cycle" is correct?
options: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元把旅客交換時間與關門確認時間分開，分析窄門、行李及重複開門如何改變站停變異。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把旅客交換時間與關門確認時間分開，分析窄門、行李及重複開門如何改變站停變異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate passenger exchange from closure confirmation and examine how narrow openings, luggage and repeated opening change dwell variability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旅客交換與門週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Passenger exchange and door cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。

Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「旅客交換與門週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Passenger exchange and door cycle", which statement holds?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旅客交換與門週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Passenger exchange and door cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「旅客交換與門週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For passenger exchange and door cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「旅客交換與門週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for passenger exchange and door cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。以「旅客交換與門週期」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. For passenger exchange and door cycle, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把登車人數 N 從 180 改成 181 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30.75 變為 30.8542 s。先說明「旅客交換與門週期」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only boarding passengers N from 180 to 181 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 30.75 to 30.8542 s. Explain the causal direction for passenger exchange and door cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「旅客交換與門週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Passenger exchange and door cycle"?
options: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
optionsEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
quiz.explanation: 逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 旅客交換與門週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Passenger exchange and door cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「旅客交換與門週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Passenger exchange and door cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「旅客交換與門週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for passenger exchange and door cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「旅客交換與門週期」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for passenger exchange and door cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「旅客交換與門週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Passenger exchange and door cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。
系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell.
High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
quiz.explanation: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 門組故障服務影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service impact of door faults: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門組故障服務影響」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Service impact of door faults” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。相同可用度可能來自頻繁短停或罕見長停，對旅客與維修資源的影響不同；更不能把高可用度直接解讀為故障發生時一定安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門組故障服務影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare loss of one doorway with loss of an entire train service, recording repair waiting separately from component replacement time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter. The same value can arise from frequent brief outages or rare long ones with different passenger and maintenance consequences. High availability does not itself establish safe behaviour during failure. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Service impact of door faults” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「門組故障服務影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Service impact of door faults”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 門組故障服務影響
knowledge.text: 本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。可用度描述長時間內能提供服務的比例，故障頻率與修復速度都會影響它。
knowledge.textEn: Compare loss of one doorway with loss of an entire train service, recording repair waiting separately from component replacement time. Availability describes the fraction of long-run time during which service is possible; both failure frequency and repair duration matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「門組故障服務影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service impact of door faults" is correct?
options: 系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。
optionsEn: High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Compare loss of one doorway with loss of an entire train service, recording repair waiting separately from component replacement time.
quiz.explanation: 本單元比較單門停用與整列無法服務的影響，將修復等待和元件更換時間分開記錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare loss of one doorway with loss of an entire train service, recording repair waiting separately from component replacement time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 門組故障服務影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service impact of door faults: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門組故障服務影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Service impact of door faults” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：平均故障間隔 mtbf=2000 h；平均修復時間 mttr=4 h。公式 y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)，代入得 y=0.998004 1。邊界：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h. Formula y=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr) gives y=0.998004 1. Boundary: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「門組故障服務影響」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service impact of door faults", which statement holds?

速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
三個最大誤差都可直接用均方根方式縮小總界限
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean time between failures mtbf=2000 h; mean repair time mttr=4 h.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
Three maximum error bounds may always be reduced through root-sum-square combination.

steps.title: 門組故障服務影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service impact of door faults: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「門組故障服務影響」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Service impact of door faults” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。以「門組故障服務影響」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. For service impact of door faults, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均修復時間 mttr 從 4 改成 4.4 h（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.998004 變為 0.997805 1。先說明「門組故障服務影響」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean repair time mttr from 4 to 4.4 h (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.998004 to 0.997805 1. Explain the causal direction for service impact of door faults, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「門組故障服務影響」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service impact of door faults"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 分別核對故障起點、服務恢復及完全修復時間，避免把部分恢復誤列為全功能。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit failure onset, service restoration and full repair separately rather than counting degraded service as full functionality. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 門組故障服務影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service impact of door faults: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「門組故障服務影響」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Service impact of door faults” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「門組故障服務影響」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for service impact of door faults. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：可修復二狀態穩態模型，未含共同原因故障、預防保養與供應鏈等待。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Repairable two-state steady model; common-cause failures, planned maintenance and supply-chain waiting are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「系統可用度很高就能直接證明所有故障都是安全的」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High system availability directly proves that every failure is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。回到「門組故障服務影響」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Trace the input chain for service impact of door faults. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「門組故障服務影響」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service impact of door faults" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency.
quiz.explanation: 刪除長停機紀錄會扭曲平均修復時間；重複報修同一缺陷則會錯估故障頻率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing long outages distorts mean repair time, while duplicate reports of one defect distort failure frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 異車型門位配對與停準試驗樣本界限
stages.titleEn: Door-position mapping across fleets & Sampling limits of stopping trials
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「異車型門位配對」與「停準試驗樣本界限」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Door-position mapping across fleets" and "Sampling limits of stopping trials": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 異車型門位配對：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Door-position mapping across fleets: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「異車型門位配對」如何影響月台門列車停準整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Door-position mapping across fleets” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Platform-screen-door and stopping-position integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元建立車型、編組方向與停車標記的案例矩陣，將尚未測過的門位組合明列為證據缺口。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「異車型門位配對」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a matrix of fleet type, formation direction and stopping marker, explicitly listing untested door-position combinations as evidence gaps. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Door-position mapping across fleets” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：已執行案例 tested=72 cases；已定義案例 total=90 cases。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: executed cases tested=72 cases; defined cases total=90 cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「異車型門位配對」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Door-position mapping across fleets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Build a matrix of fleet type, formation direction and stopping marker, explicitly listing untested door-position combinations as evidence gaps. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「異車型門位配對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Door-position mapping across fleets" is correct?

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Formula y=1-(1-confidence)**(1/tests) gives y=0.00993608 failure probability. Boundary: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
