quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：獨立試驗次數 tests=300 independent trials；單側信賴水準 confidence=0.95 1。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: independent trial count tests=300 independent trials; one-sided confidence level confidence=0.95 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停準試驗樣本界限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling limits of stopping trials: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準試驗樣本界限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling limits of stopping trials” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「停準試驗樣本界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. For sampling limits of stopping trials, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把獨立試驗次數 tests 從 300 改成 301 independent trials（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.00993608 變為 0.00990324 failure probability。先說明「停準試驗樣本界限」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only independent trial count tests from 300 to 301 independent trials (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.00993608 to 0.00990324 failure probability. Explain the causal direction for sampling limits of stopping trials, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。以「停準試驗樣本界限」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

quiz.question: 要驗證「停準試驗樣本界限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling limits of stopping trials"?
options: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
quiz.explanation: 核對案例獨立性與抽樣範圍，保留所有失敗紀錄，再說明統計界限對哪一類情境有效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit independence and sampling scope, retain all failures, and state the scenario population to which the bound applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停準試驗樣本界限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling limits of stopping trials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準試驗樣本界限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling limits of stopping trials” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「停準試驗樣本界限」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Trace the input chain for sampling limits of stopping trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Trace the input chain for sampling limits of stopping trials. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停準試驗樣本界限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling limits of stopping trials" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。
速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption.
Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 車站旅客流量模擬
summary: 本課聚焦旅客守恆局部密度與離散事件模擬。從尖峰到達累積建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把局部群聚網格與非常態需求與出口連成可驗證的介面，最後以模擬成功外推界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies passenger conservation local density and discrete-event simulation. Start with accumulation under peak arrivals to define physical or information boundaries, connect spatial cells for local clustering with exceptional demand and exits as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through limits of successful simulation runs. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究尖峰到達累積。原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。敏感度只改 duration=120 至 132 s，輸出變為 79.2 persons；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究平均停留與存量：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=2 persons/s；平均停留時間 waiting=45 s。公式 y=arrival*waiting，代入得 y=90 persons。邊界：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元從列車到站帶來的需求波開始記錄，將進出站人數與區內存量放在相同時間窗。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate accumulation under peak arrivals. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. For sensitivity, change only duration=120 to 132 s; the output becomes 79.2 persons. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate mean residence and occupancy: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=2 persons/s; mean residence time waiting=45 s. Formula y=arrival*waiting gives y=90 persons. Boundary: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Start with the demand wave created by a train arrival, measuring entries, exits and internal occupancy over the same time window. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 尖峰到達累積與平均停留與存量
stages.titleEn: Accumulation under peak arrivals & Mean residence and occupancy
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「尖峰到達累積」與「平均停留與存量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Accumulation under peak arrivals" and "Mean residence and occupancy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 尖峰到達累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Accumulation under peak arrivals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「尖峰到達累積」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Accumulation under peak arrivals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元從列車到站帶來的需求波開始記錄，將進出站人數與區內存量放在相同時間窗。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。平均服務能力若只略高於平均需求，瞬間車潮仍會形成等待；人群不能被無限壓縮，所以排隊長度會回堵上游樓梯或月台，改變原先假設的到達方式。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尖峰到達累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Start with the demand wave created by a train arrival, measuring entries, exits and internal occupancy over the same time window. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow. Even service capacity slightly above mean demand can be overwhelmed by a train-arrival pulse. People cannot be compressed indefinitely, so a growing queue can block upstream stairs or platforms and alter the assumed arrival process. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Accumulation under peak arrivals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「尖峰到達累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Accumulation under peak arrivals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 尖峰到達累積
knowledge.text: 本單元從列車到站帶來的需求波開始記錄，將進出站人數與區內存量放在相同時間窗。排隊人數依流入減流出的守恆關係累積。
knowledge.textEn: Start with the demand wave created by a train arrival, measuring entries, exits and internal occupancy over the same time window. A queue accumulates according to inflow minus outflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「尖峰到達累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Accumulation under peak arrivals" is correct?
options: 出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊
本單元從列車到站帶來的需求波開始記錄，將進出站人數與區內存量放在相同時間窗。
平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度
optionsEn: Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
Start with the demand wave created by a train arrival, measuring entries, exits and internal occupancy over the same time window.
A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 本單元從列車到站帶來的需求波開始記錄，將進出站人數與區內存量放在相同時間窗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Start with the demand wave created by a train arrival, measuring entries, exits and internal occupancy over the same time window. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 尖峰到達累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Accumulation under peak arrivals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「尖峰到達累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Accumulation under peak arrivals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：到達流率 arrival=3.2 persons/s；離開流率 service=2.6 persons/s；觀察時間 duration=120 s。公式 y=(arrival-service)*duration，代入得 y=72 persons。邊界：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: arrival flow arrival=3.2 persons/s; departure flow service=2.6 persons/s; observation duration duration=120 s. Formula y=(arrival-service)*duration gives y=72 persons. Boundary: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 尖峰到達累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Accumulation under peak arrivals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「尖峰到達累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Accumulation under peak arrivals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時數進入、離開與區內存量，以影像匿名計數或人工抽樣核對人數守恆。以「尖峰到達累積」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. For accumulation under peak arrivals, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for accumulation under peak arrivals, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

quiz.question: 要驗證「尖峰到達累積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Increasing trajectory sample rate always produces more accurate pedestrian positions.

quiz.explanationEn: Count entries, exits and occupancy together, using anonymous image counts or manual samples to verify conservation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 尖峰到達累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Accumulation under peak arrivals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「尖峰到達累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Accumulation under peak arrivals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「尖峰到達累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Trace the input chain for accumulation under peak arrivals. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定流率、初始無排隊且流入大於流出；不含放棄、繞行及密度回饋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant flows, initially empty queue and inflow above outflow; abandonment, rerouting and density feedback are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口每秒通過人數穩定就能證明站內沒有排隊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。回到「尖峰到達累積」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。

Trace the input chain for accumulation under peak arrivals. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「尖峰到達累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Accumulation under peak arrivals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。
平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows.
A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 只量出口通過量會看不到後方累積，感測器漏計還可能讓看似平衡的流率掩蓋真實回堵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Exit throughput alone misses upstream accumulation; missed detections can hide real spillback behind apparently balanced flows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 平均停留與存量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「平均停留與存量」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean residence and occupancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較大廳平均人數與旅客停留時間，檢查觀察時段是否仍在累積而不符合穩態解讀。穩態平均存量等於平均到達率乘平均停留時間，這是流量與庫存的連結，不需要先指定排隊分布。它不能描述單一尖峰時刻，也不會告訴人群在空間上如何分布；量測窗若仍在快速累積，就不宜直接套用穩態關係。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平均停留與存量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare mean concourse occupancy with passenger residence time, checking whether the observation period is still accumulating and therefore unsuitable for steady-state interpretation. Mean occupancy equals mean arrival rate times mean residence time in steady flow. This connects throughput and inventory without requiring a specific queue distribution. It does not describe one peak instant or spatial distribution, and a rapidly accumulating observation window does not satisfy the steady-state interpretation. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean residence and occupancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=2 persons/s；平均停留時間 waiting=45 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=2 persons/s; mean residence time waiting=45 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平均停留與存量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean residence and occupancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=2 persons/s；平均停留時間 waiting=45 s。公式 y=arrival*waiting，代入得 y=90 persons。邊界：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=2 persons/s; mean residence time waiting=45 s. Formula y=arrival*waiting gives y=90 persons. Boundary: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平均停留與存量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mean residence and occupancy", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=2 persons/s；平均停留時間 waiting=45 s。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=2 persons/s; mean residence time waiting=45 s.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：平均到達率 arrival=2 persons/s；平均停留時間 waiting=45 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: mean arrival rate arrival=2 persons/s; mean residence time waiting=45 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平均停留與存量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean residence and occupancy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平均停留與存量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean residence and occupancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用一致進出邊界估計流率與停留時間，並與獨立區內人數平均值比對。以「平均停留與存量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate flow and residence time using consistent boundaries and compare with an independent mean occupancy count. For mean residence and occupancy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把平均停留時間 waiting 從 45 改成 49.5 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 90 變為 99 persons。先說明「平均停留與存量」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only mean residence time waiting from 45 to 49.5 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 90 to 99 persons. Explain the causal direction for mean residence and occupancy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把包含站外等待的停留時間乘上站內流率會混用邊界，造成存量高估或低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Combining residence time that includes an outside queue with an inside flow rate mixes boundaries and biases occupancy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用一致進出邊界估計流率與停留時間，並與獨立區內人數平均值比對。以「平均停留與存量」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate flow and residence time using consistent boundaries and compare with an independent mean occupancy count. For mean residence and occupancy, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把平均停留時間 waiting 從 45 改成 49.5 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 90 變為 99 persons。先說明「平均停留與存量」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only mean residence time waiting from 45 to 49.5 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 90 to 99 persons. Explain the causal direction for mean residence and occupancy, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平均停留與存量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mean residence and occupancy"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用一致進出邊界估計流率與停留時間，並與獨立區內人數平均值比對。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Estimate flow and residence time using consistent boundaries and compare with an independent mean occupancy count.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 使用一致進出邊界估計流率與停留時間，並與獨立區內人數平均值比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate flow and residence time using consistent boundaries and compare with an independent mean occupancy count. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平均停留與存量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mean residence and occupancy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平均停留與存量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mean residence and occupancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把包含站外等待的停留時間乘上站內流率會混用邊界，造成存量高估或低估。回到「平均停留與存量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Combining residence time that includes an outside queue with an inside flow rate mixes boundaries and biases occupancy. Trace the input chain for mean residence and occupancy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：穩態同一人群與同一系統邊界的長時間平均。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Long-run averages of the same population within one steady system boundary.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把包含站外等待的停留時間乘上站內流率會混用邊界，造成存量高估或低估。回到「平均停留與存量」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Combining residence time that includes an outside queue with an inside flow rate mixes boundaries and biases occupancy. Trace the input chain for mean residence and occupancy. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平均停留與存量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mean residence and occupancy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
把包含站外等待的停留時間乘上站內流率會混用邊界，造成存量高估或低估。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
Combining residence time that includes an outside queue with an inside flow rate mixes boundaries and biases occupancy.
quiz.explanation: 把包含站外等待的停留時間乘上站內流率會混用邊界，造成存量高估或低估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Combining residence time that includes an outside queue with an inside flow rate mixes boundaries and biases occupancy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 閘門後共同瓶頸與局部群聚網格
stages.titleEn: Shared bottlenecks beyond gates & Spatial cells for local clustering
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閘門後共同瓶頸」與「局部群聚網格」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared bottlenecks beyond gates" and "Spatial cells for local clustering": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閘門後共同瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared bottlenecks beyond gates: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閘門後共同瓶頸」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared bottlenecks beyond gates” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將多個閘門與共同出口連成服務網路，避免把各設備銘牌通量直接相加成全站容量。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。單位寬流率是情境參數，受方向、坡度與群體能力影響；多條通道的容量只有在下游沒有共同瓶頸時才能直接相加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閘門後共同瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connect multiple gates to their shared exit as a service network instead of adding individual nameplate flows into a station-wide capacity. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance. Specific flow is scenario dependent and varies with direction, slope and user capability. Parallel passage capacities may be added only when they do not share a downstream bottleneck. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shared bottlenecks beyond gates” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閘門後共同瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shared bottlenecks beyond gates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閘門後共同瓶頸
knowledge.text: 本單元將多個閘門與共同出口連成服務網路，避免把各設備銘牌通量直接相加成全站容量。通道容量與有效淨寬有關，但扶手、門扇、行李及靠邊避讓會減少可用寬度。
knowledge.textEn: Connect multiple gates to their shared exit as a service network instead of adding individual nameplate flows into a station-wide capacity. Passage capacity depends on effective clear width, reduced by rails, door leaves, luggage and edge avoidance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閘門後共同瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared bottlenecks beyond gates" is correct?
options: 本單元將多個閘門與共同出口連成服務網路，避免把各設備銘牌通量直接相加成全站容量。
兩條走道接到同一狹窄出口時容量仍可直接相加
整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠
optionsEn: Connect multiple gates to their shared exit as a service network instead of adding individual nameplate flows into a station-wide capacity.
Two corridors feeding one narrow exit always have directly additive capacity.
A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將多個閘門與共同出口連成服務網路，避免把各設備銘牌通量直接相加成全站容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Connect multiple gates to their shared exit as a service network instead of adding individual nameplate flows into a station-wide capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閘門後共同瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared bottlenecks beyond gates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閘門後共同瓶頸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shared bottlenecks beyond gates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：有效淨寬 width=2.4 m；假想單位寬流率 specific=1.1 persons/(m*s)。公式 y=width*specific，代入得 y=2.64 persons/s。邊界：均勻單向流的教學係數，不是法定疏散容量或規範值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: effective clear width width=2.4 m; hypothetical specific flow specific=1.1 persons/(m*s). Formula y=width*specific gives y=2.64 persons/s. Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測最窄位置的有效淨寬，將各方向流量分開統計，檢查下游是否出現排隊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure clear width at the narrowest section, count each travel direction separately, and inspect downstream queues.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Teaching coefficient for uniform one-way flow, not a statutory evacuation capacity or code value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閘門後共同瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared bottlenecks beyond gates", which statement holds?
options: 總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同

optionsEn: Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spatial cells for local clustering” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元在樓梯口與月台門前建立小網格，對照全站平均與局部峰值以辨認模型空間解析度需求。平均密度是人數除以可用面積，設備、柱體與危險邊緣應從面積中扣除。相同平均密度可以包含完全不同的局部群聚；門口、扶梯出口與轉角的局部高密度，常比整個大廳平均值更能解釋行走速度下降。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部群聚網格」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Create small spatial cells at stairs and platform doors, comparing global means with local peaks to determine required model resolution. Mean density divides people by usable area after excluding equipment, columns and unsafe edges. The same average can conceal very different local clustering. High density at doors, escalator landings or corners often explains reduced walking speed better than the average across a large concourse. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spatial cells for local clustering” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: occupants people=180 persons; usable standing area area=90 m2.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部群聚網格」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部群聚網格」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spatial cells for local clustering"?
options: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Stable exit throughput proves that no queue is forming inside the station.
quiz.explanation: 用網格分區計數比較平均與局部尖峰，記錄可用面積隨設備或圍籬變動的情況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count occupants in spatial cells, compare mean and local peaks, and record changes in usable area from equipment or barriers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部群聚網格：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spatial cells for local clustering: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部群聚網格」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spatial cells for local clustering” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。回到「局部群聚網格」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Trace the input chain for spatial cells for local clustering. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：靜態平均密度，不是擠壓力或個別人的安全風險模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Static mean density, not a crowd-pressure or individual-risk model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整個大廳平均密度低就能保證每個出口都不擁擠」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low concourse-average density guarantees that every exit is uncrowded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Trace the input chain for spatial cells for local clustering. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部群聚網格」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spatial cells for local clustering" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。
平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest.
The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 將封閉區域算入面積會低估密度，遮蔽導致漏計又可能恰好發生在最擁擠的地方。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Including closed areas understates density; occlusion-related undercounting can be worst precisely where crowding is greatest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 轉乘路徑與等待與月台交換耦合
stages.titleEn: Transfer paths and waiting & Coupling platform exchange to dwell
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉乘路徑與等待」與「月台交換耦合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer paths and waiting" and "Coupling platform exchange to dwell": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉乘路徑與等待：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer paths and waiting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘路徑與等待」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer paths and waiting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元把步行段、辨識方向與排隊段分開，檢查最短距離路徑是否也是不同能力群體的最短時間。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。坡道、門扇與轉乘決策都可能造成停頓；對行動受限旅客而言，較遠但連續可達的路徑往往比短而不連續的路徑更可用。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘路徑與等待」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate walking, wayfinding and queuing to test whether the shortest-distance route also gives the shortest time for different user capabilities. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone. Ramps, doors and transfer decisions can introduce pauses. For a mobility-limited traveller, a longer continuously accessible route can be more usable than a shorter route containing an inaccessible interruption. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer paths and waiting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉乘路徑與等待」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transfer paths and waiting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉乘路徑與等待
knowledge.text: 本單元把步行段、辨識方向與排隊段分開，檢查最短距離路徑是否也是不同能力群體的最短時間。總旅行時間應同時計入移動與等待，不能只比較平面上的最短距離。
knowledge.textEn: Separate walking, wayfinding and queuing to test whether the shortest-distance route also gives the shortest time for different user capabilities. Travel time includes movement and waiting rather than plan distance alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉乘路徑與等待」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer paths and waiting" is correct?
options: 平面圖上最短的路徑一定是每位旅客最快的路徑
總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同
本單元把步行段、辨識方向與排隊段分開，檢查最短距離路徑是否也是不同能力群體的最短時間。
optionsEn: The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger.
Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times.
Separate walking, wayfinding and queuing to test whether the shortest-distance route also gives the shortest time for different user capabilities.
quiz.explanation: 本單元把步行段、辨識方向與排隊段分開，檢查最短距離路徑是否也是不同能力群體的最短時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate walking, wayfinding and queuing to test whether the shortest-distance route also gives the shortest time for different user capabilities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉乘路徑與等待：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer paths and waiting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉乘路徑與等待」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer paths and waiting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。公式 y=distance/speed+wait，代入得 y=185 s。邊界：定步速與固定等待的概念估算，未含煙氣、擁擠及協助需求分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Formula y=distance/speed+wait gives y=185 s. Boundary: Constant speed and fixed waiting; smoke, crowd interaction and distribution of assistance needs are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉乘路徑與等待」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transfer paths and waiting", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。
只要軌跡取樣頻率提高就必定得到更準確的行人位置
完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s.
Increasing trajectory sample rate always produces more accurate pedestrian positions.
Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：行走距離 distance=120 m；假想步速 speed=0.8 m/s；等待時間 wait=35 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: walking distance distance=120 m; assumed walking speed speed=0.8 m/s; waiting time wait=35 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉乘路徑與等待：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer paths and waiting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘路徑與等待」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer paths and waiting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「轉乘路徑與等待」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For transfer paths and waiting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把假想步速 speed 從 0.8 改成 0.88 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 185 變為 171.364 s。先說明「轉乘路徑與等待」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only assumed walking speed speed from 0.8 to 0.88 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 185 to 171.364 s. Explain the causal direction for transfer paths and waiting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分段記錄行走與等待，不以最快受試者代表所有旅客，並對照不同能力群體。以「轉乘路徑與等待」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Record movement and waiting separately, avoid representing everyone by the fastest participant, and compare groups with different abilities. For transfer paths and waiting, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer paths and waiting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量無人環境步行時間會低估轉乘負擔，電梯等待與路徑中斷可能主導總時間。回到「轉乘路徑與等待」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncrowded walking tests understate transfer burden when elevator waits or route interruptions dominate total time. Trace the input chain for transfer paths and waiting. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest route on a plan is always the fastest route for every passenger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 月台交換耦合：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「月台交換耦合」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coupling platform exchange to dwell” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將上車需求回饋到列車停站時間，再讓停站變化影響後續到達波，形成可觀察的閉迴路。停站時間包含人流服務與固定開關門程序。各門均分旅客時可用總服務率估算，但熱門樓梯旁的門通常更壅塞；瓶頸門完成時間控制發車，平均流率因此不能保證最忙車門也能按時結束。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台交換耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Feed boarding demand into train dwell and then let dwell variation affect subsequent arrival waves, creating an observable feedback loop. Dwell includes passenger service and fixed door sequences. Dividing by total service rate assumes an even passenger distribution, yet doors near popular stairs are often more crowded. The busiest door governs completion, so average flow cannot guarantee timely clearance at that door. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coupling platform exchange to dwell” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台交換耦合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Coupling platform exchange to dwell”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 月台交換耦合：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台交換耦合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coupling platform exchange to dwell” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：登車人數 N=180 persons；有效門數 doors=12 doors；每門流率 rate=0.8 persons/(s*door)；固定程序時間 fixed=12 s。公式 y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed，代入得 y=30.75 s。邊界：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: boarding passengers N=180 persons; effective doors doors=12 doors; flow per door rate=0.8 persons/(s*door); fixed procedure time fixed=12 s. Formula y=N/(doors*rate)+fixed gives y=30.75 s. Boundary: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐門記錄開始與結束時間，將固定程序從人流時間中扣除，再比較最忙門與平均門。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record start and finish at each door, subtract fixed procedure time, and compare the busiest door with the mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「月台交換耦合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for coupling platform exchange to dwell. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻單向登車，沒有下車逆流、行李阻塞或門重開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform one-way boarding without alighting counterflow, luggage blockage or door reopening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總旅客數相同就代表每次停站時間一定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total passenger counts always produce equal dwell times." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。回到「月台交換耦合」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Trace the input chain for coupling platform exchange to dwell. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台交換耦合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coupling platform exchange to dwell" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
optionsEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
quiz.explanation: 平均人數正常但單門集中仍會延誤；門故障與旅客逆流都可能造成相似的總停站時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal average load can hide a concentrated door queue; mechanical faults and passenger counterflow can produce similar total dwell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 非常態需求與出口與人流資料取樣尺度
stages.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits & Sampling scale for flow data
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「非常態需求與出口」與「人流資料取樣尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exceptional demand and exits" and "Sampling scale for flow data": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 非常態需求與出口：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「非常態需求與出口」如何影響車站旅客流量模擬的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exceptional demand and exits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Station passenger-flow simulation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。此處串接估算保守地把行走和排隊相加，實際兩者可重疊；火災分析還要比較可用安全時間、煙氣與群體差異，不能只由一個清空時間判定生命安全。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「非常態需求與出口」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service. This serial estimate conservatively adds travel and queuing, which can overlap in reality. Fire assessment must also consider available safe time, smoke and population differences; one clearance time cannot establish life safety. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exceptional demand and exits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「非常態需求與出口」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Exceptional demand and exits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 非常態需求與出口
knowledge.text: 本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。疏散估算需把察覺反應、移動與出口服務分開。
knowledge.textEn: Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument. Evacuation estimates separate recognition/response, movement and exit service.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「非常態需求與出口」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exceptional demand and exits" is correct?
options: 算出疏散清空時間就足以單獨證明火災時絕對安全
本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。
只要軌跡取樣頻率提高就必定得到更準確的行人位置
optionsEn: A calculated evacuation clearance time alone proves absolute fire safety.
Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument.
Increasing trajectory sample rate always produces more accurate pedestrian positions.
quiz.explanation: 本單元用原創串行算例比較出口不可用情境，將正常營運客流校準與火災生命安全論證分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use an original serial example to compare unavailable exits, separating normal-service flow calibration from a fire life-safety argument. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 非常態需求與出口：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非常態需求與出口」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exceptional demand and exits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。公式 y=response+travel+people/(width*flow)，代入得 y=421.667 s。邊界：原創串行教學模型，非規範認可疏散驗證，也未估可用安全疏散時間。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Formula y=response+travel+people/(width*flow) gives y=421.667 s. Boundary: Original serial teaching model, not code-approved egress verification; available safe egress time is not estimated.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「非常態需求與出口」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exceptional demand and exits", which statement holds?
options: 完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零
平均人數關係能直接預測任何瞬間的最大擁擠程度
原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons。
optionsEn: Many failure-free tests prove that the failure probability is zero.
A mean occupancy relation directly predicts the maximum crowding at every instant.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：待疏散人數 people=600 persons；有效出口寬 width=2.5 m；假想比流率 flow=0.9 persons/(m*s)；代表行走時間 travel=110 s；反應時間 response=45 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: evacuating population people=600 persons; effective exit width width=2.5 m; assumed specific flow flow=0.9 persons/(m*s); representative travel time travel=110 s; response time response=45 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 非常態需求與出口：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exceptional demand and exits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非常態需求與出口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exceptional demand and exits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「非常態需求與出口」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For exceptional demand and exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「非常態需求與出口」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only evacuating population people from 600 to 601 persons (increase by one whole count), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 421.667 to 422.111 s. Explain the causal direction for exceptional demand and exits, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把預先知道演練的反應時間套到真實事件會低估延誤，忽略封閉出口又會高估容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using reaction times from announced drills understates real-event delay; ignoring an unavailable exit overstates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不造成擁擠的受控演練校對各時間段，逐項保留行動受限者與協助程序的差異。以「非常態需求與出口」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Use controlled non-crowding exercises to check timing components and retain differences for assisted and mobility-limited users. For exceptional demand and exits, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.text: 只把待疏散人數 people 從 600 改成 601 persons（增加一個可計數單位），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 421.667 變為 422.111 s。先說明「非常態需求與出口」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
